title: Growth Manager - Influencer Marketing
description:
**Growth Manager – Influencer Marketing**




  





***Experience: 2–5 years***




***Compensation: As per experience and expertise, up to ₹6 LPA***




***Preferred: Influencer Marketing / Agency experience***




  





**About Marqueting Ventures** 




 Marqueting Ventures is an influencer marketing and brand\-building company working with leading brands across beauty, fashion, lifestyle, D2C, healthcare, retail and consumer categories.
 



  





 With 6\+ years of industry experience and a growing network of creators across categories, languages, regions and platforms, we work across the entire influencer marketing ecosystem — from strategy and creator discovery to campaign execution, content and performance.
 



  





 As we continue to scale, we are looking for someone who can bring more structure, visibility, and efficiency to how our business operates while actively contributing to its growth.
 



  





 About the Role
 



 We are looking for a Growth Manager to own business growth, project management, operational efficiency, and client relationships across our influencer marketing business.
 



  





 This is a high\-ownership and accountability\-led role. You will be expected to bring structure to a fast\-moving environment, create and improve processes, maintain visibility across business performance and ensure that opportunities and projects move forward efficiently and profitably.
 



  





 The role requires someone who can look at the business both strategically and operationally — understanding where growth can come from, ensuring existing business is delivered well, identifying potential risks and gaps, and creating systems that allow the team and business to scale effectively.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





***Business Growth \& Revenue***




 \* Analyse the company's growth, revenue and business performance and identify opportunities for month\-on\-month growth.
 



 \* Identify new business avenues across clients, categories, services and campaign formats.
 



 \* Work closely with the team to ensure new opportunities are evaluated, planned and moved forward efficiently.
 



 \* Maintain visibility on the business pipeline, expected closures and potential revenue gaps.
 



 \* Track existing client business and identify opportunities for retention, expansion and increased revenue.
 



 \* Monitor project\-level and client\-level growth to ensure overall business growth.
 



 \* Work towards maintaining a healthy and predictable monthly revenue pipeline.
 



  





***Project \& Delivery Management***




 \* Ensure new requirements are appropriately planned, assigned and initiated within timelines.
 



 \* Track ongoing projects and ensure timely, high\-quality delivery.
 



 \* Monitor project progress, identify bottlenecks and proactively resolve issues.
 



 \* Ensure projects are commercially and operationally viable before and during execution.
 



 \* Ensure timely project closures, documentation and billing.
 



 \* Work across teams and stakeholders to ensure smooth delivery of client requirements.
 



 \* Step into execution or operational responsibilities whenever required to ensure business continuity and delivery.
 



  





***Process \& Operational Management***




 \* Establish, document and continuously improve processes across the business.
 



 \* Create structures that improve accountability, efficiency and visibility.
 



 \* Ensure trackers, sheets, databases and reporting systems are consistently maintained and accurate.
 



 \* Monitor team bandwidth and ensure work is distributed appropriately based on capacity, capability and priority.
 



 \* Identify operational inefficiencies and implement practical solutions.
 



 \* Create systems that reduce dependency on individual follow\-ups and improve timely execution.
 



 \* Ensure important information, data and project updates are easily accessible to the relevant stakeholders.
 



  





***Reporting \& Business Intelligence***




 \* Maintain accurate Excel\-based trackers and business reports.
 



 \* Prepare regular reports and updates on business performance and operational progress.
 



 \* Analyse data to identify trends, gaps, risks and growth opportunities.
 



 \* Maintain a clear view of daily priorities as well as the broader monthly business pipeline.
 



 \* Use data and reporting to support business decisions.
 



  





***Client \& Relationship Management***




 \* Maintain strong relationships with existing clients and key stakeholders.
 



 \* Ensure client requirements are understood, communicated and delivered effectively.
 



 \* Monitor client satisfaction and identify potential retention or escalation risks.
 



 \* Support relationship expansion and identify opportunities for additional business.
 



 \* Handle escalations and coordinate internally to ensure timely resolution.
 



 \* Ensure the quality and consistency of delivery contribute towards long\-term client relationships.
 



  





***Team \& Stakeholder Management***




 \* Work closely with relevant teams.
 



 \* Ensure priorities, responsibilities and timelines are clearly communicated.
 



 \* Support team members and managers in resolving operational challenges.
 



 \* Ensure accountability is maintained across projects without compromising team efficiency.
 



 \* Identify capacity requirements and potential resource gaps based on business pipeline.
 



 \* Build a culture of structured working, timely communication and ownership.
 



  





**What We're Looking For** 




 \* 2–5 years of relevant professional experience, preferably in influencer marketing, digital marketing, agency operations, account management, business management or a related field.
 



 \* Agency experience will be an advantage.
 



 \* Management experience is a strong plus.
 



 \* Strong understanding of influencer marketing and agency workflows.
 



 \* Someone who genuinely values process, structure, documentation and accountability.
 



 \* Ability to create systems and processes rather than simply work within existing ones.
 



 \* Strong analytical and problem\-solving ability.
 



 \* Excellent command of Excel / Google Sheets and comfort working extensively with data, trackers and reports.
 



 \* Strong commercial understanding of revenue, profitability, utilisation, billing and business growth.
 



 \* Excellent formal written and verbal communication skills.
 



 \* Strong client and stakeholder management abilities.
 



 \* Ability to manage multiple priorities and maintain visibility in a fast\-paced environment.
 



 \* Proactive approach to identifying and solving problems.
 



 \* Willingness to take ownership beyond a defined job description when the business requires it.
 



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 \* Business and revenue show consistent month\-on\-month growth.
 



 \* New opportunities are evaluated and moved forward without unnecessary delays.
 



 \* Existing clients are retained, satisfied and generating repeat business.
 



 \* Projects are delivered on time and to the expected quality.
 



 \* Team bandwidth is optimised and work is distributed effectively.
 



 \* Projects are commercially viable and quality is protected.
 



 \* Billing and project closures happen on time.
 



 \* Clear and reliable visibility on business performance, pipeline and risks.
 



 \* Processes, data and reporting remain accurate and consistently maintained.
 



 \* The organisation becomes more structured and scalable as the business grows.
 



 \* Problems are identified early, ownership is clear and escalations are managed effectively.
 



  





*You should enjoy bringing order to complexity. You should be comfortable looking at a large number of moving parts, identifying what needs attention, creating a structure around it and ensuring that things actually get done.* 




  





***Reach out at aakriti@marquetingventures.com or hr@marquetingventures.com***

title: Influencer Marketing Lead
description:
**Influencer Marketing Lead**




  





 We are looking for a seasoned, dynamic Influencer Marketing Lead to head Lenskart's influencer marketing charter nationally. In this role, you will define and own influencer, content creator and celebrity marketing strategy end\-to\-end — setting the vision, building the playbook, and leading a distributed team of regional influencer marketing managers across North, South, East and West India. You'll be the single point of accountability for how Lenskart shows up through creators and talent across every language market in the country, ensuring regional depth (Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Bengali, Marathi, Gujarati, Malayalam, Punjabi and more) rolls up into one coherent, scalable, national strategy.
 



  





 You've built and led influencer or creator marketing functions before — whether at a large D2C/ecommerce brand, a top\-tier influencer or talent management agency, or an MCN — and you know how to pair sharp campaign instincts with the discipline of running a team, a budget and a set of vendor relationships at national scale. You have a strong business acumen and are concerned with data and results, not just feelings.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**




  





 ● Own the national influencer, content creator and celebrity marketing strategy for Lenskart, aligned to brand and business objectives across the full house of brands (John Jacobs, Vincent Chase, Lenskart Air, Aqualens, BLU)
 



 ● Build, lead and mentor a team of regional influencer marketing managers across India (North, South, East, West), setting clear goals, reviewing campaign quality, and holding a consistent bar while leaving room for regional and language\-led nuance
 



 ● Design the overarching creator and celebrity partnership framework for the country — tiering (mega/macro/micro/nano), rate cards, negotiation guardrails, contracting templates, and fraud/quality checks such as fake followers or inflated engagement
 



 ● Build and own relationships with India's leading talent management and celebrity management agencies, influencer marketing agencies and MCNs, negotiating retainers and preferred\-partner arrangements at a national level
 



 ● Lead celebrity and top\-tier talent partnerships for marquee brand moments, campaigns and product launches, working closely with brand, creative and category teams
 



 ● Set up and govern always\-on creator programs (ambassador cohorts, always\-on seeding, UGC pipelines) alongside campaign\-based bursts tied to launches, sales events and regional festivals across the calendar
 



 ● Apply Artificial Intelligence in your workflow to improve efficiency and outcome of results.
 



 ● Define and track the measurement framework for influencer marketing — engagement quality, reach, conversion/attribution and ROI — and report performance and learnings to senior leadership
 



 ● Own the national influencer marketing budget, allocating spend across regions and campaigns and ensuring efficient utilization
 



 ● Act as the senior point of escalation for stakeholder management across marketing, category, e\-commerce, PR/communications, legal and finance teams
 



 ● Build scalable systems, SOPs and tools (creator CRM, campaign trackers, vetting checklists) so the function runs consistently as it scales across regions and markets
 



 ● Stay ahead of the creator economy — platform shifts, format trends, emerging creators, competitor activity and disclosure/compliance requirements — and translate that into Lenskart's playbook
 



 ● Manage crisis or reputation situations involving creators or celebrity partners, in coordination with PR and legal
 



  





**What We're Looking For:**




  





 ● 8–12 years of experience in influencer marketing, creator/talent management or celebrity marketing, including at least 3 \-4 years in a leadership or people\-management capacity
 



 ● Proven experience building or scaling a pan\-India, multi\-regional, multi\-lingual influencer marketing function — either in\-house at a large consumer brand, D2C or e\-commerce company, or at a leading influencer/talent management agency or MCN
 



 ● Track record of managing distributed teams across geographies, setting direction centrally while empowering regional specialists to move fast locally
 



 ● Deep, current network across India's creator and celebrity ecosystem — relationships with major talent management agencies, influencer marketing agencies, MCNs and celebrity managers
 



 ● Strong commercial acumen: experience owning a marketing budget, negotiating agency/creator/celebrity deals, and reporting ROI to senior stakeholders
 



 ● Sound grasp of the creator economy — how creators and celebrities price themselves, what separates genuine engagement from vanity metrics, and how regional content strategy differs from pan\-India content
 



 ● Excellent stakeholder management and executive communication skills; comfortable presenting strategy and results to CXO\-level leadership
 



 ● Experience setting up processes, SOPs and vetting frameworks (fraud/fake\-follower detection, contracting, compliance) to run an influencer function at scale
 



 ● Bachelor's degree required; MBA or equivalent preferred Nice to Have
 



 ● Experience in fashion, beauty, lifestyle, consumer electronics or other high\-influencer\-intensity D2C categories
 



 ● Prior experience managing celebrity brand ambassador relationships alongside creator/influencer marketing
 



 ● Familiarity with influencer marketing and analytics tools (Qoruz, Kofluence, Modash,Influencer.in, etc.)
 



 ● Experience working across multiple Indian language markets and regional cultural moments
 



 ● Exposure to international/APAC creator marketing, given Lenskart's footprint in Singapore, Dubai and Japan (via Owndays)
 



 ● Experience partnering with performance marketing teams to build always\-on, ROI\-driven creator programs

description:

**Management Level**

**Experience**
 5\-12 years of relevant experience in process excellence, marketing transformation, functional consulting, or management consulting
   

  

**Educational Qualification**
 Bachelor's Degree or equivalent
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Practice: I\&P \| Global Network \- SONG \| Areas of Work: Marketing Process Excellence, AI\-Enabled Marketing Transformation, Future\-State Marketing Process Design, Marketing Operating Model Redesign, Agent Experience (AX) Design, Functional Consulting.
   

  

 As a Senior Manager, you will advise C\-suite and senior marketing stakeholders and lead large\-scale marketing process transformation programs that help consumer\-led organizations reimagine customer acquisition, engagement, loyalty, content, media, CRM, and measurement through digital innovation, data\-driven decision\-making, and AI\-powered experiences. Operating at the intersection of business strategy, customer experience, marketing, analytics, technology, and operations, you will shape transformation strategies, define future\-state operating models and roadmaps, govern delivery quality, and deliver measurable business outcomes across the customer lifecycle.
   

  

**You Are**
 You are a senior marketing transformation advisor who sets the standard for how marketing process excellence work is shaped and delivered. You bring deep knowledge of modern marketing operating models and can translate enterprise growth and customer priorities into transformation strategies covering process, organization, technology, data, AI, governance, measurement, and adoption.
   

  

 You embed Agent Experience (AX) Design into the transformation methodology, defining how AI agents should operate within marketing workflows and how autonomy, human judgment, decision rights, controls, escalation, and human\-agent handoffs should be designed. You coach teams to apply these principles consistently across engagements.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
 Use AI tools and agentic approaches across transformation strategy, research, diagnostics, design, and deliverable creation. As a Senior Manager / Associate Director, you will lead senior client conversations, shape transformation programs, govern multiple workstreams, develop managers and specialists, and ensure that recommendations translate into measurable business value. Your responsibilities include:
   

  

**Marketing Transformation Methodology \& Benchmarking**
* Define and govern the marketing process redesign approach used to assess market and consumer forces, benchmark current operations, identify reinvention opportunities, and prioritize transformation across customer acquisition, engagement, loyalty, campaign operations, content, media, CRM, social, search, marketing operations, and measurement.
* Set the benchmarking and value\-assessment approach for marketing process excellence, linking redesign opportunities to measurable outcomes such as growth, customer value, productivity, speed\-to\-market, marketing effectiveness, cost efficiency, and control.
* Determine how marketing domain expertise, industry benchmarks, and reusable functional playbooks are applied consistently across the team's portfolio of engagements.


**Future\-State Marketing Process \& Operating Model Design**
* Set standards for future\-state marketing process and operating model design, including AI integration, workflow automation, decision rights, governance, human\-machine interaction, platform enablement, measurement, and adoption requirements.
* Lead C\-suite and senior client workshops, transformation roadmap discussions, and recommendation reviews; approve final designs before client delivery and ensure they are practical, scalable, measurable, and implementation\-ready.
* Collaborate with technology, data, creative, media, CRM, analytics, and delivery partners to ensure that process design and MarTech/AdTech platform choices work together across transformation programs.


**Portfolio Leadership, Change \& Capability Building**
* Govern change impact, organizational design, capability building, governance, and workforce adoption approaches across marketing transformation programs, ensuring consistency and quality across engagements.
* Manage and develop direct reports; coach managers and senior specialists on marketing process redesign, operating model design, executive facilitation, client advisory, and domain application.


**AI \& AX Design Governance**
* Define how Agent Experience (AX) Design is embedded in the marketing process excellence methodology, including standards for AI agent roles, autonomy levels, decision boundaries, controls, escalation triggers, and human\-agent handoffs.
* Shape reusable agentic marketing patterns and governance for use cases across planning, insights, content, campaign operations, CRM, media, optimization, measurement, and reporting.


**Professional \& Technical Skills**
* 5\-12 years of experience in process excellence, marketing transformation, functional consulting, or management consulting, with significant leadership across client engagements.
* Deep marketing domain expertise with the ability to shape transformation strategy and methodology across multiple marketing capabilities and apply it across industries and client contexts.
* Demonstrated ability to lead large\-scale transformation programs, define and govern methodology and quality standards, and shape future\-state operating models and roadmaps across a portfolio of engagements.
* Strong understanding of AI, automation, and agentic operating models and how they change marketing workflows, roles, controls, decision rights, and technology requirements.
* Proven track record advising C\-suite and senior stakeholders, facilitating executive workshops, presenting recommendations, and resolving complex transformation and stakeholder issues.
* Experience managing and developing teams in a consulting environment and coaching practitioners on process redesign and marketing transformation methods.
* Ability to connect growth and customer value with marketing process, customer experience, data, MarTech/AdTech, AI, analytics, organization, governance, measurement, and adoption choices.
* Experience leading complex, multi\-workstream transformation programs in global and matrixed environments, with accountability for quality, risk, staffing, and delivery outcomes.
* Strong business development capability, including opportunity qualification, solution shaping, proposal leadership, thought leadership contribution, and senior client relationship development.


**Additional Information**
* Experience in consumer\-led B2C industries is strongly preferred, including Consumer Goods \& Services, Retail, Life Sciences, Automotive, Travel, Communications \& Media, or similar sectors with scaled marketing operations.
* Familiarity with process mining, digital twin, process mapping, or AI\-assisted design tools such as Signavio, Celonis, ARIS, Visio, or equivalent is desirable.
* Strong awareness of enterprise MarTech/AdTech ecosystems and their role in enabling redesigned marketing processes; direct platform implementation experience is helpful but not mandatory.
* Demonstrated ability to embed Agent Experience (AX) Design into delivery standards and govern how AI agent experiences are specified and validated across transformation engagements.
* Experience building reusable marketing transformation assets, playbooks, benchmarks, methods, or intellectual property is strongly preferred.
* Strong executive presence, commercial judgment, and a proactive approach to staying current on AI, agentic marketing, automation, and evolving marketing operating models.

 Master’s degree in business or related field;

title: Growth Manager, India
description:
**Growth Manager, India** 

**Location: India (Delhi/Coimbatore/Bangalore)** 





 Are you the person who fixes the process everyone else has learned to live with? Base.com India has grown to a 40\-person team across sales, implementation, support, and marketing, and the way we work has not kept pace with the team. We are looking for a
 
**Growth Manager, India** 

 to run growth experiments across the funnel, run the projects that cut across functions, write the SOPs, and train the team on them. If ownership, hustle, and impact define you, this is your launchpad.
 



**Why Base.com?** 


 We are on a mission to become the global operating system for multichannel commerce. Our platform helps over 30,000 companies worldwide manage orders, inventory, warehouses, listings, and workflows across marketplaces and storefronts, backed by 2000\+ integrations (including Amazon, Flipkart, Shopify, Zoho, Tally, Shiprocket, Delhivery, and more). Headquartered in Poland with teams across 17 countries, we are scaling fast, and India is our next big frontier.
 



**What You'll Own \& Drive** 
* **Growth Experiments** 

 : Run experiments across the full funnel: lead generation and pipeline, trial signup to first live order, retention and expansion in the customer base, and marketing and content together with the marketing team. Measure everything, kill what does not move a number, scale what does.
* **Cross\-Functional Projects** 

 : Project\-manage the initiatives that cut across sales, implementation, support, and marketing. Scope, owners, deadlines, follow\-through.
* **Process Improvement \& SOPs** 

 : Find the broken or missing process in each function, fix it, and write the SOP so the function runs it without you.
* **Team Training** 

 : Design and run onboarding for new joiners, product and process refreshers, and training on the tools and AI workflows the team uses every day.
* **Career Development** 

 : Build role ladders, skill maps, and a review cadence with the Country CEO, so every person on the team knows what growth looks like here.
* **Operating Rhythm** 

 : Own the weekly and monthly cadence that keeps every function on its numbers.


**Who You Are** 
* **Builder Mindset** 

 : You would rather design the process from zero than run one somebody else built. There is no growth team, no project office, and no L\&D department here. You are all three.
* **Experienced \& Independent** 

 : 5\-8 years in operations, growth, programme management, consulting, or a founder's office at a startup, SaaS company, or ecommerce business in India. Comfortable leading without direct reports.
* **Process Person With Numbers** 

 : You have written SOPs that people actually followed, and run growth experiments with a number attached: what you tried, what moved, what you killed.
* **Trainer at Heart** 

 : You have taught a team something they did not know, and you enjoyed it.
* **Data Comfortable** 

 : Sheets, dashboards, CRM reports. You find the number before you form the opinion.
* **AI and Tech Savvy** 

 : You use AI tools every day to move faster, and you can teach a team to do the same.
* **Multilingual Communicator** 

 : Fluent in English, and at least one of Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Marathi, Gujarati, or Bengali.
* **Doer Culture Fit** 

 : At Base India, everyone executes. The Country CEO does demos. You start as an executor and earn your mandate through results.
* **Bonus Points** 

 : Ecommerce or SaaS domain experience. Hands\-on with HubSpot, ClickUp, or similar CRM and project tools.


**What's In It For You?** 
* **Impact from Day One** 

 : You will shape how the entire India operation runs, across sales, implementation, support, and marketing.
* **Direct Access** 

 : Report to the Country CEO. No layers. You are in the room for every decision that matters.
* **Own the Playbook** 

 : The SOPs, training, and growth loops you build become how Base.com India scales.
* **Long\-Term Growth** 

 : Join during the India build phase and grow into a head\-of\-operations role as the team scales.
* **Competitive Compensation** 

 : We pay well for people who deliver.


**Ready to Build for India's Ecommerce Future?** 


 If you are a hands\-on operator who wants to make a fast\-growing team run better, apply now. In your note, tell us one process you built or one experiment you ran, what you did, and the number it moved.

description:

**About The Role**
 We are looking for an experienced and result\-oriented
 **D2C E\-Commerce Head** 
 to lead and scale our direct\-to\-consumer (D2C) business. The ideal candidate will be responsible for driving online revenue, improving customer acquisition and retention, optimizing the e\-commerce funnel, and building a profitable and scalable D2C business.
   

  

 The candidate should have strong hands\-on experience in
 **Shopify, performance marketing, D2C P\&L management, retention/CRM, conversion optimization, and analytics**

 **footwear, fashion, or lifestyle** 
 industry. This is a
 **D2C\-first role** 
 : the primary focus is the company's own website, not marketplaces.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities1\. D2C Business Strategy \& P\&L Ownership
   

  

* Own the D2C website P\&L — revenue, contribution margin, profitability, and growth targets.
* Develop and execute the overall D2C e\-commerce growth strategy aligned with business objectives.

* D2C Website Management (Shopify)

* Develop strategies for customer acquisition, retargeting, remarketing, and customer retention.
* Own and optimize key metrics such as ROAS, CAC, CTR, CPC, CVR, AOV, LTV, and contribution margin.

* Retention, CRM \& Loyalty
* Own the retention strategy — email, WhatsApp, SMS, push notifications, and CRM automation.
* Build and manage loyalty programs, referral programs, and winback campaigns.
* Track and improve repeat purchase rate, customer retention rate, and customer lifetime value (LTV).
* Develop strategies to increase repeat purchases and reduce churn.
* Use customer insights to personalize communication and improve lifetime value.
* Brand, Content \& Community

* Build and manage creator/influencer partnerships and affiliate programs.
* Develop content strategy — UGC, blogs, social media, and product\-led content.
* Foster community engagement to build brand loyalty and organic advocacy.
* Revenue \& Conversion Growth

* Analyze the complete e\-commerce funnel and identify opportunities to improve conversion.
* Conduct A/B testing and implement CRO initiatives.
* Plan and execute major campaigns around festive seasons, launches, sales events, and new product drops.
* Analytics \& Business Intelligence
* Track and analyze daily, weekly, and monthly D2C performance.
* Build and monitor dashboards covering revenue, orders, traffic, conversion, CAC, ROAS, AOV, retention, and profitability.
* Use data and customer insights to make business decisions.
* Identify gaps in performance and implement corrective action plans.
* Product \& Merchandising (Footwear\-Specific)
* Work closely with product and merchandising teams to optimize the online product assortment.
* Identify best\-selling, slow\-moving, and high\-potential products.
* Develop product launch and online merchandising strategies.
* Own inventory planning for footwear — size curves, seasonality, SKU rationalization, and stock\-out reduction — in coordination with supply chain and warehouse teams.
* Reduce stock\-outs, cancellations, and inventory\-related revenue leakage.
* Customer Experience \& Operations
* Improve the overall customer experience across the D2C journey.
* Work with customer service and operations teams to reduce returns, cancellations, complaints, and delivery issues.
* Coordinate with marketing, creative, product, finance, warehouse, logistics, technology, and customer service teams.
* Ensure smooth order processing, fulfillment, delivery, returns, and refunds.
* Ensure D2C processes are scalable as the business grows.
* Team \& Agency Management
* Build, manage, and mentor a 5–10 member D2C/e\-commerce team across performance marketing, CRM, CRO, content, and operations.
* Set clear KRAs and performance targets for team members.
* Manage external agencies, technology partners, freelancers, and other vendors.
* Ensure timely execution of campaigns and business initiatives.


 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
   

  

* D2C Revenue Growth
* Contribution Margin (CM2/CM3\)
* Website Conversion Rate (CVR)
* Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
* Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)
* Average Order Value (AOV)
* Customer Lifetime Value (LTV)
* Repeat Purchase Rate
* Customer Retention Rate
* New Customer Acquisition
* Website Traffic \& Engagement
* Organic Traffic Share
* Cart Abandonment Rate
* Return \& Cancellation Rate
* Inventory Availability
* Loyalty Program Enrollment
* Brand Search Volume


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, E\-Commerce, or a related field; MBA preferred.
* 8–12 years of relevant experience in D2C / E\-commerce, with at least 3–4 years in a leadership role.
* Strong hands\-on experience managing Shopify — this is mandatory.
* Proven experience owning a D2C P\&L of ₹10 Cr\+ — with full ownership of revenue, contribution margin, and profitability.
* Strong understanding of Meta Ads, Google Ads, GA4, CRM, SEO, CRO, and digital marketing.
* Hands\-on experience with retention/CRM — email, WhatsApp, SMS, loyalty programs, and marketing automation.

* Lead the D2C growth of a conscious, sustainable footwear brand.

* Work at the intersection of sustainability, technology, and consumer fashion.

title: Entrepreneur-in-Residence (EIR)
description:
We are hiring Entrepreneurs\-in\-Residence (EIRs) to build new businesses from zero inside MedhaviOne. Each EIR reports to the Founders and owns one mandate end to end.
 



  





**Why Now?**




  





 Higher education is being rebuilt, and the people who build it now will shape the sector for decades.
 



 ·      Degrees are giving way to skills.
 



 ·      Classroom\-only learning is giving way to work\-integrated learning.
 



 ·      One\-size\-fits\-all programmes are giving way to new models designed with employers.
 



  





 For years, the strongest graduates from top institutes walked past education. That is changing. The capital, talent and ambition now entering the sector mean it is moving fast.
 



  





 This role is a 2–3 year founder apprenticeship, fully paid. You build a real business, with our partner network and university behind you.
 



  





**(I) EIR, Enterprise Growth**



* **What you build \-** 
 Go\-to\-market, sales motion, and thought leadership for MedhaviOne Enterprise, serving employers and industries that need job\-ready talent
* **Where it can lead \-** 
 Growth Head, then Business Head for the portfolio
* **Best\-fit background \-** 
 B2B marketing or growth in SaaS or AI companies



  





**(II) EIR, New Learning Brand**



* **What you build \-** 
 A curated online marketplace of high\-value, work\-integrated upskilling and reskilling programmes, co\-developed with premier institutes and universities
* **Where it can lead \-** 
 Category Head, then Business Head for the portfolio
* **Best\-fit background \-** 
 Growth, category or programme roles at leading EdTech platforms



  





**What will you do?**




  





 In both mandates, you run the business as its founder.
 



  




* Own everything: proposition, academic framework, industry links, acquisition and outcomes.
* Write the plan, set the targets and own the results.
* Pull in marketing, technology, academic and partnerships teams to get things done.
* Build a lean team as the business proves itself.
* Put plans on a page: numbers first, with the insight beside them.



  





**Who we are looking for?**




  





**Must have** 




  




* A degree from an IIT, IIM or other top\-tier institute, or a track record that speaks just as loudly.
* 2–5 years of work experience.
* Something you built from scratch, and can show.
* A minimum commitment to 2–3 years of hands\-on building with us.
* Clear, sharp writing. Your application is the first test.



  





**Good to have** 




  




* For Enterprise Growth: B2B marketing or growth experience in SaaS or AI.
* For New Learning Brand: EdTech experience or new\-age education businesses.
* For both: Experience running a P\&L, or part of one.



  





**How you work?**




  




* **Hungry.** 
 You want the hard problem, more than the title.
* **Owner.** 
 If it reaches the Founders, you have already checked it.
* **Detail\-driven.** 
 You meet deadlines, and flag early when you cannot.
* **Proud of your work.** 
 You build things and businesses you would put your name on.
* **Thick\-skinned.** 
 The mandate will change as we learn, and you adapt.



  





**What you get**




  




* **A business to build, not a project to support.** 
 You own the outcome from day one.
* **Scale from the start.** 
 You work with 600\+ enterprise partners and a university campus.
* **Direct access.** 
 You work alongside the Founders and the leadership team.
* **A growth path.** 
 EIRs typically move into Growth Head, Category Head / Business Head roles
* **A launchpad.** 
 After 2–3 years, grow with us, or go build your own company in this space.



  





**How to apply**




  





 All applicants are required to complete the application form below. The 150\-word application response will be collected
 



 as part of the form and is mandatory for consideration. Apply Here:
 **MedhaviOne – Candidate Assessment (** 
 https://forms.gle/jisEJHm4AKkWkJsT7
 **)** 




  





**Please note:** 
 The application form and the relevant 150\-word response are mandatory to proceed to the next stage of
 



 the selection process. Please do not email your application separately.
 



  





**About MedhaviOne**




  





 MedhaviOne is building India's education\-to\-employment infrastructure: shared standards for skills and credentials that connect institutions, employers and learners.
 



  





 We are not an early\-stage startup. The Medhavi Group already has:
 



  




* 600\+ enterprise partners across 30\+ sectors, including Hyundai, Mahindra, MRF, Daikin, IHG Hotels and the Indian Navy; 650,000\+ learners reached across India
* Its own skills university, Medhavi Skills University, with close to 2,000 students on campus



  





 The base is built. We now need people to build the next businesses on top of it.
 



 For more information, visit https://www.medhavione.com/
 



  





**About Medhavi Group**




  





 Established in 2013, Medhavi Group is a unified ecosystem comprising MSU and various skill\-promoting organisations, dedicated to advancing skill development, vocational training, and industry\-integrated higher education. having trained
 **6\+ lakh learners** 
 with
 **70%\+ employability outcomes** 
 and supporting
 **20,000\+ active students** 
 .
 



  
 


* **WISE (Work Integrated Skill\-based Higher Education)** 
 is Medhavi’s flagship initiative, built on the principle of
 **“Industry on Campus”** 
 , combining academic learning with structured on\-the\-job training.
* Through partnerships with
 **300\+ leading organisations across 26\+ sectors** 
 , including Hyundai, Mahindra, IHG Group, Marriott, ITC and Tata Electronics, WISE builds industry\-aligned talent pipelines.
* WISE enables students to graduate with
 **real work experience and industry\-ready skills** 
 , enhancing employability, workforce productivity, and bridging the industry skill gap.



  
 



  





 For more information, visit https://msu.edu.in/wise/

title: Founders’ Office
description:
**Founder's Office \| Growth Valley Community** 




 Gurugram (in\-office) \| Full\-time \| 1\-5 years experience \| Reports directly to the Founder
 



  





 Tier One IIT/IIM Preferred or tier one preferred.
 



  





**Do not apply if you are looking for structured job with work life balance. Apply if you are mentally young, want to prove to yourself, want to grow and behave like growth. A consistent growth story will be awarded.** 




  





**We are looking forward to growth focussed team members, who just are obsessed about making things bigger and better for themselves and people around them. And that MUST reflect in their past journey. You will thoroughly fail in our environment if you are looking for a generic job/work life balance/ multi focus life.** 




  





**We are fanatic about what we do. What we are building. It takes intent and energy. It takes time. It takes focus. If you are one already, it could be one of the best place to work together and building something big and beautiful for the world.** 




  





**About GVC.** 




  





 Growth Valley Community is a global entrepreneurship programme where teenagers build real ventures: real inventory, real customers, real profit and loss. Our students run live businesses through TecTeenShop and are mentored by professionals and alumni from Harvard, MIT, Stanford and Columbia, supported by IITians. Today we stand at 1000\+ students across 12 countries with roughly 95% retention, which is among the hardest numbers to earn in education.
 



  





 Product\-market fit is proven. Parents renew, students stay, and the transformation is visible in the room. What we have not yet built at scale is distribution: the systems, partnerships and engines that take this from X students to 100X. That is the frontier, and that is exactly where this role operates.
 



  





**The role.** 




  





 You sit beside the founder and function as a force multiplier. Not an assistant, not an analyst producing decks for other people to act on. You take a mandate, own it end to end, and leave behind a running system. You will be in rooms most people wait years to enter: pricing calls, investor material reviews, partnership negotiations, hiring decisions. The compensation for that access is simple: everything you touch must move.
 



  





 This is the highest\-leverage seat in the company for someone who wants to compress five years of operator learning into one.
 



  





**What you will actually own. These are live mandates, not hypotheticals:** 




  




* **Enrollment engine.** 
 Our enrollment function is being rebuilt from the ground up as a system: one shared pipeline, a daily operating cadence, written playbooks, zero dependence on any single person. You will build and run it, starting with the fastest lever we own, a referral programme into our 100s of existing families.



  




* **Admissions product.** 
 We have designed a full admission journey (application, staged review, live status tracking, WhatsApp and email automation on an Airtable backbone). You will take it from tested prototype to daily operations.



  




* **AI Founder Programme, Cohort 1\.** 
 A new one\-year product where teens ship their own live AI product and present it at a Demo Day. You will run the launch: offer page, Founders Session event, application funnel, squad operations.



  




* **Partnerships.** 
 Scout and open school and institutional relationships that compound, so demand stops being bought lead by lead.



  




* **The numbers.** 
 Own the dashboards the founder runs the company on, and help prepare the materials investors see.



  





**How we will measure you.** 




 Your first 90 days are pass or fail on outcomes, not activity. Concretely: a pipeline running that did not exist, a referral programme live, an admissions system operating on SLAs, a cohort launch executed. You will know exactly what winning looks like from week one, because we will write it down together.
 



  





**Who fits.** 



* Tier\-1 institute background (IIT, IIM, BITS, top DU or equivalent), or proof of building so undeniable that pedigree is irrelevant.
* 1\-3 years in a startup operating role, or in consulting/banking with a genuine itch to build rather than advise.
* Bias to action. You default to shipping a rough version today over presenting a perfect plan next week.
* Comfort with ambiguity. Priorities shift, playbooks do not exist yet, and you find that energising rather than stressful.
* High integrity. We sell trust to parents of teenagers. There is no version of this company where cut corners survive.
* Skill gaps we can fix. Will gaps we cannot.



  





**Who should not apply.** 




  





 If you want a defined lane, a structured mentorship ramp, a large team around you, or advisory distance from the actual work, this role will genuinely frustrate you, and you will frustrate us. We are building 1 to 10 in a company where speed matters. It is intense and demanding. The honest trade: the learning curve is the compensation multiplier, and the people who thrive here would be bored anywhere else.
 



  





**Compensation.**

title: GTM Lead - B2B
description:
**Company Description:** 




 Sneakare is a New Delhi\-based, fastest\-growing sneaker care brand, built for people who genuinely love what they are wearing on their feet. We market premium, no\-nonsense products — cleaning kits, insoles, suede care, and storage solutions — designed to help sneaker fans protect what they paid for and wear what they love, longer. We started small, made it to Shark Tank India, and haven't slowed down since. Our team is young, fast\-moving, and obsessed with getting things right — whether that's a product formula, a listing copy, or a customer interaction. We care about quality over shortcuts, ownership over excuses, and learning over ego.
 



  





**Job Overview:** 




 We're looking for an experienced GTM Lead to build and own Sneakare's B2B business, largely from scratch. The mandate starts with two known pillars — brand collaborations and corporate gifting — and extends to identifying and standing up whatever other B2B channels make sense for the brand (distribution/wholesale, hospitality, institutional bulk orders, etc.). This is a strategy\-plus\-execution role: you'll define the B2B GTM plan with the Founder, then build and run the pipeline yourself in the early stages.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**1\.  Corporate Gifting:** 




 • Build a pipeline of corporate clients (HR/admin/procurement teams) for bulk/festive/onboarding gifting orders
 



 • Own pricing, packaging, and proposal templates for corporate orders, including customization options
 



 • Manage the deal cycle from pitch to contract to delivery, coordinating with ops/warehouse on fulfillment timelines
 



 • Build repeat relationships aimed at annual/recurring gifting contracts rather than one\-off orders
 



  





**2\. Brand Collaborations:** 




 • Identify and pitch co\-branded product or campaign opportunities with complementary brands
 



 • Negotiate collaboration terms (commercials, exclusivity, timelines) and manage the partnership through to launch
 



 • Work with marketing/product on execution — packaging, launch content, and joint promotion
 



  





**3\. New B2B Channels (Build\-Out):** 




 • Scope and validate additional B2B revenue channels — e.g. distributor/wholesale partnerships, hotel/airline amenity kits, event and gifting agencies, marketplace B2B — and bring recommendations to the Founder
 



 • Pilot one or two of these channels, defining what a repeatable sales motion looks like before scaling
 



 • Build the playbook (pricing, pitch, process) for each channel you stand up, so it can eventually be handed off or scaled
 



  





**4\. Pipeline, Deal Cycle \& Reporting:** 




 • Own the full deal cycle — prospecting, pitching, negotiation, contracting, and post\-sale account management
 



 • Maintain a live pipeline/CRM view of leads, deal stage, and expected revenue
 



 • Track B2B revenue against targets and report performance regularly to the Founder and leadership
 



  





**5\. Marketing \& Representation:** 




 • Work with marketing to build B2B collateral — decks, case studies, one\-pagers — that support the sales pitch
 



 • Represent Sneakare at industry events, expos, and networking forums to build pipeline and brand visibility in the B2B space
 



  





**What Success Looks Like (First 6\-12 Months):** 




 • A qualified, trackable B2B pipeline exists (not just informal conversations) with clear deal stages and expected value
 



 • Corporate gifting is generating consistent month\-on\-month revenue, with at least a few clients converted to repeat/annual contracts
 



 • At least one brand collaboration has been pitched, negotiated, and launched
 



 • A recommendation (backed by a small pilot) exists for at least one new B2B channel beyond gifting and collabs
 



 • Leadership has a regular, reliable view of B2B revenue and pipeline health
 








**Requirements:** 




 • 6\-8 years of experience in B2B sales, corporate gifting, partnerships, or key account management
 



 • Proven track record of building a pipeline from scratch and closing corporate/B2B deals
 



 • Experience in a D2C, FMCG, or lifestyle brand background preferred
 



 • Strong negotiation, relationship\-building, and stakeholder management skills
 



 • Excellent communication and presentation skills — comfortable pitching to corporate and institutional buyers
 



 • Entrepreneurial mindset — comfortable building a vertical largely from scratch with limited existing playbook, and turning ambiguity into a structured plan
 



 • Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, ambiguous startup environment
 



  





**Experience:** 
 6\-8 years
 



**Location:** 
 Kirti Nagar, Delhi (Onsite)
 



**Department:** 
 B2B / Business Development
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**CTC:** 
 Up to 12 LPA

title: Email Marketing & CRM Specialist
description:

**Reports to:** 
 CRM / Lifecycle lead (US)
 



**Team:** 
 Works day to day with the US CRM, creative, and ecommerce teams
 



**Location:** 
 Gurugram, India office — in office, on a shift aligned to US business hours
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**About the Role** 




 You build and send the email and SMS that drive our DTC revenue. Pro Standard sells licensed sports apparel direct to consumer across the US, Mexico, Canada, and the UK, and this role is the hands\-on engine of our lifecycle program — building campaigns and flows in Klaviyo, loading them, testing them, and getting them out on time and error\-free.
 



 You work closely with our US CRM and creative teams, so your hours align with the US business day. And we move at the speed of sport — when a moment hits, the email has to go out fast and clean. This is a detail\-obsessed, in\-the\-platform role for someone who takes pride in flawless sends.
 



**What You'll Own** 



* **Campaign builds.** 
 Build, QA, and schedule email and SMS campaigns in Klaviyo — segments, content blocks, links, and dynamic product feeds.
* **Lifecycle flows.** 
 Build and maintain flows to brief — welcome, abandonment, post\-purchase, win\-back, browse — and keep them current, not stale.
* **Segmentation.** 
 Build and manage segments and lists, and keep suppression and list hygiene clean.
* **QA \& deliverability.** 
 Test every send — links, rendering, personalization, product feeds — before it goes, and help keep the list healthy and inboxing.
* **Calendar execution.** 
 Turn the CRM calendar into scheduled, on\-time sends, and turn reactive sports moments around fast.
* **Reporting.** 
 Pull campaign and flow performance and flag what's working and what isn't.
* **Multi\-market support.** 
 Support US, Canada, and UK email and SMS, and Mexico email (Mexico is email\-only, no SMS).
* **AI\-assisted execution.** 
 Use our AI tools to speed up building, QA, and reporting.



**What Great Looks Like** 



* Sends go out on time, every time, error\-free — right links, right products, right segment.
* Flows are live and optimized, never stale.
* The list stays healthy — strong deliverability, low complaints.
* Reactive sports moments turn around fast and clean.
* More of the routine build and QA is handled with AI each month.



**What We're Looking For** 



* 3\+ years hands\-on in email/CRM marketing, ideally for a DTC ecommerce brand.
* Hands\-on Klaviyo (or a similar ESP) — you build campaigns, flows, and segments yourself.
* Sharp attention to detail — you catch the broken link, the wrong product, the bad merge tag before it sends.
* Comfort with data and reporting.
* Strong written English.
* Able to work a US\-aligned shift from our Gurugram office.
* AI\-savvy and eager to automate routine build and QA work.

 Write openings that earn attention and posts that deliver on them. Preserve different voices across profiles, rather than making everyone sound like the same creator.
 



 Review audience response and use it to improve future content. You’ll also handle basic publishing, comment replies and performance reporting for InboxKit’s company social accounts.
 



 This is a secondary responsibility. LinkedIn strategy and ghostwriting are the core of the role.
 



  





**What you should bring** 




 A portfolio of LinkedIn posts you’ve ghostwritten for other people.
 



 Excellent writing and editing, including the ability to make a draft sharper without making it sound unlike its author.
 



 Strong content fundamentals: audience understanding, attention, structure, storytelling and a clear point of view.
 



 The ability to explain your writing decisions beyond “it has a good hook” or “it’s relatable.” Enough curiosity to understand someone’s work and ask questions that uncover something worth saying. Experience writing for B2B founders, SaaS companies or people in the email marketing space is a plus.
 



 Our approach to AI AI\-assisted work is fine. You must be able to develop ideas, write and edit independently.
 



 The finished post should sound like the person behind it, with specific insights and natural language. Generic AI copy will not meet the standard. About InboxKit InboxKit is a cold email infrastructure platform for agencies, sales teams and outbound\-focused businesses.
 



  





 How to apply Send your resume, LinkedIn profile and portfolio to
 **Hiring@inboxkit.com** 
 , with
 **Ashmeet@inboxkit.com** 
 in CC. Your portfolio must include LinkedIn ghostwriting samples. Briefly explain your contribution to the work. If a client’s identity is confidential, anonymised samples you have permission to share are welcome.

description:

 **Google Ads \& Performance Marketing Manager**

 This is
 **not a campaign\-execution\-only role** 
 .
   

  

 We are looking for someone who understands performance marketing as a
 **revenue and growth function**

 The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience scaling
 **D2C or e\-commerce brands through Google Ads** 
 , managing significant advertising budgets and improving key business metrics such as
 **CAC, ROAS, revenue and profitability** 
 .
   

  

 Key ResponsibilitiesGoogle Ads \& Paid Acquisition
   

  

* Own the end\-to\-end Google Ads strategy for the brand.
* Plan, launch, manage and optimize Google Search, Shopping and Performance Max campaigns.

* Develop strategies for customer acquisition and revenue growth.
* Scale advertising spend while maintaining healthy CAC, ROAS and profitability.
* Identify new opportunities across products, audiences, geographies and campaigns.

 Google Shopping \& Performance Max

 Tracking \& Analytics

* Monitor tracking across Google Ads, Shopify, website and CRM.
* Identify and resolve discrepancies between advertising platforms and actual business revenue.
* Maintain accurate UTM and conversion tracking structures.

 D2C Growth \& Revenue
   

  

* Optimize campaigns based on business metrics rather than vanity metrics.

 Creative \& CRO

 Reporting

**Required Experience**

* Proven experience managing Google Ads for D2C or e\-commerce brands.
* Experience managing significant monthly advertising budgets.
* Proven track record of scaling Google Ads campaigns.

* Attribution

* Data Analysis

 Key Performance Metrics
   

  

**Success In This Role Will Be Measured Through**
* Revenue generated through Google Ads
* CAC / CPA
* ROAS
* MER
* Advertising spend scale
* Conversion rate
* Average Order Value (AOV)
* New customer acquisition
* Customer acquisition cost
* Profitability / contribution margin
* Tracking and attribution accuracy

 Ideal Candidate
   

  

 We are looking for someone who thinks like a

 , not just a Google Ads operator.

 You own the
 **paid acquisition number**

title: Social Media Executive
description:
JOB TITLE
 



 Social Media Executive
 



  





 COMPANY
 



 BoxFit Studios LLP
 



  





 WORKPLACE TYPE
 



 On\-site
 



  





 LOCATION
 



 New Delhi, Delhi, India
 



  





 EMPLOYMENT TYPE
 



 Full\-time
 



  





 EXPERIENCE LEVEL
 



 Associate
 



  





 SALARY
 




 ₹ 35,000 Per month
 




  





 APPLY METHOD
 



 Link: https://airtable.com/app3TzSzlPBT1pX8O/pagEjtWYG1eVEvayr/form
 



  





 JOB DESCRIPTION
 



  





 🥊 BoxFit is hiring a Social Media Executive who lives behind the camera.
 



  





 Before anything else, read this:
 



 This is a hands\-on SHOOTING role. You will be on the studio floor 5 days a week, phone in hand, filming classes, coaches, members and events. Then editing it the same day. If you prefer planning from a desk, or aren't comfortable filming people and talking to them, this role is not for you. Please don't apply.
 



  





 About the role
 



 You'll run BoxFit's Instagram and YouTube end to end. Shoot it, edit it, post it, track it, repeat. You'll work directly with our Head of Social Media and be part of a small team where your work goes live every single day.
 



  





 What you'll do every day
 



 ✅ Shoot Reels, Stories and BTS at our South Delhi studios (GK, Defence Colony, Vasant Vihar)
 



 ✅ Direct coaches and members on camera, brief them, make them comfortable, get the take
 



 ✅ Edit fast on VN / CapCut / InShot (Premiere Pro is a bonus)
 



 ✅ Post daily Reels and Stories, reply to comments in the brand voice
 



 ✅ Write hooks, captions and scripts that stop the scroll
 



 ✅ Plan shoots, coordinate with coaches, keep the content calendar moving
 



 ✅ Cover events, challenges and community days
 



 ✅ Run influencer and creator collaborations
 



 ✅ Use AI tools (ChatGPT, Gemini) to work faster and smarter
 



 ✅ Track what works, drop what doesn't
 



  





 You're a fit if
 



 ✅ You have 1 to 2 years of experience shooting and editing short\-form video (freelance counts)
 



 ✅ You're based in Delhi, ideally South Delhi, and can commute to our studios daily
 



 ✅ You speak and write English confidently. You'll be talking to our members, coaches and premium clients all day
 



 ✅ You're comfortable approaching people with a camera
 



 ✅ You can show us Reels you've actually made
 



  





 Perks
 



 🎟️ Free BoxFit membership
 



 🎯 Your office is a working fitness studio, not a co\-working space
 



 🤖 Paid AI tools
 



 🚀 Small team, real ownership, your work goes live daily
 



  





 Logistics
 



 📍 South Delhi studios
 



 📆 Monday to Saturday, 10 AM to 7 PM (5 days studio \+ 1 day WFH)
 



 💰 ₹4,20,000/\-
 



 ⏳ 3 months probation, then full\-time
 



  





 Apply through the form. Include a link to your best Reel. No Reel link, no review.
 



  





 SKILLS
 



 Video Editing, Videography, Content Creation, Instagram Marketing, Social Media Marketing, Short\-Form Video, CapCut, Copywriting, Influencer Marketing, Canva
 



  





 ABOUT THE COMPANY
 



 BoxFit is fitness made fun.
 



  





 We're a boxing\-led boutique fitness brand with three studios across South Delhi: GK, Defence Colony and Vasant Vihar. Our sessions mix boxing, strength and HIIT into high\-energy group workouts that burn up to 1000 calories and don't feel like a workout at all. Loud music, great coaches, real sweat, and a lot of laughing mid\-round.
 



  





 We don't sell workouts. We sell confidence, stress relief and a community people genuinely look forward to coming back to. Get fit. Lose weight. Beat stress. Have fun.
 



  





 What makes us different
 



 ✅ Coaching, not counting. Every class gets PT\-level attention and a booked spot that's truly yours
 



 ✅ Never boring. New formats, themed classes and challenges all year round
 



 ✅ Events people talk about. From Bass \& Burn nights with a live DJ to the BoxFit Games, raffle challenges and community days, we build experiences, not just classes
 



 ✅ A community that sticks. Our members stay for the people as much as the results
 



 ✅ Personal training in studio and online, for members in Delhi and around the world
 



  





 Content is at the heart of it
 



 BoxFit is as much a content brand as a fitness brand. Our studios are our sets. Our coaches and members are our stars. Every day we shoot, edit and publish Reels, Stories and YouTube content that shows what fitness looks like when it's actually fun, and we collaborate with creators who share that energy.

description:

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for a data\-driven, growth\-oriented App Performance Marketing Professional with 3 to 4 years of hands\-on experience in driving paid user acquisition, app installs, and in\-app retention for scaling D2C brands.
   

  

 In this role, you will own paid marketing budgets across app acquisition networks, optimize customer acquisition cost (CAC), scale return on ad spend (ROAS), and improve bottom\-of\-the\-funnel app conversions. You will bridge performance media buying with product analytics, working closely with creative, retention, and e\-commerce tech teams.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* App Acquisition \& Paid Media Execution
* Campaign Management: Plan, launch, scale, and optimize end\-to\-end paid app acquisition campaigns across channels including Meta Ads (App Install Campaigns), Google App Campaigns (UAC), Apple Search Ads (ASA), TikTok/Snapchat, and programmatic/affiliate DSPs.
* Funnel Optimization: Track and optimize key app performance metrics: Cost Per Install (CPI), Cost Per Acquisition/First Purchase (CPA/CAC), Return on Ad Spend (ROAS), Customer Lifetime Value (LTV), Retention (D1/D7/D30\), and Average Order Value (AOV).
* Budget Management: Allocate and manage monthly/quarterly marketing budgets effectively across acquisition and retargeting channels to drive scalable growth.
* Attribution, Tracking \& Deep Linking
* MMP Integration: Own configuration, event tracking, and attribution modeling via Mobile Measurement Partners (MMPs) like AppsFlyer, Adjust, or Branch.
* In\-App Analytics: Measure post\-install behavior, cohort retention, drop\-offs, and custom event funnels (e.g., install $ ightarrow$ registration $ ightarrow$ add\-to\-cart $ ightarrow$ checkout) using Mixpanel, CleverTap, MoEngage, or GA4\.
* SKAdNetwork \& Privacy Compliance: Maintain tracking accuracy and attribution setup under iOS SKAdNetwork (SKAN 4\.0\+) and Android Privacy Sandbox constraints.
* App Store Optimization (ASO) \& Creative Strategy
* ASO Execution: Drive organic app downloads by optimizing App Store (iOS) and Google Play Store listings through keyword research, localized screenshots, app preview videos, and A/B testing store listings.
* Creative Testing Framework: Partner with in\-house or agency creative teams to build high\-converting mobile\-first ad concepts (UGC, dynamic product ads, short\-form video) and run structured creative testing cycles.
* Re\-engagement \& Retention Alignment
* App Retargeting: Execute paid re\-engagement and dynamic retargeting campaigns (e.g., Criteo, Meta Dynamic Ads, RTB House) for lapsed users and abandoned carts.
* Cross\-Functional Synergy: Collaborate with Retention/CRM teams (Push Notifications, SMS, WhatsApp) to suppress recent buyers and maximize incremental ROAS.


**Requirements \& Qualifications**
* Experience: 3–4 years of dedicated experience in digital/performance marketing, with at least 2 years focused on mobile app acquisition and scaling D2C/e\-commerce brands.
* Core Technical Stack:
+ Paid Channels: Hands\-on experience with Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads (UAC), Apple Search Ads.
+ MMPs: AppsFlyer, Adjust, or Branch.
+ Analytics \& BI: GA4, Mixpanel, Amplitude, or Tableau/Looker Studio.
+ E\-Commerce Platforms: Familiarity with Shopify, Magento, or WooCommerce infrastructure.

* Analytical Capability: High proficiency in data analysis, cohort analysis, pivot tables, and multi\-touch attribution modeling.
* Mindset: Experiment\-driven approach with a clear methodology for hypothesis testing, A/B testing ad creatives, landing/in\-app pages, and custom audiences.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Prior experience with an established fast\-growing D2C startup in Fashion, Beauty, FMCG, Health \& Wellness, or Consumer Electronics.
* Certifications in Google Ads, Meta Blueprint, or MMP Platforms.
* Basic understanding of SQL or BI dashboarding tools.

title: Social Media Strategist
description:
Role Overview
 
 As a
 **Social Media Strategist** 
 , you will be responsible for developing social media strategies and content directions for brands and campaigns.
 



 You will work closely with the Strategy, Creative, Influencer Marketing, Planning, and Revenue teams to develop ideas that are
 **platform\-native, culturally relevant, creator\-friendly, and aligned with brand objectives** 
 .
 



 The ideal candidate is someone who spends a lot of time understanding social media, follows emerging trends closely, knows why certain content works, and can translate those observations into actionable strategies.
 



 This role requires a combination of
 **strategic thinking, cultural understanding, content expertise, platform knowledge, and strong execution skills** 
 .
 



  





  




 Key Responsibilities1\. Social Media Strategy
 * Develop comprehensive social media strategies based on brand objectives, target audiences, category dynamics, and platform behaviour.
* Translate business and communication objectives into clear social media strategies.
* Define the role of different social platforms within a campaign or brand ecosystem.
* Develop content pillars, themes, formats, and communication territories.
* Build social strategies for launches, campaigns, always\-on communication, and influencer\-led initiatives.
* Identify opportunities to make brand communication more relevant to current social conversations and cultural moments.
* Develop platform\-specific approaches rather than applying the same content strategy across all platforms.



  





  




 2\. Content Strategy \& Ideation
 * Develop content ideas that are relevant, engaging, and aligned with the brand's positioning.
* Create content frameworks and creative territories for social platforms.
* Develop campaign concepts that can be translated into creator\-led and social\-first content.
* Work closely with creative teams to convert strategic thinking into strong content ideas.
* Develop hooks, content angles, storytelling approaches, and formats for different platforms.
* Identify opportunities for short\-form video, reels, carousels, stories, memes, creator content, and other emerging formats.
* Ensure ideas are both strategically relevant and realistically executable.



  





  




 3\. Social \& Cultural Trends
 * Stay highly updated on Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, and other relevant platforms.
* Track emerging formats, memes, trends, creators, communities, conversations, and cultural moments.
* Identify trends that can be meaningfully connected to brands.
* Distinguish between short\-lived trends and trends with genuine strategic relevance.
* Build regular trend reports or trend\-led recommendations for internal and client teams.
* Identify opportunities for brands to participate in relevant conversations without appearing forced or disconnected.
* Maintain a strong understanding of changing social\-media behaviour and audience preferences.



  





  




 4\. Influencer \& Creator Strategy
 * Develop influencer strategies aligned with the overall social media and communication strategy.
* Recommend creator profiles based on audience, content style, credibility, relevance, and campaign objectives.
* Define the role creators should play within a campaign.
* Develop creator content directions, storytelling frameworks, and content territories.
* Identify opportunities for creators to create content that feels native to their communities rather than overly branded.
* Collaborate with Planning and Talent Management teams to identify relevant creators.
* Provide clear strategic direction to creators while allowing sufficient creative freedom.
* Evaluate creator content from a strategic and brand perspective.



  





  




 5\. Campaign Strategy
 * Develop strategic frameworks for influencer and social media campaigns.
* Understand the campaign brief and identify the core communication challenge.
* Define the campaign thought, communication territory, audience insight, and content approach.
* Develop campaign narratives that can be executed across multiple creators and platforms.
* Build campaign journeys from awareness to engagement and action where relevant.
* Develop strategic presentations and campaign proposals for internal and client\-facing discussions.
* Participate in brainstorming sessions and contribute strategic and creative thinking.
* Ensure campaign ideas are differentiated, relevant, and aligned with the brand.



  





  




 6\. Social Listening \& Audience Insights
 * Monitor social conversations and audience behaviour around relevant categories and brands.
* Identify audience pain points, interests, behaviours, and content preferences.
* Conduct social listening and competitor analysis.
* Identify gaps and opportunities in the brand's current social presence.
* Track competitor campaigns, creator partnerships, content formats, and communication approaches.
* Convert observations into actionable insights and recommendations.
* Use social and audience insights to continuously improve content strategy.

title: Manager - CRM & Marketing Technology
description:
**Manager, CRM \& Marketing Technology** 




  





**Location:** 
 Gurgaon, Haryana, India
 



**Experience:** 
 10–12 years of relevant experience preferred
 



  





**About the Company** 




 Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global consulting firm known for entrepreneurial, action\-oriented and results\-focused professionals. The firm takes a hands\-on approach to solving client problems and helping organizations reach their potential. Its culture values independent thinkers and doers who create meaningful client and industry impact. A\&M operates with a commitment to Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward and Inclusive Diversity. In 2023, A\&M established a Global Capability Center in India to expand specialized talent, accelerate delivery, maintain competitive pricing and enable automation through digital and analytics capabilities. The Gurgaon\-based center partners with global business units and case teams across the Americas, EMEA and APAC. Unlike traditional back\-office models, it contributes to end\-to\-end case delivery and thought leadership across industries including Consumer \& Retail, Healthcare, Software \& Technology, Automotive \& Industrials, Hospitality \& Leisure, Energy \& Natural Resources and Financial Services. The GCC is growing rapidly and already has more than 1,000 members.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 This role owns the CRM and Marketing Technologies strategy and roadmap for A\&M’s growing India Global Capability Center. Reporting to the CRM and Marketing Technologies Director, you will translate marketing priorities into scalable technology capabilities, operating models and delivery plans. The position is accountable for orchestrating projects and initiatives across CRM, marketing automation, analytics, AI and broader MarTech ecosystems. Success requires strong MarTech/CRM expertise, marketing business and technology transformation experience, and proven project, change and stakeholder management. You will connect Marketing, IT, data teams and business units to improve integration, data quality, channel execution and decision\-making. The role combines strategic planning with hands\-on execution, ensuring solutions are fit for purpose, adopted by users and aligned with compliance expectations. You will also act as a trusted subject matter expert, shaping investment choices and recommending innovations that improve marketing effectiveness, operational efficiency and measurable business outcomes.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own the CRM and MarTech strategy and roadmap, converting marketing objectives into sequenced initiatives, investment priorities and capabilities that improve campaign effectiveness, operational efficiency and stakeholder outcomes.
* Lead delivery of CRM, marketing automation, analytics, AI and channel technology projects through structured governance, milestones, risk controls and benefits tracking that keep transformation initiatives on schedule.
* Translate business requirements into technical capabilities, solution designs and prioritized backlogs, ensuring platforms and processes support scalable, compliant and measurable multi\-channel marketing execution.
* Partner with data teams to improve infrastructure, data quality and integration across databases and MarTech components, enabling reliable customer insights, segmentation, activation and reporting.
* Establish and improve marketing operating models, processes and organization structures through technology\-enabled transformation, clarifying ownership and increasing consistency across business units and geographies.
* Analyze marketing performance data and convert findings into improvement initiatives, recommendations and executive\-ready insights that strengthen strategy, resource allocation and business decision\-making.
* Manage stakeholder alignment across Marketing, IT, data teams, business units and vendors, resolving dependencies and building credibility through clear communication, negotiation and outcome\-focused governance.
* Monitor MarTech trends, compliance requirements and vendor capabilities, recommending innovations and managing integrations that improve effectiveness while addressing customer\-data obligations such as GDPR and CCPA.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Strong expertise across CRM, marketing automation, MarTech platforms, channels, AI and analytics tools, with the ability to connect business requirements to practical technical functionality and integrated solutions.
* Demonstrated marketing business and technology transformation experience, including operating\-model design, process improvement, product or project delivery and adoption of new capabilities across matrixed organizations.
* Advanced project, change and stakeholder management skills, supported by analytical thinking, vendor negotiation, troubleshooting, executive communication and customer\-data compliance awareness.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* PMP, CPM or comparable project and product management certification is an advantage, particularly where it demonstrates disciplined delivery, governance and benefits realization across complex transformation programs.
* Experience working with global marketing organizations, distributed stakeholders and cross\-regional CRM initiatives is beneficial, especially within consulting, professional services or other matrixed environments.
* Exposure to emerging MarTech, AI, analytics and automation trends is valuable when paired with sound judgment about adoption, integration effort, governance and measurable business impact.



  





**What You'll Bring** 




 You bring 10–12 years of relevant experience managing marketing technology platforms and systems, with total professional experience typically ranging from 10 to 15 years. Your background demonstrates strong MarTech and CRM expertise, combined with marketing business and technology transformation experience. You have led complex projects or products from strategy through implementation, using structured governance, change management and stakeholder alignment to deliver adoption and measurable results. You understand how Marketing organizations operate, how processes and operating models shape performance, and how technical capabilities can solve business priorities. You are comfortable working across CRM, marketing automation, analytics, AI, channels, data infrastructure and platform integrations. You use data to diagnose performance, shape recommendations and guide decisions. You can negotiate with vendors, troubleshoot issues, manage deadlines and communicate clearly with senior stakeholders and delivery teams. You understand customer\-data compliance considerations, including GDPR and CCPA, and can operate effectively in a matrix environment. A bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Technology, Business Administration or a related field is required. You are organized, detail\-oriented, credible, collaborative and accountable for outcomes rather than activity.
 



  





**Why Join Us** 




 At A\&M, you will own technology\-enabled marketing transformation within a rapidly growing Global Capability Center that works directly with global business units and case teams. Your decisions will influence how CRM, MarTech, data and automation capabilities scale across major markets and industries. The role offers the opportunity to shape strategy and roadmap while remaining close to implementation, adoption and measurable business impact. You will work alongside experienced consultants, technologists, data professionals and leaders across the Americas, EMEA and APAC, gaining exposure to complex operating models and diverse client environments. A\&M’s entrepreneurial culture rewards independent thinking, practical problem\-solving and professionals who create visible results. The organization supports continuous learning through formal training, on\-the\-job development and performance conversations that recognize contribution and encourage progression. You will join a center that is expanding its capabilities, strengthening its global delivery model and investing in specialized talent. This is an opportunity to build enduring platforms, improve how marketing operates and grow as a transformation leader in a collaborative, inclusive environment.
 



  





**What We Offer** 



* A\&M supports continuous professional development through structured performance conversations, formal training and on\-the\-job learning that help employees build capabilities and progress through a meritocratic environment.
* Employees receive resources and support focused on personal well\-being, enabling sustainable performance while contributing to meaningful work in a collaborative and inclusive culture.
* The role offers exposure to global markets, senior stakeholders, multiple industries and cross\-functional transformation initiatives within a rapidly growing India Global Capability Center.
