title: Content Marketing Associate
description:
At Aftershoot, we’re building a global community of photographers who spend less time behind their screens and more time behind the lens. Every feature we create, every update we ship, is designed to make post\-processing easier, faster, and smarter for photographers around the world.
   

  

 From culling to editing to retouching. Our AI tools do all the heavy lifting, so photographers can focus on what they do best: capturing moments, telling stories, and creating magic.
   

  

 We’re a fast\-growing, passionate team backed over 100K\+ active users globally. Double\-digit ARR in less than 4 years, amazing investors and team who truly believe in our mission.
   

  

 Our mission is clear: Become the default companion for every photographer in the world.
   

  

 If you care deeply about building meaningful products, working with curious and driven teammates, and being part of a team that genuinely loves what they do, we’d love to meet you.
   

  

 Let’s create the future of AI in photography, together.
   

  

 🚀
 **Your Mission:**
 Aftershoot is a leading AI\-powered post\-production software company with over 200,000 users and tens of thousands of customers. We are looking for a Content Writer to join our dynamic marketing team. As a Content Marketing Manager, you'll be responsible for executing the company's content strategy and driving engagement through various channels. We're seeking a creative individual with strong writing skills and the ability to produce content that resonates with our audience of professional photographers.
   

  

 🎯
 **What You Will Do:**
* Execute content strategies that drive measurable business outcomes, including user acquisition and conversions.
* Grow the Aftershoot blog into a valuable resource for photographers while optimising content for SEO and AI platforms
* Create diverse content assets (guides, ebooks, templates) that help us to build trust and generate results
* Identify, prioritise, and implement new content opportunities to drive organic growth
* Manage content production schedules, working with freelancers and agencies to scale output and optimise ROI
* Collaborate across teams (marketing, design, product, SEO) to ensure content aligns with brand messaging and performance goals
* Build and nurture relationships with partners and industry influencers to extend content reach
* Monitor content performance metrics and provide regular reports with insights for improvement
* Contribute to content planning for newsletters, social media, and video channels to ensure cohesive messaging
* Maintain consistent brand voice while adapting to different platforms and audience needs


 💪
 **What We're Looking For:**
* 2\-4 years of experience in content marketing, writing, editing, or a related field
* Strong storytelling abilities and writing skills, with a portfolio of published work
* Basic understanding of SEO principles and content optimisation techniques
* Experience using analytics tools to track content performance
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong attention to detail
* Experience in B2B content marketing preferred
* Familiarity with the photography industry a plus but not required


**What happens after you apply?**
* Step 1: If your profile aligns with our vibe and requirements for the role, our people team will reach out to you for a brief phone call.
* Step 2: If everything aligns, your next chat will be with one of your future team members to better understand the role and your experience.
* Step 3: You will then be given a task \- this helps us evaluate your thought process and help you showcase your expertise.
* Step 4: If everything goes well, you will meet the leadership for a quick bar\-raiser round.
* Step 5: If you do manage to clear all rounds, this is the point we make an offer, shake hands, and welcome you to the team.


**You will work with:**
* Captain: Vrushti
* Team Members: Sriyanka, Vasundhara and the rest of the Aftershoot team.

Social Media Strategist
 
**Social Tab** 




 At Social Tab, we work with some of the most exciting names across
 **food, beverage, hospitality and lifestyle** 
 , building social identities that are culturally relevant, creatively sharp and made to stand out.

 **Social Media Strategist with prior agency experience**

 **F\&B and hospitality brands**

 This is a client facing role for someone who can think strategically, spot what’s trending, develop strong content ideas and, most importantly, take those ideas from a presentation to the feed.

 **7 to 8 brands**

 • Stay plugged into social media trends, platform behaviour and emerging content formats, with an understanding of what actually makes sense for each brand.
 



 • Manage multiple accounts, timelines and deliverables without compromising creative quality.
 


 Who We’re Looking For
 
 We’d love to meet someone who:
 



 • Has
 **prior social media or digital agency experience** 
 in a similar client facing role.
 



 • Has managed
 **multiple brands simultaneously** 
 and is comfortable owning accounts independently.
 



 • Has strong experience with
 **F\&B, restaurants, hospitality or lifestyle brands** 
 . This is highly preferred.

 • Has a strong visual and creative sensibility, with an eye for content that feels current and platform native.
 



 • Can confidently manage clients, internal creative teams and production timelines.
 



 • Is equally comfortable
 **coming up with the idea and making sure it gets executed well** 
 .

 The Kind of Person Who’ll Thrive Here
 
 You probably save great campaigns before anyone sends them to you. You notice when a restaurant’s content feels as considered as its menu. You can walk into a shoot with a moodboard and walk out knowing you got the content you needed.
 



 Most importantly, you understand that great social media is a combination of
 **strategy, culture, creativity and execution** 
 .

title: Retention Marketing Executive
description:
**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a Retention Marketing Executive to drive customer engagement, repeat purchases, and retention for a growing healthcare and wellness brand.
 



 This role focuses on the complete customer lifecycle — lead → purchase → product experience → repeat purchase. You will be responsible for converting interested leads, reducing customer drop\-offs, and increasing repeat revenue through WhatsApp, email, CRM, and marketing automation.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Plan and execute segmented WhatsApp and email campaigns for different customer lifecycle stages.
* Build lead nurture journeys for quiz\-takers, enquiries, checkout abandoners and other prospects.
* Create post\-purchase journeys covering onboarding, reminders, product experience, repeat purchase and win\-back.
* Develop and manage CRM and marketing automation workflows using triggers, timing and customer behaviour.
* Segment customers based on lifecycle stage, purchase history, engagement, recency/frequency, and other relevant data.
* Write clear, persuasive and customer\-focused WhatsApp and email communication.
* Analyse retention, repeat purchase, cohort and funnel data to identify customer drop\-offs and opportunities.
* Track campaign performance and continuously test messaging, timing, segmentation and CTAs.
* Monitor WhatsApp and email health, including opt\-outs, engagement, deliverability and compliance.
* Work closely with marketing, sales, and customer experience teams to improve the overall customer journey.
* Ensure all healthcare\-related communication follows responsible marketing and communication practices.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* 1–3 years of experience in Retention Marketing, CRM, Lifecycle Marketing, Email Marketing, WhatsApp Marketing, or Growth Marketing.
* Hands\-on experience managing WhatsApp and email campaigns.
* Experience with CRM/marketing automation tools and customer journey creation.
* Strong understanding of segmentation, customer lifecycle, retention, and repeat purchase marketing.
* Ability to analyse campaign and customer data and turn insights into actionable campaigns.
* Good copywriting skills with a strong understanding of customer psychology.
* Familiarity with cohort analysis, RFM, funnel metrics and retention KPIs is an advantage.
* Strong execution, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience in healthcare, wellness, D2C or consumer brands is preferred but not mandatory.



  





**Success in This Role** 




 Your primary goal will be to convert more existing leads, reduce customer drop\-offs, increase repeat purchases, and grow retention revenue.
 



 We are looking for someone who can move beyond simply sending campaigns and understand who should receive what message, at what stage, through which channel, and why.

title: Social Media & Content Creation Lead | 2-4 years | Faridabad (WFO)| upto 10LPA
description:
**Social Media \& Content Creation Lead \|** 




**Full\-time \|** 




**Reporting to: Brand Manager \|** 




**Location: Faridabad (in\-office)** 




  





**TARGET CANDIDATE PROFILE 2–4 years in social media or content creation • Strong short\-form portfolio • Comfortable on camera • Beauty, lifestyle or D2C experience preferred** 




**About the opportunity** 




**fast\-growing beauty and personal\-care company with in\-house manufacturing and R\&D, and multiple consumer brands.** 




**We are building organic social as a repeatable content engine, not a posting calendar. Working under the Brand Manager, you will personally take ideas from hook to script to camera to edit to publish, then use the numbers to decide what deserves another iteration. This is a hands\-on creator role with real ownership, not an agency\-coordination position.** 




**The essentials** 



1. **Experience: 2–4 years in social media management, content creation, brand content or a closely related role.**
2. **Location: Faridabad, Haryana. In office, five days a week, with on\-site shoots when required.**
3. **On\-camera work: Mandatory. You should be confident presenting products, tutorials, demonstrations and brand stories on video.**
4. **Production: You must be able to script, shoot and edit Reels, Shorts and other platform\-native short\-form content yourself.**
5. **Role type: Strong individual contributor. You may coordinate designers or photographers when needed, but you remain personally accountable for output and quality.**
6. **Terms: Full time. Six\-month probation. No bond and no lock\-in. Statutory PF and gratuity apply.**
7. **Reporting: Brand Manager; working closely with Creative and Performance Marketing.**
8. **Start date: Immediate joining preferred.**
9. 



**What you will actually build** 




**The mandate is to create a durable organic\-content capability across our beauty brands:** 



1. **A platform\-first content system: clear content pillars, recurring series, formats and channel roles for each brand.**
2. **A reliable short\-form engine: a fast weekly rhythm from insight and hook to script, shoot, edit, caption and publish.**
3. **A recognisable on\-camera presence: credible demonstrations, tutorials, problem\-solution stories and product education that feel native to the platform.**
4. **A disciplined social operating rhythm: calendars, approvals, publishing, community responses and an organised content library.**
5. **A measurable learning loop: weekly reviews that identify winning hooks and formats, then turn them into repeatable series and stronger briefs.**



**What the job involves** 



1. **Turning the Brand Manager’s priorities into monthly calendars and weekly production plans with clear objectives for every piece.**
2. **Researching audience problems, product truths, trends, and cultural moments, then converting them into original content ideas.**
3. **Writing hooks, scripts, captions, calls to action and thumbnail text in a clear, distinctive brand voice.**
4. **Appearing on camera and directing your own performance until the delivery feels natural, credible and platform\-native.**
5. **Shooting clean footage with strong framing, lighting and audio, then editing for pace, retention, subtitles and mobile viewing.**
6. **Publishing consistently across Instagram and YouTube Shorts, and adapting content for other relevant channels when required.**
7. **Managing comments and community conversations, and feeding recurring questions or objections back to the Brand Manager.**
8. **Reviewing watch time, completion, shares, saves, profile visits and organic traffic; testing new hooks instead of defending weak content.**
9. **Handing proven organic assets to Performance Marketing for amplification. You will not own media buying or paid\-campaign optimisation.**



**What we are looking for** 



1. **A portfolio that proves personal contribution. We want to see content you conceived, scripted, presented, shot or edited, not only work produced by an agency.**
2. **Strong short\-form craft: hooks, structure, pacing, framing, lighting, audio, subtitles and a clear reason to keep watching.**
3. **Comfort with at least one practical editing workflow, such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro or an equivalent tool.**
4. **Good writing and visual judgment. You can recognise a weak hook, cluttered frame or generic caption before it goes live.**
5. **Speed with standards. You can publish at a steady cadence without letting brand voice, accuracy or finish collapse.**
6. **Analytical discipline. You understand that reach and followers are signals, while retention, shares, saves, profile visits and traffic reveal whether content worked.**
7. **High ownership and openness to direct feedback. You can reshoot, recut and improve without treating every revision as a creative disagreement.**

title: Meller India Head
description:
**Mission Brief: Build and Scale Meller as a Business in India** 




  





 Meller, Lenskart's Barcelona\-born, D2C\-first sunglasses brand is entering its next chapter in India. Known for bold silhouettes, expressive colourways, and a design language rooted in Barcelona's street culture, Meller has a cult following of 700K\+ on Instagram and a strong Gen Z and Millennial fan base across Europe and the U.S.
 



  





 This role owns Meller as a business in India end\-to\-end P\&L, growth strategy, and operational execution across retail, e\-commerce, and marketing. Sitting at Lenskart's India HQ, you will effectively run Meller India as a founder would: setting the strategy, building the team, and making the commercial, brand, and operational calls that turn Meller to a category\-leading sunglasses brand in India.
 



  





 This is a builder's role at the intersection of business leadership, brand, and retail. You'll work closely with the global Meller team in Barcelona, Lenskart's leadership, and internal functions spanning category, retail, e\-commerce, supply chain, and finance while building a lean India team to execute the mission.
 



  





**🔑 Core Mandate: Business Ownership \& P\&L Leadership** 




  





**1\. Business Strategy \& P\&L Ownership (The Founder Focus)** 




**P\&L Ownership:** 
 Own Meller India's P\&L end\-to\-end — revenue, margin, and profitability — making the trade\-offs needed to build a healthy, scaling business.
 



**Business Strategy:** 
 Define and drive Meller's India growth strategy — market entry sequencing, channel mix, pricing, and expansion roadmap across retail and online.
 



**Brand Architecture Fit:** 
 Position Meller within Lenskart's house\-of\-brands portfolio (alongside John Jacobs, Owndays, and Le Petit Lunetier), with clear differentiation in price, design, and audience.
 



**Investment \& Resource Allocation:** 
 Decide where to invest — stores, marketing, people, technology — to maximise growth and return, and build the business case for future investment.
 



  





**2\. Retail, Category \& Channel Execution (The Growth Focus)** 




**Retail Rollout \& Performance:** 
 Own store performance and expansion across the \~500 launch stores and beyond — driving sell\-through, productivity, and the store economics that justify further rollout.
 



**Category \& Assortment Strategy:** 
 Partner with category and buying teams to shape the assortment strategy, ensuring product\-market fit for Indian consumers while staying true to Meller's global design DNA.
 



**E\-commerce \& D2C Growth:** 
 Drive Meller's presence and growth across Lenskart's app, website, and D2C channels, balancing brand experience with commercial performance.
 



**Channel \& Partnership Development:** 
 Identify and build new channels and partnerships — marketplaces, collaborations, wholesale, or others — that extend Meller's reach in India.
 



  





**3\. Brand, Marketing \& Consumer Experience** 




**Brand Custodianship:** 
 Ensure Meller's brand voice, positioning, and consumer experience in India stay true to its bold, design\-led, youth\-first DNA within global brand guidelines.
 



**Marketing Strategy Oversight:** 
 Set the direction for Meller's marketing engine in India — brand campaigns, influencer and community building, and performance marketing — and hold the team accountable for outcomes.
 



**Consumer Insight:** 
 Build a strong read on the Indian Gen Z and Millennial consumer — fashion trends, buying behaviour, and sentiment — to keep Meller's proposition sharp.
 



  





**4\. Global Coordination, Team \& Stakeholder Leadership** 




**Global Coordination:** 
 Serve as the primary interface between the Barcelona\-based Meller team and Lenskart's India leadership — aligning on strategy, brand consistency, and market learnings.
 



**Cross\-Functional Leadership:** 
 Work closely with Retail, E\-commerce, Category, Supply Chain, and Finance to ensure the business runs as one integrated system.
 



**Team Building:** 
 Build, mentor, and lead a lean, high\-performing India team capable of running Meller as an independent, founder\-led business within Lenskart.
 



**Leadership Reporting:** 
 Own business reviews and reporting cadences with Lenskart and Meller global leadership — covering performance, strategy, and course corrections.
 



  





**The Essentials** 




  




* **Experience:** 
 Proven experience in business leadership, general management, or P\&L ownership roles, with meaningful experience building or scaling a D2C brand; exposure to fashion/lifestyle, retail, or consumer brands is a strong plus, as is an entrepreneurial bent of mind.
* **P\&L \& Commercial Acumen:** 
 Proven ability to own and grow a P\&L — balancing revenue growth, margin, and working capital while making sound commercial trade\-offs.
* **Brand \& Retail Understanding:** 
 Strong grounding in brand building, retail operations, and consumer behaviour, particularly within fashion, lifestyle, or eyewear categories.
* **Entrepreneurial Track Record:** 
 Experience building or scaling a business, brand, or new market with founder\-like ownership, ideally in a fast\-growing or category\-disrupting environment.
* **Cross\-Border Collaboration:** 
 Experience or strong aptitude for working with global teams, balancing brand consistency with local market relevance.
* **Stakeholder \& Team Leadership:** 
 Proven ability to lead cross\-functional teams and influence senior leaders across commercial, retail, marketing, and finance functions.
* **Education:** 
 Bachelor's or Master's in Business, Marketing, Economics, or a related discipline. MBA preferred.



  





**🧠 The Mindset** 




  




* **Founder's Mentality:** 
 You think and act like you own the business — chasing outcomes, not just tasks, and taking full accountability for Meller's success in India.
* **Brand Storyteller:** 
 You understand how to turn a brand's design DNA into stories and experiences that resonate with a new generation of consumers.
* **Globally Minded, Locally Grounded:** 
 You carry a brand's global identity faithfully while adapting it with nuance for Indian consumers and platforms.
* **Commercially Grounded:** 
 You balance brand ambition with the discipline of running a healthy, profitable business.
* **Entrepreneurial Bent of Mind:** 
 You're comfortable with ambiguity, quick to take ownership, resourceful with limited support, and driven to make things happen rather than wait for a playbook.
* **Collaborative Operator** 
 : You move easily between strategic, creative, and commercial conversations, working across category, retail, and global brand teams to get things done.
* **Execution\-Focused:** 
 You don't just set strategy — you see it through, chase details, and hold the bar high at every touchpoint.

title: Manager - Content Strategy
description:

 We are looking for a Content Strategist to lead content planning and execution across its international markets. This role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution — owning the content roadmap while also shaping creator briefs, performance creative, and e\-commerce storytelling across different markets.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**International Content Strategy** 



* Develop and own the annual and quarterly content strategy for Fast\&Up’s international markets.
* Build market\-specific content pillars based on consumer behaviour, cultural nuances, sporting calendars and business priorities.
* Identify content opportunities around sports, fitness, wellness, hydration, lifestyle and cultural moments.



**Social Media Content** 



* Own content strategy for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and other relevant platforms.
* Develop concepts for Reels, TikToks, static content, carousels, stories and other social formats.
* Identify trends, formats, sounds, conversations and cultural moments relevant to each market.
* Ensure content is optimized for engagement, reach and discovery.



**Creator \& Influencer Content** 



* Work closely with the creator/influencer team to develop briefs and content directions.
* Develop creative briefs for different creator cohorts and use cases.
* Identify opportunities to convert creator content into paid media assets.



**Performance Content** 



* Develop strategy for content specifically for Meta, TikTok and other paid platforms.
* Develop creative testing frameworks across hooks, formats, messaging, CTAs and audiences.
* Analyse performance data and feed learnings back into content strategy.



**E\-commerce Content** 



* Work with e\-commerce teams to ensure strong product storytelling and consistency across all platforms.
* Help Develop enhanced product content, A\+ content, banners, videos and platform\-specific assets.
* Ensure brand consistency across D2C and marketplace environments.



**Team \& Agency Management** 



* Manage internal content resources, copywriters, editors and external agencies/creators.
* Build efficient content workflows and approval processes across international markets.
* Brief creative teams and ensure timely delivery of assets.
* Maintain high standards of quality and brand consistency.



**Market \& Competitor Intelligence** 



* Track competitors and emerging brands across international markets.
* Monitor social and cultural trends in the Europe, GCC, South East Asia and other markets.

 5–8 years of experience in content strategy, brand marketing, or social media, ideally with exposure to international/global markets.
 



  





**Skills:** 



* Strong understanding of social platforms (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube) — their formats, algorithms, and what drives engagement in each.

title: Ecommerce Manager
description:
**Digital Marketing and E\-Commerce Manager** 




  





**Location:** 
 Gurugram, Haryana, India
 



**Experience:** 
 7\-10 years
 



  





**About the Company** 




 bioQuad Life Sciences is a biotechnology company that manufactures patented, clinically tested supplements built on Bio\-Replenishments®, bioactive molecules the body naturally produces to maintain homeostasis. Published clinical trials support the company’s claims, which is uncommon in this industry. We operate two brands: bioQuad® for people and Boneo Canine® for pets. Both brands sell in the US, Europe and the UAE through Amazon, direct\-to\-consumer Shopify stores, and professional and retail distribution channels. Our products are based on original scientific research and are designed to support the body’s natural systems of regulation, repair, renewal and balance. The company has a growing international presence across the US, Europe, the Middle East and India. We combine scientific rigour, product quality and commercial execution to develop next\-generation solutions for metabolic and broader systemic health. This role reports directly to the Founder and CEO and will help build the paid acquisition function that supports the next stage of growth.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 This role takes charge of our paid advertising and makes it profitable. Amazon US is the priority. Both brands sell well there on their own, but the advertising has been left unmanaged by an outside agency. You will audit the accounts, present a rebuild plan, and then run the campaigns yourself. After Amazon US, you will launch Meta and Google, then paid traffic to our Shopify stores, and then assess Amazon UAE. None of these channels is currently running at full capability. You will work directly in the ad accounts, report to the Founder and CEO, and take responsibility for the numbers. The first ninety days are clear: audit the accounts, relaunch Amazon advertising on an approved structure, restore return on ad spend, and present a plan for the next channels. As the function grows, you will help set creative priorities, review agencies and take part in hiring additional digital team members.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Audit the existing Amazon US campaigns for both brands and present a written, costed rebuild plan before making changes.
* Create the campaign structure across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Display, with sound bidding, match types and negative keyword management.
* Restore return on ad spend to a profitable level and hold it, while ensuring budgets pace evenly through the day and remain within approved limits.
* Maintain account health and respond to policy notifications and listing suppressions within 24 hours. Improve titles, keywords, images and A\+ content before publication.
* Track inventory levels, restock timing and the causes of order cancellations so advertising does not create demand for products that cannot be supplied.
* Develop Meta and Google from dormant accounts into working campaigns across prospecting, retargeting, Search, Shopping and Performance Max, with tracking verified through GA4, Tag Manager and platform pixels.
* Strengthen the path from advertisement to completed Shopify checkout, identify conversion bottlenecks, and create and test campaign landing pages with the creative team.
* Submit a performance report every Monday, covering spend, revenue and return across all channels. Set creative and agency deliverables, verify reported figures, and escalate risks promptly.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Amazon Seller Central, Amazon Advertising and Brand Registry, including Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Display, bidding, match types, negative keywords and account health.
* Meta Ads Manager and Business Manager, Google Ads, Google Search, Shopping and Performance Max, with the ability to launch and manage campaigns yourself.
* Google Analytics 4, Tag Manager, Search Console and platform pixels, including the ability to verify tracking and diagnose gaps in reported performance.
* Shopify administration and analytics, with practical experience improving product pages, landing pages, checkout conversion and the wider e\-commerce funnel.
* Strong command of return on ad spend, ACOS, TACOS, cost per acquisition, conversion rate, budget pacing, revenue forecasting and quarterly spend planning.
* Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, with experience preparing weekly performance reports, forecasts, variance analysis and channel\-level decisions.
* Daily use of AI tools for research, ad copy, creative briefs, keyword analysis and reporting, alongside practical use of Helium 10, Jungle Scout or similar tools.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Background in supplements, nutraceuticals, health or pet products, where product claims, customer education and compliance require care.
* Experience with Amazon UAE or European marketplaces, including the differences in demand, creative, timing and marketplace operations.
* Experience reviewing an external marketing agency, leading a small digital team, or managing advertising budgets substantially larger than the current spend.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* Seven to ten years in performance marketing or e\-commerce growth, still working hands\-on in the advertising accounts.
* A revenue target you carried for a channel and met, with the ability to talk through the numbers and explain what drove the result.
* A channel you launched from nothing and made profitable, including the starting position, the actions taken and the timeline to profitability.
* Hands\-on command of Amazon Advertising and Seller Central. You must be able to diagnose and repair an underperforming account yourself.
* A track record of running Meta or Google advertising profitably for a direct\-to\-consumer brand, preferably in a Western market.
* The ability to prepare a quarterly spend and revenue forecast, not only optimize week to week.
* Fluency in return on ad spend, ACOS, TACOS, cost per acquisition and conversion rate, with the judgment to act when they move.
* Strong written and spoken English, sufficient for clear reporting to senior management. You use AI tools daily and are comfortable working directly with the Founder and CEO.
* You are commercially accountable, organized and willing to build the function rather than wait for a finished team, established process or fully managed account.



  





**Why Join Us** 



* You turn a channel around rather than maintain one. The result of your work is visible and attributable in revenue, return on ad spend and budget performance.
* You report directly to the Founder and CEO, with no layers between you and the decision. Strategy, budget and channel priorities are close to the person accountable for the business.
* The scope grows in a defined order: Amazon US first, then Meta and Google, then Shopify, then Amazon UAE. You will build the system as each channel comes online.
* You help shape and hire the digital team that follows you. This is an opportunity to establish how paid acquisition, creative testing, reporting and agency management are done.



  





**What We Offer** 



* A hands\-on role with direct responsibility for paid advertising across two international health and pet\-care brands.
* Direct reporting to the Founder and CEO, with clear ownership of channel performance, budget control, reporting and the ninety\-day delivery plan.
* A defined path to broaden the role from Amazon US into Meta, Google, Shopify, Amazon UAE and digital team building.
* Full\-time, in\-office work at HQ27, Sector 27, Gurugram, a Grade A building near IFFCO Chowk metro, with a food court and parking.

description:
Working at Infobip means being part of something truly global. With 75\+ offices across six continents, we’re not just building technology — we’re shaping how more than 80% of the world connects and communicates.
   

  

 As employees, we take pride in contributing to the world’s largest and only full\-stack cloud communication platform. But it’s not just what we do, it’s how we do it: with curiosity, passion, and a whole lot of collaboration.
   

  

 We operate with an AI\-first mindset, embedding intelligent tools into our daily workflows to work smarter and more efficiently. Every role here benefits from and contributes to this approach.
   

  

 If you're looking for meaningful work and challenges that grow you in a culture where people show up with purpose, this is your opportunity.
   

  

 Let’s build what’s next, together.
   

  

 We are looking for a data\-driven, strategic, and hands\-on
 **Demand Generation Manager** 
 to lead our customer acquisition, pipeline generation, and account\-based marketing (ABM) strategies. In this role, you will own multi\-channel campaigns designed to create, capture, and convert qualified pipeline for our sales teams.
   

  

 You will bridge the gap between marketing execution and sales velocity, partnering directly with Revenue Operations, Account Executives, and SDR leads to accelerate funnel conversion and maximize lifetime target account value.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Campaign Strategy \& Execution: Design, build, and optimize multi\-channel inbound and outbound marketing campaigns across LinkedIn Ads, Google Search, content syndication, webinars, and automated email sequences.
* Account\-Based Marketing (ABM): Partner closely with sales leads to execute tailored ABM strategies targeting our Target Account List (TAL) to increase enterprise deal velocity and win rates.
* Sales \& SDR Alignment: Build tight hand\-off processes and SLAs with the sales team to ensure rapid lead follow\-up, high conversion rates, and continuous feedback loops on lead quality.
* Funnel Analytics \& Attribution: Track, analyze, and present performance metrics across every stage of the funnel (MQLs, SQLs, CAC, ROAS, sales pipeline generated, and closed\-won revenue).
* MarTech \& Automation: Manage and optimize our core marketing stack (CRM, Marketing Automation, ABM tools) for precise audience segmentation, automated nurture tracks, and lead scoring.
* Experimentation \& Optimization: Continuously test ad creative, landing pages, copy, and audience targeting to lower customer acquisition costs (CAC) while scaling pipeline volume.


**What We're Looking For**
* Experience: 8\-10 years of hands\-on demand generation or growth marketing experience in a B2B SaaS environment.
* Channel Mastery: Proven track record managing significant monthly paid acquisition budgets ($30k\+/month) with verifiable pipeline contribution.
* Tech Stack Proficiency: Strong operational experience with Salesforce/HubSpot, Marketo, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Ads/GA4, and ABM/sourcing tools (e.g., Demandbase, 6sense, Apollo).
* Sales\-Minded Alignment: Strong empathy for sales workflows with a clear understanding of enterprise sales cycles, deal stages, and ACV dynamics.
* Data\-Driven: Ability to extract actionable insights from raw performance data and communicate key metrics clearly to executive leadership.


**Why you'll love it here**
* Financial rewards \& recognition \- A fair compensation aligned with your experience, industry, and market standards, performance\-driven bonuses, regular reviews to support your growth and recognize your contributions, and a culture that values your impact.
* Flexible work arrangements \- We combine in\-person collaboration with remote work and flexible working hours, because great ideas happen everywhere \- and not always between 9 and 5\.
* ESOP (Employee Stock Ownership Plan) \- As an Infobip employee, you’ll have the opportunity to share in our company’s success through stock options.
* Work\-life balance and Well\-being  \- We offer time off when you need it, special leave days for life’s big moments, and a flexible hybrid work model tailored to local regulations.
* Career mobility \- Your career is a journey. With internal mobility, upskilling, and mentorship, we help you shape your path.
* Professional development \- Learning never stops. Onboarding, mentorship, and training programs help you grow \- no matter where you start.
* International mobility \- Ready to take your career global? Explore short and long\-term opportunities in our Hubs worldwide.  While some benefits may vary by location, our goal remains the same: to support your growth, well\-being, and success \- wherever you are.  Diversity drives connection


**Infobip is built on diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and talents.** 
 We’re proud to be an equal\-opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace.
   

  

 No matter your race, gender, age, background, or identity — if you have the passion and skills to thrive, there’s a place for you here.
   

  

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, national origin, citizenship, disability, veteran status or any other part of one's identity.**
 Read more about our hiring process.

title: Regional Growth Leaders
description:
**Company Description** 




  





 Metafusion is a Unified Video Intelligence Platform provider. A platform that that integrates big video data, Natural Language Processing, computer vision, and Generative AI to unlock the full potential of metadata. Its advanced AI powered video analytics engine enables customers to derive actionable insights through natural language search, visual data interpretation, and on\-the\-fly content generation. This unified platform transforms how users explore and interact with large video data repositories, driving informed decision\-making and innovation. Metafusion’s solutions support a wide range of industries, including Smart and Safe Cities, Surveillance, Traffic and Transportation, Warehousing and Logistics, Hospitality and Healthcare, Banking, and Retail.
 



  





**Job Description** 




  





 Growth Leader is Metafusion's revenue engine on the ground — a dual\-mandate leader who drives new business acquisition and nurtures long\-term strategic growth within a defined geographic territory. Beyond classic quota ownership, the growth leader functions as a leader, responsible for mapping the market, building a partner ecosystem, and positioning Metafusion's Vision AI portfolio (Metavisio, Metatraffic, PixelFACE etc) as the intelligence layer of choice across Critical Infra, PSUs, Smart City, Safe City, and Government \& Enterprise verticals.
 



  





 This role requires a commercially assertive, consultatively strong professional who can operate at both the CXO boardroom and the technical evaluation table — owning the full sales cycle from prospecting to contract closure.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**A. Revenue Ownership \& Quota Attainment** 



* Own and exceed the assigned annual revenue quota for the territory per AOP targets.
* Drive end\-to\-end deal closure for Metafusion's Video AI and Vision AI product suite across assigned accounts and geographies.
* Maintain a healthy pipeline coverage at all times, qualifying and progressing opportunities through CRM.
* Deliver accurate sales forecasts of committed numbers on a quarterly basis.



  





**B. Territory Planning \& Market Development** 



* Build and execute a structured Territory Business Plan (TBP) each quarter aligned to AOP priorities.
* Identify high\-potential verticals, critical infra, government bodies \& Enterprises (Police, Smart City, Safe City, ICCC, Traffic, Large Enterprises), PSUs, and other accounts within the territory.
* Map competitive landscape and develop counter\-positioning strategies.
* Track government tenders and proactively position Metafusion in the pre\-tendering stage.
* Maintain a living territory account map: whitespace, installed base, renewal pipeline, and upsell opportunities.



  





**C. Channel Partner \& SI Ecosystem Development** 



* Identify, onboard, and enable active channel partners / System Integrators (SIs) within the territory.
* Conduct quarterly partner business reviews, co\-selling, and joint GTM activities.
* Ensure partner pipeline is logged in CRM; manage deal registration and conflict resolution.
* Train partners on Metafusion's product portfolio, solution USPs, and competitive differentiation.



  





**D. Solution Selling \& Pre\-Sales Collaboration** 



* Work closely with Pre\-Sales / Solution Engineers to craft solution architectures, BoQs, and demos tailored to customer needs.
* Lead discovery conversations and translate customer pain points into compelling Metafusion use cases.
* Support RFP / RFI responses for government and enterprise bids, ensuring compliance, differentiation, and on\-time submission.
* Conduct technical evaluation workshops, PoC planning, and site assessment visits alongside Pre\-Sales.



  





**E. CXO Engagement \& Strategic Relationship Management** 



* Build trusted advisor relationships with C\-level and senior decision\-makers at target accounts \& verticals.
* Coordinate with delivery and customer success teams’ post\-sale to ensure smooth implementation and account expansion.



  





**F. CRM Discipline \& Sales Reporting** 



* Maintain 100% CRM hygiene — all opportunities, activities, contacts, and deal stages updated weekly.
* Submit weekly pipeline reports and monthly territory reviews.
* Participate in appraisal cycles with documented evidence against KRA/KPI framework.



  





**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE** 




  





**Education** 



* B.E. / B. Tech in Electronics, Computer Science, IT, or related engineering discipline.
* MBA in Sales, Marketing, or Business Management preferred (not mandatory for proven performers).



  





**Experience** 



* 7–8 years of B2B sales experience with at least 3 years in technology / SaaS / Video Surveillance / AI solutions.
* Demonstrated track record of quota achievement.
* Experience selling to Critical Infra, Government (Smart City, Traffic, Safe City), PSUs, or Enterprise accounts is strongly preferred.
* Exposure to tender\-driven procurement processes is a significant advantage.
* Prior experience managing channel partners / SIs in a technology sales context.



  





**Domain Knowledge** 



* Working familiarity with Video Management Systems (VMS), AI Video Analytics, ANPR/LPR, Facial Recognition, or Surveillance infrastructure.
* Awareness of Enterprise Safe City / ICCC / Smart Traffic deployments in the Indian market.
* Understanding of procurement cycles, DPR preparation, and solution architecture basics.



  





**WHY METAFUSION?** 




  




* Work at the intersection of AI, Video Intelligence, and Smart Infrastructure — one of India's fastest\-growing technology domains.
* Opportunity to be a founding GTM team member — shape market strategy, not just execute it.
* Uncapped earning potential.
* Direct access to leadership — flat hierarchy, fast decisions, and merit\-driven career progression.
* Comprehensive product portfolio across Smart City, Traffic Management, Surveillance, and Enterprise AI verticals.



  





**Positions open for territories of Delhi/NCR, North, East \& West Regions.** 




  





**Send your profile on hr@metafusion.ai**

title: Account Director, Large Enterprise
description:
**About The Team**
 OpenAI’s mission is to build safe artificial general intelligence (AGI) which benefits all of humanity. This long\-term undertaking brings the world’s best scientists, engineers, and business professionals into one lab together to accomplish this.
   

  

 In pursuit of this mission, our Go To Market (GTM) team is responsible for helping customers learn how to leverage and deploy our highly capable AI products across their business. The team is made of Sales, Solutions, Support, Marketing, and Partnership professionals that work together to create valuable solutions that will help bring AI to as many users as possible.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Our Sales team has a unique mission to help customers understand the deep impact that highly capable AI models can bring to their business and users. This role is a mixture of technical understanding, vision, partnership, and value\-driven strategy.
   

  

 You’ll be a key driver of opportunities through the entire sales cycle, from pipeline generation to closure. You’ll work with researchers, engineers, and solution strategists to help customers evolve their industry with AI.
   

  

 This role will be based in Delhi.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Manage a small number of key accounts, developing and executing strategies for a comprehensive account plan.
* Lead our enterprise prospects’ journeys from consideration to successful deployment.
* Partner with solutions and research engineering to build and execute complex customer programs and projects.
* Own a consumption revenue target.
* Manage consumption revenue forecasts.
* Analyze key account metrics to create reports and provide insights to internal and external stakeholders.
* Closely monitor the industry landscape (people, competitors, partners, etc.) to contribute to product roadmap and other corporate strategies.
* Collaborate with solutions, marketing, communications, business operations, people operations, finance, product management, and engineering.
* Support the recruitment and onboarding of other teammates.
* Support the development of company culture.


**We're Seeking Someone With Experience In**
* 10\+ years selling platform\-as\-a\-service and/or software\-as\-a\-service.
* Achieving revenue targets \>$2M per year for more than 3 years.
* Designing and executing complex deal strategies.
* Supporting the growth of fast\-growing, high\-performance companies.
* Working directly with c\-level executives.
* Communicating technical concepts to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Leading high\-visibility customer events (CAB, conferences, product launches, etc.).
* Gathering, distilling, and processing complex market (industry, competitor, customer, prospect) intelligence.


**You Might Thrive In This Role If You**
* Are customer\-centric. You are motivated to deeply understand your customer’s priorities and help them achieve their vision for using our models to improve their products and services. You build strong relationships with executives and professionals across functions and serve as a trusted advisor.
* Have a passion or deep curiosity in artificial intelligence. You embrace the opportunity to help deploy our technology in a way that benefits humanity. You’re excited to educate our customers on AI and how to plan for the future.
* Are a builder. You are excited to impact how our company operates and scales. Your passion is building strong systems and processes from the ground up and executing them with precision.
* Are excited by new challenges. You don’t have the answers to every question up front, but the process of solving them invigorates you. Bespoke issues requiring multidimensional knowledge excite you. You’re willing to experiment with new solutions.
* Are a strategist. You deeply understand go to market best practices and raise the bar for our organization. You think and plan forward on the order of years and bring internal and external stakeholders along with your strategy.


**About OpenAI**
 OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general\-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.
   

  

 We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.
   

  

 For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.
   

  

 Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US\-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non\-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.
   

  

 To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non\-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.
   

  

 We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link.
   

  

 OpenAI Global Applicant Privacy Policy
   

  

 At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology.

title: Sr Manager, Strategy & Operations
description:
The Trade Desk is a global technology company and the world’s leading independent platform for digital advertising, with over 3,000 employees across more than 30 offices. Our technology helps advertisers reach the right audiences across the open internet — from streaming TV and podcasts to mobile apps, news, and more.
   

  

 Advertising powers the content people love. By making it more transparent, effective, and responsible, we help support trusted journalism, quality entertainment, and creators worldwide. The world’s brands and agencies rely on us to reach their customers and grow their businesses responsibly.
   

  

 The scale of our platform brings unique technical challenges — from processing massive datasets in real time to building systems that operate reliably on a global scale. When you work here, your impact is worldwide. We welcome diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and build teams that learn from one another. If you’re driven to solve meaningful challenges, we’d love to meet you.
   

  

 The Trade Desk is helping shape the future of digital advertising, and APAC \& EMEA are the most dynamic places to build that future. As APAC \& EMEA Strategy \& Operations (S\&O) resets from ad\-hoc executor to strategic advisor, we are standing up two accountable pillars: RevOps \& Sales Enablement, and Systems \& XFN Enablement to give the region the scalable frameworks and operating discipline it needs for sustained double\-digit growth.
   

  

 We're looking for a hands\-on operator who thrives on turning systems and process chaos into trusted, self\-serve foundations, someone who is as comfortable rolling up their sleeves in Salesforce (or equivalent platforms) as they are coaching a country manager through change. If you're energised by fixing the plumbing so teams can focus on customers, this is where you'll do some of your best work.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 Reporting into the APAC Director, Systems \& XFN Enablement, you'll own the execution layer that turns the region's systems foundation from a source of friction into a source of trust. Today, channel management activities (such as, mapping rework and change requests) pull Business Development \& Client Services managers and sellers off customers; you'll close that gap for good.
   

  

  

* Own Salesforce hygiene end\-to\-end, empowering Sales teams with tools for a frictionless \& efficient experience.
* Support systems transformation at regional and global level.
* Run change management and self\-serve training series with managers, including relationship methodology as well as 1:many governance cadences with the Salesforce champion community.
* Operate governance gates for rev\-group creation and maintain a clean audit trail, partnering with Finance, HR and Deal Desk.
* Support the Top Accounts process and outbound account management logic as part of the broader sales enablement agenda and contribute to the redesign of the Ops rhythm (Weekly Revenue Call, Quarterly \& Annual Planning).
* Track and report against success measures (mapping accuracy, backlog, adoption, meetings/FTE, training completion) to demonstrate ROI and free up selling time for GTM teams.
* Identify and build automation for standard workflows, processes and reporting, in partnership with engineering where needed.


**Who You Are**
* 8\-10 years in Sales Ops, Revenue Ops, Systems/Salesforce administration or Strategy, ideally in ad tech, SaaS or digital media.
* Deep, hands\-on Salesforce or CRM expertise (account/territory mapping, workflow rules, Portfolio Manager App or equivalent tooling); Tableau or Power BI experience is a strong plus.
* A track record of designing durable, self\-serve processes rather than one\-off fixes — you build the reusable rule, not just the one\-time exception.
* Comfortable running change management directly with frontline managers: training, governance cadences, and building trust that the new system works.
* Detail\-obsessed and data\-driven, with the judgement to know when a process needs to flex versus when to hold the governance line.
* A collaborative operator who partners naturally across Finance, HR, Deal Desk, Sales and Engineering to get things done.


**Why this role, why now**
 At TTD, values like Vision, Grit, Agility, Generosity, Openness, and Full\-Heartedness show up in how we work with one another every day. We're building a team that reflects the diversity of the markets we serve, and we warmly welcome people from all backgrounds who are excited to help shape what comes next.
   

  

 As an Equal Opportunity Employer, The Trade Desk is committed to creating an inclusive hiring experience where everyone has the opportunity to thrive.
   

  

 Please reach out to us at accommodations@ thetradedesk. com to request an accommodation or discuss any accessibility needs you may require to access our Company Website or navigate any part of the hiring process.
   

  

 When you contact us, please include your preferred contact details and specify the nature of your accommodation request or questions. Any information you share will be handled confidentially and will not impact our hiring decisions.

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
**Company Description** 
 Calxmap is an AI\-powered global expert marketplace that connects businesses and individuals with experts, freelancers, students, and custom AI agents for a wide range of needs. The platform offers on\-demand talent for both short\-term projects and flexible contracts, supported by intelligent AI matching. Calxmap enables users to access specialized expertise anytime and anywhere, streamlining how professional services are discovered and delivered. By combining human knowledge and AI capabilities, Calxmap aims to create a more efficient and accessible talent ecosystem for users worldwide.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Digital Marketing Executive role at Calxmap is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Gurgaon. In this role, the individual will plan and execute digital marketing campaigns across various channels to drive brand awareness, user acquisition, and engagement for the platform. Daily responsibilities include managing social media accounts, creating and optimizing web content, tracking and analyzing campaign performance using web analytics tools, and coordinating with internal teams to align marketing initiatives with business goals. The role also involves monitoring market trends, identifying growth opportunities, and contributing creative ideas to enhance Calxmap’s digital presence and user experience.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong Marketing skills, including campaign planning, execution, and performance optimization.
* Excellent Communication abilities for clear, effective collaboration and marketing messaging.
* Proficiency in Social Media Marketing for managing and growing brand presence across platforms.
* Experience in Web Content Writing to create engaging, user\-focused digital content.
* Knowledge of Web Analytics tools to measure, interpret, and report on digital campaign performance.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.
* Familiarity with SEO/SEM, email marketing, and basic design tools is an advantage.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment, with strong organizational and time\-management skills.

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Light Up Beauty® is a skincare and wellness brand transforming the Indian market with innovative, trendsetting formulations and a strong focus on clean\-label products. The brand pioneers advanced ingredients such as THD Ascorbate, Rice Water Complex , Butterfly Pea Flowers and Ceramides, combining them with superfoods for visible results. Light Up Beauty® has been featured in leading publications including Vogue, Femina, Elle, Grazia, Lifestyle Asia, HELLO, Hindustan Times, and Economic Times. Its products are available on major e\-commerce platforms such as Nykaa, Amazon, Flipkart, Blinkit and Swiggy.
 



**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site role for a Digital Marketing Manager based in South Delhi.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  




* Leading and planning digital marketing campaigns, including web, SEO/SEM, email, social media and display advertising.
* Complete ownership for all digital ads across all channels \- website, third party marketplaces like Amazon, Nykaa, Flipkart, Purplle and all mediums \- Facebook, Insta, Youtube, Google etc.
* Maintaining our social media presence across all digital channels
* Measuring and reporting on the performance of all digital marketing campaigns
* Optimizing paid marketing : budget monitoring, ROI efficiency across all marketing channels.
* Measure and monitor via Google Analytics, FB Ads Business manager and other tracking platforms, the performance and boost ROAS accordingly.
* Developing and managing online partnerships to expand social audiences and support content strategies: New User acquisition and Organic growth in Brand advocacy.
* Evaluating important metrics that affect our website traffic, service quotas, and target audience.
* Stay upto date with digital marketing trends, and potential new channels and strategies to keep us ahead including updates to marketing, attribution and media buying.
* Monitor market intelligence and keep track of competitor movement and market situation.
* Monitoring SEO team and ensuring that SEO presence of website is being improved month on month with consistent improvement in organic traffic, organic sales, conversion, page views and number of sessions.
* Ensuring improvement in company presence in top relevant keywords.
* Set measurable goals that demonstrate improvement in marketing efforts
* Monitor daily performance metrics to understand SEO strategy performance
* Identifying, evaluating and recommending social media management tools.
* Experimenting with new and alternative ways to leverage social media activities
* Monitoring trends, strategies and best practices in market and applying knowledge to Light Up marketing objectives.
* Measure the impact and return of social media efforts.
* Research and report on social media campaigns, performance, trends, competitor benchmarking and opportunities
* Provide insights to drive marketing strategies based on key metrics, historical data, and trend reporting.
* Brainstorm new and creative growth strategies
* Plan, execute, and measure experiments and conversion tests
* Collaborate with internal teams to create landing pages and optimize user experience
* Utilize strong analytical ability to evaluate end\-to\-end customer experience across multiple channels and customer touch points
* Instrument conversion points and optimize user funnels
* Develop optimization strategies that increase the company's search engine results rankings
* Working with internal designer on own production of creative assets – reels, posts, videos, emailers, blog content to boost sales
* Growing the online communities on Instagram, Facebook, Youtube
* Managing social media budget. Managing the social media budget to ensure maximum ROI and efficiency.
* Responsible for tying\-up and building strategic partnerships for product range to maximise brand awareness, sales and brand outreach.
* Lead business development efforts to maximise brand’s physical and digital presence via relevant e\-commerce and offline sales platforms, cross product partnerships with relevant brands and festive collaborations to increase sales.
* Structure and the deal with new Partners (i. e. key skincare products to be sold, commercials, contracting, and working relationship)
* Align and work closely with cross\-functional teams to ensure partner implementations are on track and delivering against plan ( social media, design and operations execution)
* Help grow the revenue from each Partner by improving conversions e. g. driving traffic to our products on Partner websites/app, suggestions for improving customer UI/UX, supporting the partner with digital marketing material, and introducing new products to each Partner
* Manage day to day Partner relationship \- engage with Partners with a win\-win mindset to improve customer experience, drive higher revenue, drive strategic objectives, etc.
* Leading team for day to day management to hit sales, SEO and brand awareness goals and being fully responsible for the business in case founder is travelling or absent.
* Please note as a startup, job description may change with additional responsibilities subject to brand goals, new product launches and responses to market and competition.

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
**Digital Marketing and E\-Commerce Manager** 




  





**Location:** 
 Gurugram, Haryana, India
 



**Experience:** 
 7\-10 years
 



  





**About the Company** 




 bioQuad Life Sciences is a biotechnology company that manufactures patented, clinically tested supplements built on Bio\-Replenishments®, bioactive molecules the body naturally produces to maintain homeostasis. Published clinical trials support the company’s claims, which is uncommon in this industry. We operate two brands: bioQuad® for people and Boneo Canine® for pets. Both brands sell in the US, Europe and the UAE through Amazon, direct\-to\-consumer Shopify stores, and professional and retail distribution channels. Our products are based on original scientific research and are designed to support the body’s natural systems of regulation, repair, renewal and balance. The company has a growing international presence across the US, Europe, the Middle East and India. We combine scientific rigour, product quality and commercial execution to develop next\-generation solutions for metabolic and broader systemic health. This role reports directly to the Founder and CEO and will help build the paid acquisition function that supports the next stage of growth.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 This role takes charge of our paid advertising and makes it profitable. Amazon US is the priority. Both brands sell well there on their own, but the advertising has been left unmanaged by an outside agency. You will audit the accounts, present a rebuild plan, and then run the campaigns yourself. After Amazon US, you will launch Meta and Google, then paid traffic to our Shopify stores, and then assess Amazon UAE. None of these channels is currently running at full capability. You will work directly in the ad accounts, report to the Founder and CEO, and take responsibility for the numbers. The first ninety days are clear: audit the accounts, relaunch Amazon advertising on an approved structure, restore return on ad spend, and present a plan for the next channels. As the function grows, you will help set creative priorities, review agencies and take part in hiring additional digital team members.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Audit the existing Amazon US campaigns for both brands and present a written, costed rebuild plan before making changes.
* Create the campaign structure across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Display, with sound bidding, match types and negative keyword management.
* Restore return on ad spend to a profitable level and hold it, while ensuring budgets pace evenly through the day and remain within approved limits.
* Maintain account health and respond to policy notifications and listing suppressions within 24 hours. Improve titles, keywords, images and A\+ content before publication.
* Track inventory levels, restock timing and the causes of order cancellations so advertising does not create demand for products that cannot be supplied.
* Develop Meta and Google from dormant accounts into working campaigns across prospecting, retargeting, Search, Shopping and Performance Max, with tracking verified through GA4, Tag Manager and platform pixels.
* Strengthen the path from advertisement to completed Shopify checkout, identify conversion bottlenecks, and create and test campaign landing pages with the creative team.
* Submit a performance report every Monday, covering spend, revenue and return across all channels. Set creative and agency deliverables, verify reported figures, and escalate risks promptly.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Amazon Seller Central, Amazon Advertising and Brand Registry, including Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Display, bidding, match types, negative keywords and account health.
* Meta Ads Manager and Business Manager, Google Ads, Google Search, Shopping and Performance Max, with the ability to launch and manage campaigns yourself.
* Google Analytics 4, Tag Manager, Search Console and platform pixels, including the ability to verify tracking and diagnose gaps in reported performance.
* Shopify administration and analytics, with practical experience improving product pages, landing pages, checkout conversion and the wider e\-commerce funnel.
* Strong command of return on ad spend, ACOS, TACOS, cost per acquisition, conversion rate, budget pacing, revenue forecasting and quarterly spend planning.
* Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, with experience preparing weekly performance reports, forecasts, variance analysis and channel\-level decisions.
* Daily use of AI tools for research, ad copy, creative briefs, keyword analysis and reporting, alongside practical use of Helium 10, Jungle Scout or similar tools.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Background in supplements, nutraceuticals, health or pet products, where product claims, customer education and compliance require care.
* Experience with Amazon UAE or European marketplaces, including the differences in demand, creative, timing and marketplace operations.
* Experience reviewing an external marketing agency, leading a small digital team, or managing advertising budgets substantially larger than the current spend.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* Seven to ten years in performance marketing or e\-commerce growth, still working hands\-on in the advertising accounts.
* A revenue target you carried for a channel and met, with the ability to talk through the numbers and explain what drove the result.
* A channel you launched from nothing and made profitable, including the starting position, the actions taken and the timeline to profitability.
* Hands\-on command of Amazon Advertising and Seller Central. You must be able to diagnose and repair an underperforming account yourself.
* A track record of running Meta or Google advertising profitably for a direct\-to\-consumer brand, preferably in a Western market.
* The ability to prepare a quarterly spend and revenue forecast, not only optimize week to week.
* Fluency in return on ad spend, ACOS, TACOS, cost per acquisition and conversion rate, with the judgment to act when they move.
* Strong written and spoken English, sufficient for clear reporting to senior management. You use AI tools daily and are comfortable working directly with the Founder and CEO.
* You are commercially accountable, organized and willing to build the function rather than wait for a finished team, established process or fully managed account.



  





**Why Join Us** 



* You turn a channel around rather than maintain one. The result of your work is visible and attributable in revenue, return on ad spend and budget performance.
* You report directly to the Founder and CEO, with no layers between you and the decision. Strategy, budget and channel priorities are close to the person accountable for the business.
* The scope grows in a defined order: Amazon US first, then Meta and Google, then Shopify, then Amazon UAE. You will build the system as each channel comes online.
* You help shape and hire the digital team that follows you. This is an opportunity to establish how paid acquisition, creative testing, reporting and agency management are done.

Elchemy leverages a proprietary digital customer platform to provide real\-time order transparency, traceability, and a just\-in\-time delivery experience. You'll build the function from the ground up: content, social, brand, events, campaigns, and the inbound funnel, all while working closely with sales and product to keep marketing tied directly to revenue goals. **Qualifications** 



* Experience building marketing strategy and function in companies with focus on international markets

description:
**About us** 




 D\-Axis Digiweb Solutions LLP is a full\-service digital marketing and web development agency based in New Delhi. We run performance campaigns, SEO, social media and custom web builds for clients across India, Dubai, the UK and Europe — spanning e\-commerce, D2C, wellness, healthcare, legal, interior design and professional services.
 



  





**The role** 




 You will independently own Google Ads and Meta Ads accounts end to end — strategy, build, optimisation and reporting — across a portfolio of client accounts and our own in\-house campaigns. This is a hands\-on execution role, not a supervisory one. You will be measured on the numbers your accounts produce, not on the volume of campaigns you launch.
 



  





**What we're looking for** 



* Minimum 4 years of hands\-on performance marketing experience, with direct ownership of both Google Ads and Meta Ads (agency background strongly preferred)
* A verifiable track record of improving ROAS or reducing CPL on live accounts — come prepared to walk us through two or three accounts you personally scaled, including what was failing before you touched them
* Comfortable managing meaningful monthly ad spend across several accounts simultaneously without dropping balls
* Strong working knowledge of GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Events Manager and Conversions API
* Solid grasp of attribution, incrementality and why platform\-reported numbers and actual business revenue often disagree
* Fluent in Excel or Google Sheets for pivot\-level analysis — you should be able to find the answer in the data before you ask the platform for it
* Experience across both lead generation and e\-commerce campaign objectives
* Confident written and spoken English, and comfortable in direct client conversations
* Google Ads and Meta Blueprint certifications are a plus, not a substitute for results



  





**What you'll own** 



* Full\-funnel campaign strategy, build and daily optimisation across Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, Display, YouTube, Shopping) and Meta Ads (Facebook \+ Instagram)
* Monthly ad budgets across multiple client accounts, with accountability for ROAS, CPL, CAC and lead quality — not just CTR and impressions
* Audience architecture: custom audiences, lookalikes, remarketing pools, exclusion lists and audience segmentation by funnel stage
* Conversion tracking setup and hygiene — Meta Pixel, Conversions API, GA4, Google Tag Manager, offline conversion imports
* Structured testing: creative, copy, audience, landing page and bidding\-strategy experiments with documented learnings
* Keyword research, negative keyword management, search term audits and quality score improvement
* Catalogue and feed management for e\-commerce accounts (Shopify / WooCommerce)
* Ad copy direction and creative briefs for the design team — you decide what gets tested and why
* Landing page and funnel feedback to the web team where conversion rate is the bottleneck
* Client\-ready monthly performance reports in Looker Studio, plus clear commentary on what changed and what's next
* Joining client calls to present performance, defend recommendations and manage expectations



  





**What we offer** 



* Direct ownership of accounts from day one, with no layers of approval between you and the campaign
* Exposure to international clients and varied industries, not one vertical on repeat
* Working alongside in\-house design, web development and SEO teams — you won't be fighting for resources
* Room to grow into account leadership as the portfolio expands



  





**How to apply** 




 DM on Linkedin
