 Apis Nandi Insurance Brokers Private Limited is a leading insurance broking and risk management firm in India, licensed by the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI) as a direct broker for life and non\-life insurance. Established in 2018 and headquartered in New Delhi, the company focuses on delivering comprehensive insurance placement, claims management, and risk advisory services with a strong emphasis on client satisfaction. Apis Nandi helps organizations understand and manage evolving risk exposures through services such as risk and policy analysis, insurance program design, and claims consultancy. The firm also offers specialized risk consulting in areas like property engineering, supply chain, fire, logistics, and natural hazards for large corporations, SMEs, and individual clients. Team members join a professional environment committed to market expertise, ethical practices, and long\-term client relationships.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Marketing Specialist role based in New Delhi. The Marketing Specialist will plan and execute marketing strategies to promote Apis Nandi’s insurance broking and risk consulting services across key business segments. Daily responsibilities include conducting market and competitor research, developing campaigns and marketing materials, coordinating with sales and client service teams, and supporting branding initiatives across digital and offline channels. The role involves monitoring campaign performance, preparing marketing reports, assisting with client presentations and events, and ensuring consistent messaging aligned with regulatory and corporate guidelines. The Marketing Specialist will collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams to enhance visibility, generate leads, and strengthen client engagement.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong Communication and Customer Service skills to interact effectively with clients and internal stakeholders.
* Candidates should possess Market Research and Marketing Strategy skills to analyze trends, identify opportunities, and plan targeted campaigns.
* Candidates should possess Sales and Marketing skills to support lead generation, promotional activities, and business development initiatives.
* Candidates should ideally have experience with digital marketing tools, presentation skills, and basic data analysis or reporting capabilities.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field; experience in financial services or insurance is an advantage.
* Ability to work collaboratively on\-site in New Delhi, manage multiple tasks, and maintain accuracy and compliance with industry regulations.

title: CSP - Value Stream Owner, Service Excellence & Retention
description:
**About The Opportunity**
 Job Type: Permanent
   

  

 Application Deadline: 31 October 2026
   

  

**Title** 
**CSP \- Value Stream Owner, Service Excellence \& Retention**
**Department** 
**Client Servicing Platforms**
**Location** 
**Gurgaon**
**Reports To** 
**Head of Client Servicing Platforms**
**Level** 
**8**
 We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together \- and supporting each other \- all over the world. So, join our Client Servicing Platform team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.
   

  

**About Your Team**
 As a business, we are constantly evolving how we work to stay ahead of what our clients need and to deliver on our Forward 8 ambitions. FIL Platforms represents the next step in that journey \- bringing together Asset Management Delivery, Enterprise Technology Services, and delivery and change teams from across the business into a single integrated structure, designed for clarity, speed, and impact.
   

  

 That structure is organised around Platforms, each a focused unit of capability with a single accountable owner and within each Platform, a set of Value Streams that translate strategic priorities into funded, sequenced delivery.
   

  

 Your value stream sits at the heart of that model. It exists to connect our talent and expertise directly to the priorities that matter most, delivering value for our clients with less duplication and fewer competing backlogs
   

  

 Client Servicing Platform is accountable for delivering on Fidelity’s client commitments after engagement, ensuring servicing outcomes are reliable, consistent and scalable across regions. The team owns the end\-to\-end client servicing journey, focusing on standardisation, transparency and repeatable delivery.
   

  

 The Service \& Retain value stream owns the platform capabilities that strengthen service performance and deepen long\-term client relationships. It brings together live service stability, continuous improvement, client insight and relationship\-focused outcomes so that service delivery is transparent, repeatable and aligned to client needs across regions.
   

  

**About Your Role**
 A value stream is FIL's core delivery construct \- the unit through which strategy becomes execution. Each value stream is underpinned by a clear roadmap, supported by the right people and capabilities required to deliver it. It sits below the Platform and above the Agile Release Train (ARTs) and Squads that do the work, and it is the layer where sequencing is decided, scope is defined and refined, and outcomes are owned.
   

  

 As a Value Stream Owner you represent the voice of the customer \- translating their strategic needs into delivery, as well as the Platform priorities.
   

  

 You will lead across both run (e.g. live service performance and stability) and change (e.g. delivery and continuous improvement). You’ll enable your teams to focus on the work that makes the biggest difference to FIL and its clients.
   

  

 Reporting to the Head of Client Servicing Platforms, you will lead the Service \& Retain value stream, ensuring Fidelity’s client servicing outcomes are reliable, consistent, scalable and continually improving across the end\-to\-end client journey.
   

  

 Key outcomes
   

  

* Reliable, consistent and scalable servicing outcomes across the end\-to\-end client servicing journey.
* A coherent roadmap across the Strengthen Service and Deepen Relationships ARTs, linked to platform OKRs and client value.
* Clear ownership of service stability, operational risk, client insight and continuous optimisation.
* Transparent performance tracking focused on service quality, client retention, engagement, cost\-to\-serve and platform effectiveness.


 Day to day, this means:
   

  

* Setting and defining the value stream vision (Objective \& Key Results) and roadmap, keeping it aligned to platform OKRs and FIL's Forward 8 priorities as both evolve with a focus on continuously delivering incremental value at all times.
* Acting as Value Stream Owner within the LPM process, accepting agreed demand into the backlog and leading delivery through the quarterly planning and execution cycle.
* Owning the Initiative backlog, and development of the Lean Business Case and making sequencing decisions.
* Managing the value stream budget and headcount within allocated funding levels, and making the case for investment where it is needed.
* Tracking and reporting on outcomes, not just delivery progress \- knowing what has actually moved and being honest when it has not.
* Leading Quarterly Planning Cycles and ensuring the ARTs are co\-ordinating a coherent, well\-sequenced plan.
* Managing operational risk and service stability within the value stream alongside the change agenda.
* Building and developing the leadership team within the value stream, and holding them accountable to outcomes.
* Accountable for role modelling and championing the correct behaviours and change culture.
* Championing and driving the value stream at the relevant governance forums and with senior stakeholders.
* Transiting the value stream to the North Star view over time (reducing dependencies and additional coordination horizontal layers).


**About You**
 This role will suit if you’ve run, changed and owned a large, complex global product (including service, platform, proposition or product) at scale, including: the viability, the operational, the technical, and value dimensions.
   

  

**Specifically, we are looking for:**
* Commercial acumen to own a business outcome and make the value case for a value stream's priorities.
* A genuine track record of building high\-performing, engaged teams to move the dial on performance metrics via the value delivered.
* An individual who has led both run and change, and are comfortable being fully accountable for live performance, delivery outcomes, operational effectiveness and the long\-term health of a value stream.
* An individual who can engage senior stakeholders with integrity, using sound judgement and negotiation skills to influence outcomes, manage competing interests and ensuring the right initiatives are being delivered in the right way.
* Strong familiarity with Agile operating models at scale; experience with SAFe or a comparable framework is an advantage.
* Financial management experience \- owning a budget, making trade\-offs, and being accountable for spend against outcomes.
* The technical fluency to engage meaningfully with engineering leads on architecture, debt, and delivery risk.
* Sound judgement in complex, regulated environments, balancing experience, delivery feasibility, risk, control and operational practicality without losing momentum.
* The ability to define the longer\-term direction for a value stream while staying close enough to execution, risk, delivery and operational detail to ensure results are actually achieved.
* An excellent communicator who can motivate and align large teams (including matrixed roles), create shared understanding across complex stakeholder groups and maintain momentum through clarity, consistency and presence.
* Enterprise\-first individual, supporting the creation of common, reusable patterns and repeatable solutions that improve consistency, speed and simplicity across the platforms.


 Behavioural expectations
   

  

**Brave**
* Prioritise learning and momentum over defending legacy commitments.
* Remove blockers and reset priorities when outcomes are at risk.
* Role model stopping or reshaping work that no longer delivers value.


**Bold**
* Set clear, outcome led direction and make decisive tradeoffs at valuestream level.
* Simplify governance, roles and interfaces to reduce duplication and escalation.
* Delegate real decision authority and protect teams’ ability to move at pace.


**Curious**
* Drive continuous prioritisation based on flow, outcomes and data.
* Expect evidence led conversations (not status updates) in the appropriate governance forums.
* Use delivery data to inform funding, sequencing and capacity decisions.


**Compassionate**
* Act as a visible advocate for client outcomes across the value stream.
* Build psychological safety so issues are raised early rather than escalated late.
* Balance pace with sustainability and colleague wellbeing.


 Feel rewarded
   

  

 For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

title: Category Management
description:
**About The Opportunity**
 Role: Category Management
   

  

 Level : Assistant Manager
   

  

 Location: Gurgaon
   

  

 Reporting to : Lead Category Manager
   

  

**About The Function**
 With a deep understanding of Indian consumers' travel preferences, the Holidays team offers a vast range of holiday packages for destinations across the world.
   

  

 MMT Holidays is a leading name in the leisure travel space, serving over 3 lakh passengers a nnually. Our offerings span both domestic and international markets, catering to travellers across more than 50 destinations. With a strong focus on delivering exceptional travel experiences, we are a trusted choice for holiday packages.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The incumbent will play a pivotal role in driving growth and innovation within this category. The role demands a strong strategic mindset, backed by deep market insights and competitive benchmarking, to shape category performance and business direction.
   

  

 You will lead high\-impact initiatives, working cross\-functionally with product, marketing, supply, and operations teams to ensure seamless execution and strategic alignment. A key responsibility will be to build performance dashboards that surface actionable insights, support data\-driven decisions, and unlock new growth opportunities.
   

  

 In addition, you will be instrumental in enhancing the overall customer experience by identifying friction points and collaborating on solutions. The role also involves supporting leadership with data\-backed recommendations to steer the business forward.
   

  

**What Will You Be Doing**
* Developing and driving annual growth roadmaps by leveraging insights from traveler segments, market trends, competitive landscapes, customer value analysis, funnel performance, and experimental pilots.
* Leading strategic, high\-impact projects from ideation to execution, including building robust business plans and implementing phased rollouts aligned with the company’s vision.
* Delivering actionable insights and enabling cross\-functional execution across supply, sales, marketing, product, and post\-sales teams.
* Designing, building, and refining performance dashboards and business intelligence tools to track progress against the annual operating plan.
* Collaborating closely with Marketing, Sales, Revenue, and Product teams to accelerate growth and drive business outcomes.
* Identifying and capitalizing on new growth opportunities through industry benchmarking and innovative strategies across related sectors.
* Owning and optimizing the end\-to\-end customer journey to ensure an aspiration\-led, seamless travel experience and differentiated market positioning.
* Partnering with senior leadership to shape strategic priorities, support high\-impact decision\-making, and provide data\-driven recommendations.


**Qualification \& Experience**
* A master’s degree from a reputed institute, along with 2 to 4 years of experience in managing a category within internet, e\-commerce, travel organizations, or in a similar role.


**Key Success Factors For The Role**
* Strong collaboration skills with a proven track record of working effectively across Product, Tech, Supply, Marketing, and Sales functions.
* Sharp analytical thinking with a passion for data\-driven problem solving and structured decision\-making.
* Ability to think strategically while maintaining a strong execution focus to drive measurable business outcomes.
* Experience in scaling category portfolios and leading innovation\-led growth initiatives.
* Ownership of end\-to\-end product journeys with a focus on cohort\-specific experiences and customer\-centric design.
* Agility to thrive in ambiguous environments, with a test\-and\-learn mindset and an iterative approach to driving performance improvements.

title: Revenue Manager
description:
**About The Opportunity**
**Role:** 
 Revenue Management
   

  

**Level:** 
 Deputy Manager /Manager
   

  

**Reporting To:** 
 Associate Director \- Revenue Management
   

  

**Location:** 
 Gurgaon
   

  

**About The Function**
 Being the largest online travel aggregator in India, MMT witnesses a sizeable number of users visiting the app and transacting every day.
   

  

 The Ground Transport(GT) business offers an unmatched booking experience to this vast user base, with the widest range of Bus, Rail, and Cab booking options—also playing a crucial role in acquiring new users, especially from Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities across India.
   

  

 This is further complemented by a world\-class post\-booking experience—whether it's through the app's numerous self\-help features or our hand\-picked executives who strive to deliver customer delight at every step. The Ground Transport SBU embraces a strong innovation mindset and has consistently launched industry\-first features that make the booking experience truly seamless and delightful.
   

  

 At MMT, the Ground Transport unit takes immense pride in its team members who work tirelessly to champion the best possible experience for our users. An orchestra of product managers, tech developers, designers, researchers, and revenue managers comes together to ensure we continue to lead and differentiate ourselves in the industry.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As part of the GT Online Revenue function, you will join a whip\-smart team responsible for managing revenue, driving growth, and increasing profitability. You will embody our values of consumer focus, commitment to results, and continuous improvement by developing innovative solutions that raise challenging questions and demand both creative and practical answers.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is an independent, self\-starting, quick\-witted, entrepreneurial, and intellectually curious individual. This person must excel at cross\-functional collaboration, blend creativity with strong organizational skills, manage deliverables under tight deadlines, and consistently produce high\-quality work under pressure.
   

  

**What Will You Be Doing**
**P\&L and Revenue Management**
* Own and manage the business P\&L, working with internal stakeholders to devise strategies aimed at achieving revenue goals.
* Closely monitor performance parameters, ensuring tight control over key business KPIs such as conversions, transactions, and margins.
* Conduct deep dives into competitor pricing data and use insights to inform category pricing strategies.
* Adjust pricing strategies based on demand signals and market conditions to maintain competitiveness and maximize revenue.


**Growth Strategy Development**
* Define annual and quarterly plans based on short\- and long\-term growth strategies, influencing key cross\-functional teams to align on common objectives.
* Develop and implement initiatives focused on customer acquisition.
* Analyze demand signals and traffic data to understand business and marketing trends.
* Use these insights to shape business and marketing strategies, driving greater engagement and higher conversion rates.


**Customer Engagement \& Marketing Collaboration**
* Work closely with the marketing team to develop and execute customer engagement strategies and campaigns that maximize customer lifetime value.
* Lead tactical initiatives around active revenue drivers such as pricing, seasonal trends, and topical promotions using relevant marketing channels.
* Collaborate with various marketing functions to maximize order volumes while maintaining a healthy ROAS.


**Collaboration with Product \& Operations Stakeholders**
* Partner with product teams to develop first\-class, customer\-centric experiences.
* Work with operations teams to streamline processes that drive strong NPS and CSAT scores.


**Data Analysis \& Reporting**
* Create and maintain rich, interactive visualizations through effective data interpretation and analysis.
* Integrate reporting components from multiple data sources to provide actionable insights to stakeholders.
* Apply statistical methods to analyze data and answer key business questions, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and performance.


**Qualification \& Experience**
* MBA from a reputed institute with 4–6 years of experience in a revenue or category management role within a consumer\-facing, technology\-enabled business—preferably in the e\-commerce industry.
* Proven track record of working in high\-growth, data\-driven environments with a strong understanding of business levers and consumer behavior.
* Advanced proficiency inMS Excel and MS PowerPointfor data analysis and business storytelling.
* Sound understanding of SQL and Python is mandatory to independently work on data extraction, modeling, and analysis.


**Key Success Factors For The Role**
* A mindset that consistently focuses on return on investment, business outcomes, and revenue growth.
* High energy, team\-oriented, and brings a positive, can\-do attitude.
* Strong understanding of data analysis, with hands\-on experience in data\-driven decision\-making.
* Proven track record of driving business growth through both tactical and strategic initiatives.
* Excellent communication skills and strong stakeholder management capabilities.
* Exceptional attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple proj ects simultaneously.

title: Decision Analyst
description:
Join us as a Decision Analyst at Barclays, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You'll harness cutting\-edge technology to revolutionize our digital offerings ensuring unapparelled customer experiences.
   

  

 The Decision Intelligence team at Barclays drives strategic business impact by applying advanced analytics and data science to solve complex challenges. Focused on enhancing profitability, customer experience, and operational efficiency, the team builds analytical capabilities to inform business strategies and case development. By uncovering growth opportunities, optimizing customer and digital strategies, and improving risk management, they deliver data\-driven and decision focused solutions in collaboration with stakeholders, fostering a culture of informed decision making and continuous improvement throughout the organization.
   

  

 To be a successful Decision Analyst, you should have experience in:
   

  

  

* Synthesizing business knowledge, market research, and analytics to drive strategic outcomes.
* Understanding value drivers across products and services, linking customer, operational, and financial levers.
* Breaking down complex challenges using frameworks such as MECE, hypothesis\-driven approaches, 5 WHYs, 80/20, and decision trees.
* Using Python, SQL, Excel, and Tableau to transform data into actionable insights.
* Generating insights that drive measurable business outcomes.
* Crafting compelling, data\-backed narratives for senior stakeholders and delivering powerful executive presentations.
* Coordinating cross\-functional teams and tracking benefits realization.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* Strong communication and storytelling.
* Good at problem solving skills and strategic thinking.
* People leadership potential and guiding/coaching less experienced colleagues.
* AI Awareness/Adoption.


 You may be assessed on essential skills relevant to succeed in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 The location is based out of Gurugram.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To extract meaningful insights from complex data sets, developing robust decision models, and presenting actionable recommendations to stakeholders across the departments.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Identification and extraction of relevant data from various internal and external sources.
* Performing sensitivity analysis and scenario planning.
* Monitoring and evaluation of the performance of existing models.
* Development and implementation of data quality control procedures.
* Building and validation of quantitative models to support decision\-making across different business areas.


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Brand Manager
description:
Brand Manager – Industrial \& Marketing
 
**Company:** 
 Steelbuild Infra Projects Limited
 



**Industry:** 
 Pre\-Engineered Buildings (PEB) \| Structural Steel \| Industrial Infrastructure
 



**Department:** 
 Marketing \& Branding
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Location:** 
 Delhi
 



**Experience:** 
 6–10 Years
 


 About Steelbuild Infra Projects Limited
 
 Steelbuild Infra Projects Limited is a growing Pre\-Engineered Building (PEB) and structural steel solutions company delivering warehouses, factories, industrial buildings, manufacturing facilities and infrastructure projects across India.
 



 We are looking for an experienced
 **Brand Manager – Industrial \& Marketing** 
 to strengthen our corporate brand, enhance market visibility and lead integrated marketing initiatives across digital, content, industrial marketing, events and sales enablement.
 


 Key Responsibilities / KRAs1\. Brand Strategy \& Positioning
 * Develop and execute the overall brand and marketing strategy for Steelbuild.
* Strengthen brand positioning across PEB, structural steel and industrial infrastructure markets.
* Build consistent messaging around engineering expertise, manufacturing capabilities, quality, reliability and project execution.
* Maintain consistency in brand identity, communication and tone across all channels.
* Conduct competitor and market analysis to identify positioning opportunities.
* Translate business objectives into actionable marketing initiatives.


 2\. Industrial \& B2B Marketing
 * Develop targeted B2B marketing strategies for industrial customers and decision\-makers.
* Plan sector\-specific campaigns for manufacturing, warehousing, logistics, automotive, FMCG, pharmaceuticals, food processing and related industries.
* Understand industrial customer journeys and develop relevant communication for different buying stages.
* Create campaigns highlighting Steelbuild's engineering, manufacturing and project execution capabilities.
* Identify industry trends, customer requirements and competitive developments.
* Support market expansion across priority sectors and geographical markets.


 3\. Corporate Communication \& Content
 * Manage corporate communication across digital and offline channels.
* Develop company profiles, brochures, presentations, project profiles, case studies and corporate videos.
* Convert technical and engineering information into clear, compelling business communication.
* Develop project success stories showcasing challenges, solutions and execution outcomes.
* Coordinate professional photography and videography of projects and manufacturing facilities.
* Maintain a structured library of corporate and project marketing assets.


 4\. Digital Marketing \& Website
 * Lead digital marketing across website, search engines, social media and paid campaigns.
* Manage the corporate website from branding, content, SEO, UX and lead\-generation perspectives.
* Drive SEO for PEB, structural steel, warehouse, factory and industrial construction searches.
* Plan and monitor Google Ads and other relevant digital campaigns.
* Use GA4, Google Search Console and analytics platforms to evaluate performance.
* Improve website traffic, engagement, conversions and qualified enquiries.
* Develop campaign landing pages and other digital marketing assets.


 5\. Social Media \& Content Marketing
 * Develop and execute Steelbuild's social media strategy with a strong focus on LinkedIn.
* Prepare monthly and annual content calendars.
* Create content around projects, engineering expertise, manufacturing capabilities, milestones, industry insights and achievements.
* Plan corporate, festival, awareness and milestone campaigns while maintaining professional brand standards.
* Build engagement with customers, consultants, architects, industry professionals and decision\-makers.
* Monitor performance and continuously optimize content strategy.


 6\. Lead Generation \& Sales Enablement
 * Collaborate with Sales and Business Development teams to generate qualified enquiries.
* Develop customer presentations, capability decks, brochures, project portfolios and sector\-specific collateral.
* Plan targeted campaigns for prospective industrial customers.
* Support account\-based marketing initiatives for high\-value prospects.
* Develop marketing assets for customer meetings, proposals and business\-development activities.
* Track marketing\-generated leads and coordinate with Sales for follow\-up.
* Analyze lead sources and campaign performance to improve lead quality.


 7\. Project \& Site Branding
 * Develop standardized branding guidelines for projects and manufacturing facilities.
* Manage project signboards, corporate signage, banners and other visibility materials.
* Ensure consistent Steelbuild branding across offices, plants and project locations.
* Coordinate documentation, photography and videography of completed and ongoing projects.
* Identify projects suitable for case studies, campaigns and corporate communication.


 8\. Events \& Exhibitions
 * Plan participation in relevant industrial exhibitions, conferences and trade shows.
* Manage stall concepts, branding, collateral, presentations and promotional materials.
* Coordinate pre\-event and post\-event marketing campaigns.
* Support Sales teams in capturing and following up event\-generated enquiries.
* Identify relevant sponsorship and industry networking opportunities.
* Evaluate event performance based on visibility, engagement and lead generation.


 9\. PR \& Corporate Reputation
 * Support PR and corporate reputation initiatives.
* Develop press releases and corporate announcements for projects, milestones and company developments.
* Identify opportunities for leadership and technical teams to contribute to industry publications and forums.
* Maintain consistent external communication and professional brand representation.
* Monitor industry and competitor communication for emerging opportunities.


 10\. Marketing Analytics \& Performance
 * Establish measurable KPIs for branding and marketing activities.
* Track website traffic, SEO performance, social engagement, campaign leads and qualified enquiries.
* Prepare monthly and quarterly marketing performance reports.
* Analyze campaign effectiveness, conversions and marketing ROI.
* Identify high\-performing channels and optimize campaigns based on data.
* Recommend marketing budget allocation based on performance.


 11\. Budget \& Vendor Management
 * Prepare and manage marketing budgets.
* Coordinate with agencies, designers, photographers, videographers, printers and digital partners.
* Negotiate vendor commercials while maintaining quality standards.
* Monitor campaign timelines, deliverables and expenditure.
* Ensure activities are completed within approved budgets and timelines.


 12\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration
 * Collaborate with Sales, Engineering, Design, Manufacturing, Projects, Quality, HR and senior management.
* Gather accurate technical and project information for marketing communication.
* Support Sales with effective customer\-facing materials.
* Coordinate with HR on employer branding and corporate communication when required.
* Maintain effective coordination between internal teams and external partners.


 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
 * Growth in qualified marketing\-generated enquiries.
* Improvement in brand visibility within target industrial sectors.
* Website traffic, SEO visibility and conversion performance.
* Digital campaign effectiveness and cost efficiency.
* Social media reach, engagement and audience quality.
* Quality and frequency of project case studies and marketing assets.
* Effectiveness of sales\-enablement campaigns and collateral.
* Event and exhibition lead generation.
* Brand consistency across digital and offline channels.
* Marketing campaign execution and budget utilization.
* Measurable marketing ROI.


 Preferred Skills
 * Brand Management \& Brand Strategy
* Industrial \& B2B Marketing
* Corporate Branding \& Communication
* Digital Marketing
* Content Strategy \& Corporate Storytelling
* SEO \& Google Ads
* LinkedIn \& Social Media Marketing
* Lead Generation
* Website Marketing \& Optimization
* Marketing Analytics
* GA4 \& Google Search Console
* Campaign Management
* Market Research \& Competitor Analysis
* Sales Enablement
* Corporate Presentations
* Case Study Development
* Event \& Exhibition Management
* PR \& Media Communication
* Budget \& Vendor Management
* Stakeholder Management
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration
* Project Management


 Qualification \& Experience
 * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Mass Communication, Branding, Communications or related discipline.
* MBA/PGDM in Marketing will be preferred.
* **6–10 years of relevant experience** 
 in brand management, industrial marketing, B2B marketing or corporate marketing.
* Experience in
 **PEB, structural steel, construction, engineering, manufacturing, infrastructure, building materials or related B2B industries** 
 will be preferred.
* Strong understanding of industrial marketing and B2B customer journeys.
* Experience managing integrated online and offline marketing initiatives.
* Strong written, verbal, presentation and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to understand technical information and translate it into effective business communication.
* Strong analytical, planning and project\-management capabilities.


 Ideal Candidate
 
 The ideal candidate combines
 **strategic brand thinking with hands\-on marketing execution** 
 and can manage corporate branding, industrial marketing, digital campaigns, technical content, project storytelling, events and sales enablement.
 



 The candidate should understand that industrial marketing is about building credibility, communicating engineering capabilities, supporting business development and strengthening long\-term customer relationships.
 


 Why Join Steelbuild?
 
 At
 **Steelbuild Infra Projects Limited** 
 , you will have the opportunity to strengthen the market presence of a growing industrial engineering brand in the Pre\-Engineered Buildings and structural steel sector.
 



 You will collaborate with engineering, manufacturing, project execution, sales and leadership teams while gaining exposure to the complete lifecycle of industrial projects.
 


* **Build the Brand. Strengthen the Market. Shape Industrial Growth.**

title: Senior Enterprise Solutions Manager - Brand & Engagement
description:
**💻 Position: Senior Enterprise Solutions Manager \- Brand \& Engagement** 




**📍Location: Delhi** 




**🗓️ Working Days: Monday to Friday** 




**📌 Experience Required: 4–7 years** 




  





**About the Role** 




 Own the
 **end\-to\-end implementation and growth of FMCG brand campaigns post\-sale** 
 — getting them live, setting up tooling/dashboards, handling SQL, legal/ops, and building solutions when standard processes don’t fit.
 



  





**The Role** 



* You own what happens after a brand signs — and part of what happens just before.
* You take a signed (or near\-signed) enterprise brand and stand up a working, measurable campaign: configuring internal tooling, building the demo/sandbox the brand evaluates, wiring up their analytics dashboards, and clearing the legal and operational steps between contract and go\-live.
* When the standard path doesn't fit a brand's ask, you design one. And you feed every recurring gap back to Product, so the next deployment is faster.
* This is a builder's seat, not a relationship\-management seat. You'll be measured on getting brands live, instrumented and expanding — not on meeting cadence.



  





**What You'll Do** 



* **Demos \& sandboxes:** 
 Build the demo environments and proof\-of\-concept setups brands evaluate, in coordination with the founding team.
* **Solutioning:** 
 Translate a brand's objective into a concrete campaign configuration. Invent workarounds when our defaults don't fit.
* **Customer setup:** 
 Configure and launch new enterprise customers in our internal tools. Own time\-to\-first\-live\-campaign.
* **Analytics:** 
 Stand up and maintain customer\-facing dashboards so every brand can see purchase intent and campaign outcomes without having to ask.
* **Cross\-functional coordination:** 
 Drive legal (MSAs, DPAs, brand \& procurement reviews) and operations (fulfilment, sampling logistics) to unblock go\-live.
* **Account outcomes:** 
 Own the ongoing result — accounts that stay live and grow because they're properly instrumented. Catch risk in the data before it surfaces at renewal, not after.
* **Product partnership:** 
 Surface recurring friction, scope it with Product, and help shape the tooling built specifically for this function.



  





**Requirements** 



* 4–7 years in solutions engineering, implementation / onboarding, technical account management, or enterprise customer success at a B2B SaaS, martech or adtech company.
* Hands\-on data fluency. You build dashboards from raw data, not just read them — hands\-on SQL, plus a BI tool (Metabase, Looker, Power BI, Tableau).
* Ownership in ambiguity. You've run an implementation or a complex onboarding end\-to\-end, not just managed a relationship around one.
* Enterprise stakeholder management. You've sat across from brand / marketing, procurement and legal — ideally in or around FMCG / CPG brand teams or their agencies (WPP, Publicis, Mindshare, Dentsu).
* Communication. Sharp written and verbal; you can run a room of senior client stakeholders.

title: Country Manager – (HVAC, Ventilation, IAQ, ERV/HRV, Heating-cooling system)
description:
**Country Manager – (HVAC, Ventilation, IAQ, ERV/HRV, Heating\-cooling system)** 




**Zehnder Group \| Represented in India by T\&A Consulting** 




**Location: Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Bengaluru** 




  





**About Zehnder Group** 




 Zehnder Group is a Swiss headquartered provider of world\-leading solutions for a comfortable, energy\-efficient and healthy indoor climate. The products and services of the Group include heating, cooling, indoor ventilation and air cleaning. The Group develops and manufactures its products at its own factories in Europe, China, and North America.
 



 As part of its international growth strategy, Zehnder is now entering the Indian market and is looking to appoint Country Manager – India.
 



**More about Zehnder Group on www.zehndergroup.com** 




 Zehnder has partnered with
 **T\&A Consulting** 
 to support its India market entry and leadership hiring.
 



  





**About T\&A Consulting** 




 T\&A Consulting is a global advisory firm, with extensive experience of working with government, economic development agencies, businesses and academic institutions across Europe, Asia, and the Americas towards their expansion in the international markets.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a Country Manager – India who will be responsible for building Zehnder’s business in India from the ground up.
 



 This is not a conventional sales role. It is a
 **market\-entry, business development and category\-building role** 
 for a senior commercial professional who can create demand for premium indoor climate solutions in India.
 



 The role requires someone who can position Zehnder as a premium ventilation, fresh\-air and indoor air quality brand in India, build specification\-led demand, develop a strong project pipeline, create the right partner ecosystem, and secure early reference projects.
 



 The ideal candidate should be comfortable operating in a lean, entrepreneurial setup where brand awareness, channels, installer capability and market acceptance need to be built from scratch.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. India Market Entry \& Business Build\-Up** 



* Establish Zehnder’s presence in India.
* Develop and execute a practical go\-to\-market plan for India.
* Identify priority customer segments, geographies and project types.
* Build Zehnder’s visibility among architects, consultants, developers, contractors and premium project decision\-makers.
* Generate qualified project pipeline and secure early reference projects.
* Provide regular market intelligence, competitor insights and customer feedback to Zehnder’s global leadership team.



  





**2\. Ventilation, Fresh\-Air \& Indoor Climate Business Development** 



* Lead market development for Zehnder’s balanced energy recovery ventilation systems
 **(ERV/ HRV, fresh air)** 
 with focus on the residential market.
* Build demand around the need for healthy indoor air, controlled ventilation, humidity management, energy efficiency and premium indoor comfort.
* Educate the market on the difference between air purification, air\-conditioning and engineered balanced energy recovery ventilation systems.
* Position Zehnder as a premium, technically superior and performance\-led indoor climate solution provider.



  





**3\. Premium / Luxury Project Sales** 



* Identify and develop opportunities in premium and luxury building projects.
* Target relevant segments such as luxury residential developments, branded residences, HNI villas, premium apartments, wellness spaces, high\-end hospitality, international schools, healthcare and select green building projects.
* Build relationships with premium developers, architects, interior designers, consultants, villa owners, project owners and HNI\-focused ecosystem partners.
* Sell on value, performance, comfort, health, acoustics, energy efficiency and lifecycle benefit, not on price alone.



  





**4\. Specification \& Project Sales** 



* Drive specification\-led selling by engaging architects, MEP consultants, HVAC consultants, green building consultants, PMCs, developers and contractors.
* Influence projects at the design and specification stage, before tendering and commercial negotiation.
* Develop technical presentations, concept notes and project\-specific value propositions.
* Support the creation of BOQ inputs, specification language, product comparisons, technical submittals and project proposals.
* Ensure that Zehnder is positioned as a system solution, not merely a product or equipment supplier.



  





**5\. Partner Ecosystem Development** 



* Identify, evaluate and develop suitable channel partners, system partners, installers, integrators and commissioning partners.
* Build a limited but high\-quality partner network capable of selling, installing and servicing premium ventilation systems.
* Train partners on Zehnder’s product value proposition, installation standards, commissioning discipline and customer experience expectations.
* Ensure that partners have the capability to support premium projects and maintain Zehnder’s brand standards.
* Develop a partner model that protects pricing, service quality, installation quality and long\-term customer satisfaction.



  





**6\. Technical Selling \& Customer Education** 



* Explain Zehnder’s solutions convincingly to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Communicate the benefits of balanced ventilation, fresh\-air supply, energy recovery, humidity control, filtration, low\-noise operation and indoor air quality.
* Conduct presentations, seminars, consultant meetings, architect discussions, CPD\-style sessions and industry engagements.
* Build awareness among the market that premium indoor climate is about air quality, comfort, health and performance \- not only cooling.



  





**7\. Brand Representation \& Executive Presence** 



* Act as the face of Zehnder in India.
* Represent the company in senior client meetings, industry forums, trade events, consultant interactions and partner discussions.
* Build credibility with Indian stakeholders while maintaining alignment with Zehnder’s European quality, brand and business standards.
* Communicate clearly with Zehnder’s global leadership team on India market realities, opportunities, challenges and progress.



  





**Ideal Candidate Profile** 




  





**Experience** 



* 10–15 years of experience in HVAC, ventilation, building technology, indoor air quality, air filtration, fresh\-air systems, ERV/HRV, heat recovery, energy recovery, related technical building solutions.
* Experience in premium or specification\-led project sales is strongly preferred.
* Prior exposure to international companies, European brands, premium technical products or MNC environments will be an advantage.
* Experience in building a new business vertical, product category, region, partner network or market from an early stage will be highly valued.



  





**Product / Sector Exposure** 




 The ideal candidate should have exposure to one or more of the following:
 


* **Balanced energy recovery ventilation systems (ERV/ HRV, fresh air)**
* **Residential ventilation systems**
* Heat recovery / energy recovery
* Indoor air quality solutions
* Air filtration / clean\-air solutions
* Premium HVAC systems
* Green building / energy\-efficient building solutions



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




 We are looking for a commercially strong, self\-driven professional with a builder mindset. The right candidate will be someone who has the maturity of working with international companies, but also the agility, ownership, and entrepreneurial drive required to build a business in a new market.
 



  





**Key Competencies** 




 ▪ Strong business development and pipeline creation capability
 



 ▪ Ability to build markets, channels, and partnerships from the ground up
 



 ▪ Commercially sharp and opportunity\-driven
 



 ▪ Strong network in HVAC / ventilation / building technology ecosystem
 



 ▪ Good understanding of specification\-led and project\-led sales
 



 ▪ Ability to work independently with limited local infrastructure
 



 ▪ High ownership, initiative, and accountability
 



 ▪ Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
 



 ▪ Comfortable working with international leadership teams
 



 ▪ Strategic thinking with hands\-on execution capability
 



  





**Why This Role Is Exciting** 




 ▪ Opportunity to lead the India market entry for a respected European brand
 



 ▪ First commercial leadership role for Zehnder in India
 



 ▪ High ownership and visibility with global leadership
 



 ▪ Opportunity to shape market strategy, channel structure, and early business growth
 



 ▪ Ideal role for a professional who enjoys building, not just managing.

title: International Policy & Communications Lead, India (Director)
description:
**Role Description**
* Develop and manage strategic policy initiatives to support Pfizer's business in India.
* Develop and implement innovative policy strategic platforms to support Pfizer’s business, including but not limited to creation of broader industry coalitions and platforms to advance Pfizer’s objectives.
* Serve as thought partner to the Head of IPC EM and the India Country President in anticipating and assessing the impact of the external policy environment on business strategy.
* Develops and leads Policy, Communications and Patient Advocacy strategies across India to support key Pfizer and business unit priorities, including access, pricing, intellectual property, localization, life\-course immunization, and stakeholder engagement.
* Executive support for the Country President and local country\-level external communications programs, with the support of the local IPC team, that drive business objectives and strengthen Pfizer’s reputation in India.


**ROLE RESPONSIBILTIES**
**Strategic planning and implementation**
* Proactively assesses trends, policies and identifies key opportunities and threats.
* Prepares informational materials for management, highlighting opportunities and potential threats and works in partnership with the Head of IPC EM to develop responsive strategies where such developments could impact business operations.
* Utilizes Pfizer corporate policy positions to develop targeted political strategies and action plans.
* Develops and implements a macro\-level strategic policy plan that effectively shapes the environment to create a favorable operating environment for Pfizer.
* Leverages insights and knowledge to create a vision for the future and position Pfizer as a preferred partner.
* Prioritizes and drives both long\-term and short\-term opportunities.
* Works in partnership with the Head of IPC EM, Country President and local functional teams to develop innovative policy strategies that proactively shape the environment for launch of new assets.
* Adapt and implement TA\-level policy strategies and tactics to support access to Pfizer products address the patient affordability challenge.


**External Relations**
* Participates in advocacy functions at trade and business associations at a local level, as required.
* Establishes, maintains and consistently leverages relationships with policy makers, think tanks, patient advocacy groups and other organizations to advance Pfizer’s strategic priorities and ensure Pfizer’s position is reflected in advocacy materials.
* Supports the development of briefing materials for external engagements.
* Appropriately and effectively tailors Pfizer International policy positions to local market dynamics.
* Maintains strict compliance with all applicable policies and laws, especially those related to interactions with government officials.


**Patient Advocacy**
* Develop and lead the implementation of country strategic, pro\-active agenda with internal and external stakeholders
* Provide leadership and direction for all cross functional engagement with targeted key stakeholders, including current and future patients, and serve as a key relationship manager, leading and/or guiding relationships with patient and professional advocacy organizations as appropriate.
* Communicates on key topics such as IP, health reform, access to medicines, pricing, trade agreements, etc. through the development of briefing notes, position papers, talking points, as well as relevant correspondence, proposals and presentations.
* Provide strategic counsel and tactical communications support to the Country President, as well as country marketing teams and other functions in order to develop external communications country plans aligned with the business vision, mission and key priorities.
* Work collaboratively across functions in the business to manage proactive and reactive external communications.
* Partner with commercial teams in India, ensuring alignment with global messaging and priorities and that local teams have the external communications support needed to execute local business strategies.
* Provide strategic communications counsel and messaging support for country leadership with internal and external stakeholders to ensure alignment and consistency with Pfizer corporate narratives and international policy messaging.


**Leadership**
* Serves as key thought partner to the Country President and Commercial Leads in assessing the impact of the external policy environment on business strategy. Provide strategic counsel in business planning decisions including but not limited to operating plan discussions and business reviews.
* Coordinates and prepares the LT for external engagements.
* Ensures that the local management team understand the impact of Policy \& Comms activities and role in supporting the BU commercial goals.


**ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS**
* Internal: H\&V, Legal, Commercial, Medical, Regulatory, IPC regional and global team.
* External: Academics, trade associations, policy makers, government officials, patient advocacy groups, consultants, media and key influencers.


**Qualification And Experience**
* Minimum of 10 years of experience in public policy, strategy or consulting related to policy, government relations, and/or corporate affairs.
* Bachelor degree required. Advanced Degree in health/public policy, international affairs, political science, and/or law preferred
* Deep knowledge of healthcare policy and pharmaceutical pricing and reimbursement issues. Excellent knowledge of the local healthcare system and its major players and decision\-makers.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and execute effective, innovative and practical policy/public affairs and policy solutions and comprehensive plans that deliver results.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and deploy appropriate "public affairs and policy" tools (advocacy, lobbying, stakeholder engagement plans).
* Strong understanding of business strategy and key drivers of commercial success
* Highly skilled at anticipating, identifying, and addressing emerging issues and related risks that could impact Pfizer's business
* Strong ability to develop relationships with key stakeholders. Skilled at advocacy influence within internal/external matrix organizations. Skilled at navigating complex environments through range of internal and external stakeholders.
* Strong executive presence and interpersonal acumen, highly substantive and collaborative. Demonstrated ability to succinctly convey relevant information at the right time and with the proper context and seek input as needed.
* Excellent oral and written communications skills.
* Excellent command of English language. Fluency in English required; fluency in Hindi or another relevant Indian language preferred.


**RESOURCES MANAGED**
* Financial Accountability – Responsible for managing local Policy \& Communications budgets.
* Supervision – Local team (2 colleagues), local agency resources in India, as applicable.

title: Independent Director
description:
**Why a marketing\-led Independent Director** 




  





 The company provides integrated marketing services spanning creative development, media, analytics and research. Its Board seeks an experienced marketing and agency\-business leader to challenge the strategy for entering and expanding in EU markets. The appointment must bring independent judgment about where the company's capabilities create a defensible proposition, how local credibility will be earned and what organisational and financial commitments expansion requires.
 



  





 The Director is not being appointed to act as a commissioned salesperson, introduce clients for fees or manage a European business unit. Expansion advice will be exercised through the statutory Board role. Executive management retains responsibility for sales, negotiations, hiring and delivery.
 



  





**The EU expansion decision** 




  





 The Director will help the Board distinguish a coherent market thesis from an ambition to establish a presence. Evaluate demand by service line, customer need, buying behaviour, procurement expectations, language, cultural adaptation, delivery model and margin. Creative reputation in one market does not automatically transfer into local insight or a credible integrated offering in another.
 



  





 Market selection should consider the company's actual right\-to\-win, available leadership, referenceable work, partner capability, client concentration and full cost of entry. The Board should approve specific commitments rather than a broad mandate to pursue Europe. Every entry case needs a staged investment, accountable executive, downside funding, review point and exit option.
 



  





**Integration is a promise to the client** 




  





 Challenge whether creative, media, analytics and research operate as one proposition or four services joined in a pitch. Review client leadership, planning, pricing, shared briefs, scope ownership, data access, delivery assurance and escalation. Cross\-selling should create demonstrable client value rather than increase internal referrals without improving outcomes.
 



  





 The Director will examine which work can be delivered from existing operations, which requires local teams and which should remain with specialist partners. Offshore efficiency must be evaluated alongside time zones, language, research validity, creative relevance, client access and responsible supervision. Non\-standard commitments should carry explicit commercial and delivery approval.
 



  





**Money, measurement and market trust** 




  





 Oversee client and service\-line profitability after talent, freelance and production cost, media commitments, research procurement, analytics infrastructure, travel, rework, working capital and local management. Media billings, pass\-throughs and agency income must be clearly distinguished. The Board needs to understand who holds customer money, who commits spend and how balances are reconciled.
 



 Review rebates, principal\-agent relationships, connected suppliers, incentives, subcontractors and commercial transparency. Performance and audience claims should identify observed facts, modelled estimates, attribution assumptions and limitations. Research quality requires suitable samples, methods, consent, participant protection and honest treatment of uncertainty.
 



  





 AI\-generated creative, synthetic content, analytical tools and automated research introduce questions of intellectual property, authenticity, confidentiality and evidence. The Director should ensure that product and client claims do not outrun the company's ability to substantiate them.
 



  





**Local accountability before launch** 




  





 Require qualified legal and tax advice on proposed entities, employment, contracting, advertising, consumer conduct, privacy, research, IP and data transfer arrangements. The Director will challenge the completeness of this advice and its translation into operating controls, without substituting personal opinion for specialist conclusions.
 



  





 Client contracts should specify deliverables, scope change, data and IP rights, subcontracting, media authority, liability, acceptance, payment and termination. Customer information and campaign data must not be repurposed across clients or used to train external models without appropriate authority and safeguards.
 



  





 For acquisitions or partnerships, assess cultural compatibility, key\-person retention, client conflicts, ownership of work and data, hidden media or production commitments, deferred obligations, claims and the cost of integration. A local relationship network is not an adequate valuation thesis if it depends on one individual who may leave.
 



  





**Leadership and independent governance** 




  





 Help the Board appoint and evaluate international leadership, define delegation and build succession across client service, creative, media, analytics, research and finance. Incentives should reward retained clients, collected contribution, delivery quality and conduct rather than bookings or expansion announcements alone.
 



  





 The Director should expect Board reporting on pipeline quality, active and retained clients, service mix, scope leakage, delivery, collections, media balances, research and measurement exceptions, client conflicts, privacy and IP events, talent retention, investment consumed and returns against the approved expansion thesis.
 



  





 Protected escalation must be available where employees believe a client claim is misleading, data is being misused, media commitments are unauthorised or commercial pressure is compromising research integrity.

title: Business Head – School Partnerships
description:
HEAD – SALES
   

  

**Department:** 
 Sales \& Business Development
   

  

**Location:** 
 Delhi NCR / Pan India
   

  

**Reports To:** 
 CEO / Business Leadership
   

  

**About EdTerra**
 EdTerra Edventures is a leading experiential learning and educational travel company that designs and delivers immersive learning journeys for school students across India and international destinations.
   

  

 We partner with schools to create meaningful experiences that combine travel, learning, culture, adventure and real\-world exposure.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for a
 **Head – Sales** 
 to lead EdTerra's sales function and drive the next phase of revenue growth.
   

  

 This is a
 **business leadership role** 
 with end\-to\-end ownership of the sales engine—from market strategy and school acquisition to key account growth, sales\-team performance, forecasting and revenue delivery.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will be a commercially strong, data\-driven and inspiring sales leader who can build scalable sales systems while personally driving strategic relationships with large schools and institutional partners.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities1\. Revenue \& Business Growth
   

  

* Own the overall sales revenue, growth and commercial performance for the business.
* Develop and execute the annual and quarterly sales strategy in line with organizational objectives.
* Translate business targets into territory, segment, product and team\-level targets.
* Identify new revenue opportunities across geographies, school segments and products.
* Drive both new business acquisition and growth of existing accounts.
* Develop strategies to increase customer lifetime value, repeat business and wallet share.
* School \& Institutional Partnerships
* Build and maintain strong relationships with school management, principals, trustees, coordinators and other key decision\-makers.
* Lead negotiations and closures for strategic/high\-value school accounts.
* Develop long\-term partnerships with schools and educational institutions.
* Create account\-development plans for key schools.
* Drive cross\-selling and up\-selling across EdTerra's domestic, international and experiential learning programmes.
* Act as the senior escalation point for strategic clients.
* Sales Team Leadership
* Lead and mentor the complete sales organization across regions/functions.
* Define team structures, roles, territories, targets and performance expectations.
* Recruit, coach and develop high\-performing sales managers and sales professionals.
* Establish a strong culture of ownership, accountability and performance.
* Conduct structured weekly, monthly and quarterly business reviews.
* Identify capability gaps and implement targeted coaching and development plans.
* Build a strong succession pipeline for critical sales positions.
* Sales Process \& Performance Management
* Build a predictable and scalable sales process from lead generation → qualification → meetings → proposals → negotiation → closure → repeat business.
* Establish clear sales KPIs and performance dashboards.
* Monitor conversion ratios at every stage of the funnel.
* Improve sales productivity and reduce sales\-cycle time.
* Ensure disciplined CRM usage and accurate pipeline management.
* Establish mechanisms for identifying and resolving pipeline bottlenecks.
* Forecasting \& Business Intelligence
* Own the monthly and quarterly sales forecast.
* Maintain strong visibility on pipeline value, probability and expected closures.
* Develop accurate revenue projections based on historical performance and current pipeline.
* Use sales data to identify trends, risks and opportunities.
* Present actionable sales insights and recommendations to the leadership team.
* Develop territory\-wise and account\-wise performance dashboards.
* Market Expansion
* Identify and evaluate new cities, regions and school segments for expansion.
* Analyse competitor positioning, pricing, offerings and market trends.
* Develop go\-to\-market strategies for new products and markets.
* Identify emerging opportunities within the education and experiential\-learning ecosystem.
* Work with the leadership team to evaluate strategic partnerships and new business channels.
* Key Account Growth \& Retention
* Build a structured Key Account Management framework.
* Develop annual growth plans for strategic schools.
* Drive repeat journeys, renewals and increased engagement with existing schools.
* Monitor account health, satisfaction and revenue potential.
* Ensure high\-value clients receive proactive relationship management.
* Work with Operations and Customer Experience teams to resolve critical client concerns.
* Commercial \& Margin Ownership
* Balance revenue growth with profitability and contribution margins.
* Participate in pricing and commercial strategy.
* Establish appropriate discounting and negotiation frameworks.
* Monitor deal economics and commercial effectiveness.
* Work closely with Finance to improve collection efficiency and reduce outstanding receivables.
* Ensure sales commitments remain commercially and operationally viable.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration


**Work Closely With**
* Marketing – lead generation, campaigns and brand positioning
* Product – product development, pricing and market fit
* Operations – delivery feasibility and execution
* Finance – pricing, margins, collections and commercial controls
* HR – manpower planning, hiring and capability development
* Customer Experience – client satisfaction and retention


 Ensure seamless alignment between
 **what is sold, what is promised and what is delivered** 
 .
   

  

 Success in the First 12 Months
   

  

**The Successful Candidate Will Be Expected To**
* Deliver agreed annual revenue and growth targets.
* Build a predictable and healthy sales pipeline.
* Improve sales conversion and sales productivity.
* Strengthen the key\-school account portfolio.
* Increase repeat business and customer retention.
* Build a high\-performing and accountable sales leadership team.
* Improve forecast accuracy.
* Establish standardized sales processes and performance dashboards.
* Identify and successfully penetrate new markets.
* Improve revenue quality and contribution margins.


 Key Performance Indicators
   

  

**Business**
* Revenue Achievement %
* YoY Revenue Growth
* Gross Contribution / Margin
* New Revenue


**Acquisition**
* New Schools Acquired
* New Revenue from New Accounts
* Conversion Rate
* Average Deal Value


**Retention \& Growth**
* Repeat Revenue %
* School Retention
* Key Account Growth
* Revenue per Strategic Account


**Sales Productivity**
* Pipeline Coverage
* Sales Cycle
* Lead\-to\-Meeting Conversion
* Meeting\-to\-Closure Conversion
* Individual \& Team Productivity


**Forecasting**
* Forecast Accuracy
* Pipeline Health
* Closure Predictability


**People**
* Team Target Achievement
* Sales Attrition
* Manager Productivity
* Internal Talent Development


 Candidate ProfileExperience
   

  

* 10–15\+ years of progressive experience in B2B / institutional / consultative sales.
* 4\+ years in a senior sales leadership role managing sizeable sales teams.
* Proven experience owning significant revenue targets.
* Experience managing multi\-city or multi\-region sales operations preferred.
* Strong experience in relationship\-led businesses such as education, EdTech, travel, hospitality, SaaS, media or other B2B services will be advantageous.


 Education
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in any relevant discipline.
* MBA/PGDM in Sales, Marketing, Business Management or a related field preferred.


 Core Competencies
   

  

* Strategic Sales Leadership
* Revenue \& P\&L Orientation
* B2B / Institutional Sales
* Enterprise/Key Account Management
* Negotiation \& Commercial Acumen
* Sales Forecasting
* CRM \& Sales Analytics
* Market Expansion
* Team Building \& Leadership
* Coaching \& Performance Management
* Cross\-functional Collaboration
* Executive Communication


 Leadership Traits We Value
   

  

**We Are Looking For Someone Who**
* Thinks like a business owner, not just a salesperson.
* Is highly accountable for outcomes.
* Can operate strategically while remaining close to the ground.
* Uses data to make decisions.
* Builds strong, long\-term relationships.
* Can challenge existing processes and create better systems.
* Develops people rather than simply managing them.
* Is comfortable working in a fast\-paced, growth\-oriented environment.
* Has the energy and maturity to represent EdTerra with senior school stakeholders.


 Why Join EdTerra?
   

  

 At EdTerra, sales is not simply about selling a product.
   

  

 It is about building long\-term partnerships with schools and helping create experiences that can have a lasting impact on students.
   

  

 As Head – Sales, you will have the opportunity to
 **shape the sales organization, influence business strategy, build a high\-performing team and directly contribute to EdTerra's next phase of growth.**

title: APAC Business Marketing Manager, AI Ecosystem
description:
At Meta, we believe AI transforms how people and businesses connect and grow. Our mission is to enable and inspire developers to build with Meta's AI models and new monetization businesses, cultivating a thriving AI Ecosystem grounded in innovation and trust.We're seeking a Business Marketing Manager for AI Ecosystem to grow the awareness, adoption, and sentiment of Meta's AI models and new monetization businesses with developers across the ecosystem including individual builders, startups, enterprises, and industry associations, spanning APAC's diverse markets. This role spans developers, ecosystem partners, and enterprise audiences, and it requires both a technical lens on AI models and demonstrated marketing acumen, from strategy through execution. You'll own the APAC go\-to\-market plan, combining day\-to\-day operational execution with longer\-term strategic planning.
   

  

 APAC Business Marketing Manager, AI Ecosystem Responsibilities:
   

  

* Build and execute the AI developer marketing strategy for APAC to deliver on Meta's goal of having the most widely adopted AI models and products in the world
* Own the localized go\-to\-market plan: translate global launches and product\-sourced narratives into locally resonant activations that address developer jobs\-to\-be\-done across APAC priority markets
* Turn technical messaging, assets, and documentation into developer\-ready content — blogs, videos, tutorials, demos, events, and solution guides — tailored to local audiences
* Drive the hybrid GTM motion across developers, partners, and enterprise: equip ecosystem partners, cloud providers, and enterprise engineering teams with the technical narrative and assets they need
* Plan and execute developer\-first programs: hackathons, workshops, technical conference presence, community engagement, and digital campaigns
* Work directly with developers, partners, and customers across APAC to pressure\-test messaging, gather feedback, and channel technical requirements back to product and engineering
* Use adoption data, developer funnel signals, and community sentiment to guide decisions and measure performance
* establish clear operating rhythms and provide regular business and scorecard updates
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with product marketing, product and engineering, developer relations, partnerships, digital marketing, events, communications, legal, and privacy
* Manage external vendors and agencies as needed to scale content and program production


 Minimum Qualifications:
   

  

* 10\+ years of professional experience in technology, developer/platform marketing, or B2B technology marketing in APAC
* Experience marketing technical products to a developer, ML engineering, or data science audience — including a demonstrated understanding of the developer/ML persona (workflows, tooling, evaluation criteria, pain points) and the ability to build technically credible positioning and messaging
* Working knowledge of how developers build with AI — how they evaluate models, integrate them into their stack, and deploy — across the build, fine\-tune, evaluate, and deploy lifecycle
* Experience developing technical content: tutorials, technical blog posts, videos, demos, benchmark or architecture explainers
* Experience operating across hybrid audiences: individual developers and communities, ecosystem/platform partners, and enterprise engineering organizations
* Marketing experience launching and driving adoption of new technical products in the GenAI space
* Experience working cross\-functionally with product, engineering, developer relations, research, analytics, and digital marketing
* Experience using data to measure adoption and sentiment and optimize outcomes within a measurable framework
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, marketing, business, analytics, or a related discipline
* AI\-native across the marketing workflow: uses AI tools as default practice for planning, operations, research, campaign production and reporting


 Preferred Qualifications:
   

  

* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience with developer\-led or product\-led growth, and measuring developer funnel signals (downloads, API calls, repository activity, retention)
* Experience engaging maintainer and contributor communities
* Active member of the AI Ecosystem and developer community, with contributions, technical writing, or conference speaking
* Experience implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality/accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience with the APAC developer ecosystem — including startups, enterprises, and government agencies
* Professional fluency in one or more regional languages (e.g., Mandarin, Japanese, Korean, Bahasa Indonesia, Vietnamese, or Hindi) is a plus because the role requires direct engagement with developers, partners, and customers in local APAC markets where business is conducted in the local language


 About Meta:
   

  

 Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.
   

  

 Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

title: Brand Manager - Ostocalcium

**Job Posting End Date**
 2026\-10\-17
