title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
**About noon** 




 We’re building an ecosystem of digital products and services that power everyday life across the Middle East—fast, scalable, and deeply customer\-centric. Our mission is to deliver to every door every day. We want to redefine what technology can do in this region, and we’re looking for a Digital Marketing Manager who can help us move even faster.
 



  





**noon’s mission: Every door, every day.** 




  





**About Dubai Mall** 




 The Dubai Mall Online is the official digital platform of Dubai Mall, bringing together the mall’s iconic retail brands into a single online shopping destination. Powered by best\-in\-class e\-commerce technology, logistics, and customer experience capabilities, the platform enables customers to discover, shop, and receive products from multiple Dubai Mall retailers through a seamless digital journey.
 



  





 Joining The Dubai Mall Online offers a unique opportunity to help build and scale a high\-growth business from the ground up, working alongside some of the world’s most recognized brands while shaping the future of omnichannel retail in the GCC.
 



  





**What you'll do:** 




 As the Digital Marketing Manager, you will take full ownership of the paid user acquisition strategy, multi\-channel performance media, and app growth for Dubai Mall Online. This role bridges analytical rigor with high\-scale campaign execution to drive installs and first\-order conversion. You will work closely with external media agencies, Analytics, Commercial, and the Emaar ecosystem team to operationalize our paid media stack across Meta, Google, TikTok, and App Stores, ensuring a growing customer base while maintaining optimal Customer Acquisition Costs (CAC).
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 •
 **Own Paid Acquisition Strategy:** 
 Lead end\-to\-end performance marketing across core digital channels including Meta (Advantage\+/DPA), Google Ads (PMax/App Campaigns), TikTok, Apple Search Ads (ASA), and Google Search.
 



 •
 **Media Agency Governance:** 
 Manage day\-to\-day campaign operations, directing account structures, budget allocation, bidding strategies, and holding the agency accountable to tight CPI and CAC scorecards.
 



 •
 **App Store Optimization (ASO):** 
 Direct the optimization of iOS App Store and Google Play Store listings in both English and Arabic, managing screenshots, preview videos, keyword defense strategies, and ATT prompt sequencing.
 



 •
 **MMP \& Tracking Operations:** 
 Partner with Tech and Analytics to ensure flawless execution of Adjust tracking, SKAN 4\.0 schema configuration, deferred deep\-linking infrastructure, and attribution logic across the entire paid media stack.
 



 •
 **Creative Variant Strategy:** 
 Supply the creative vision and testing roadmap for paid campaigns, ensuring the continuous delivery of high\-performing, localized (EN \& AR) video and static ad formats.
 



 •
 **Dynamic Catalog \& Feed\-Based Marketing:** 
 Own the commercial execution of feed\-driven ad formats (Meta Dynamic Product Ads, Google Merchant Center feeds, TikTok Catalog Sales campaigns). Manage product feed architecture, custom label segmentation (e.g., luxury vs. lifestyle, margin bands, high\-stock SKUs, top sellers), and automated dynamic retargeting funnels across hundreds of tenant doors.
 



 •
 **Feed Health \& Catalog Troubleshooting:** 
 Partner closely with Senior Digital Merchandisers and Platform Tech to monitor catalog feed health, resolve item disapprovals, fix missing attribute/GTIN errors, and enforce real\-time price and inventory sync frequencies to protect ad spend efficiency.
 



 •
 **Channel\-Level Problem Solving:** 
 Act as the primary point of escalation for platform approvals, navigating Google Merchant Center feed integrations, Meta domain verifications, and App Store review blockages.
 



 •
 **Promotional Campaign Phasing:** 
 Align performance media spend with the onsite merchandising calendar, synchronizing ad budgets with critical shopping events, payday windows, and major brand launches.
 



 •
 **Budget Management \& Pacing:** 
 Control the performance media budget, utilizing daily spend APIs and war\-room dashboards to dynamically shift budgets across channels to maximize return on ad spend (ROAS).
 



  





**What You'll Need** 




 • 5\+ years of experience leading digital acquisition and performance marketing for consumer mobile apps, multi\-brand e\-commerce platforms, or retail marketplaces.
 



 • Demonstrated expertise in dynamic feed\-based marketing, Google Merchant Center management, Meta Dynamic Product Ads (DPA), and custom label catalog taxonomy.
 



 • Hands\-on experience managing campaign budgets natively within Meta Business Manager, Google Ads, TikTok Ads Manager, and Apple Search Ads Advanced.
 



 • Proven track record of managing global performance marketing agencies and holding external partners accountable to stringent ROI metrics.
 



 • Exceptional data fluency and analytical capability, with a relentless focus on customer acquisition cost (CAC), conversion rates, and incremental lift.
 



 • Entrepreneurial mindset, comfortable navigating technical ad\-ops and catalog feed challenges from scratch in a high\-velocity, pre\-launch environment.
 



 • Professional fluency in English; Arabic language proficiency is a strong advantage.
 



  





**Who will excel?** 




 • We’re looking for people with high standards, who understand that hard work matters.
 



 • You need to be relentlessly resourceful and operate with a deep bias for action.
 



 • We need people with the courage to be fiercely original.
 



 • noon is not for everyone; readiness to adapt, pivot, and learn is essential.

description:

CLIPS \& SHORTS • Identify the strongest moments from every podcast and brief editors with timestamps, hooks and content angles. • Package Shorts and long\-form clips for discovery and move viewers naturally towards the full podcast. • Track which topics, guests and formats repeatedly perform and use those learnings in future releases. INSTAGRAM – 2 ACCOUNTS • Plan, schedule and publish Reels/Stories/posts with strong hooks, covers and captions. • Monitor reach, watch time, shares, saves and follower growth; build repeatable formats from winning content. • Use Instagram strategically to support podcast discovery without making every post promotional. PERSONAL \& VERTICAL CONTENT • Manage Deep Verma personal\-brand content and Acharya Ji social content as separate content identities. • Turn shoots, behind\-the\-scenes moments, opinions and podcast footage into relevant short\-form content. CONTENT PLANNING \& TRENDS • Maintain one practical weekly/monthly calendar covering podcasts, clips, Shorts, Reels and collaborations. • Track relevant trends across spirituality, paranormal, tantra, supernatural and adjacent categories. • Share timely content opportunities with editors/designers and keep publishing deadlines on track. **Brand Building**



* Contribute to developing and strengthening
 
**BVM's overall brand identity**

* Have a strong understanding of

* 3\+ years of experience in
 
**social media, content strategy, digital marketing or brand management**

**content strategy, social media trends and audience behaviour**

**growth marketing, paid promotion and performance metrics**

 The candidate should be comfortable working with and reviewing work in:
 



* **Adobe Creative Suite**

* **Figma**

**not**

**events, exhibitions, B2B, business, government or large\-scale campaigns**

 We're looking for someone who can sit between

**Position:** 

 Full\-Time, In\-House
 




**Location:** 

 Central Delhi

 Please share your

title: Social Media Strategy Manager
description:

From tactical campaigns to far\-reaching transformational programs, the team at Scatter works on growing our partners' businesses.  City: Delhi 
 



  





  
 



 Key Responsibilities 
 



  





 New Account Onboarding 
 



  





 Own the onboarding of our upcoming marquee accounts, translating the client's brand and business objectives into a clear social\-first strategy from day one. 
 



  





 Lead the platform strategy, content pillars, and posting cadence for the account across relevant social platforms. 
 



  





 Existing Accounts

 Drive the quarterly and monthly content calendars, campaign concepts, and platform\-specific strategies for the account. 
 



  





 Track and report on content performance, using data to sharpen strategy and improve engagement, reach, and conversion metrics. 
 



  





 Build strong working relationships with client stakeholders and represent Scatter confidently in strategy calls and reviews.

 Stay ahead of platform algorithm changes, format trends, and emerging social behaviours, and translate these into actionable recommendations for clients. 
 



  





 Collaborate closely with content, design, and video teams to ensure strategy translates into high\-quality creative output. 
 



  





 Mentor junior executives on the team, reviewing their content plans and coaching them on strategic thinking.

 Qualifications 
 



  





 5\+ years of experience working exclusively in social media strategy, community management, or social\-first content roles (agency experience mandatory). 
 



  





 Proven track record of growing and managing social media accounts end\-to\-end, from strategy to execution to reporting.

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
We’re looking for a \*hands\-on Head of Marketing / Growth Lead\* to own marketing end\-to\-end
 



  





 This is not a role for someone who only manages agencies, reviews dashboards, or creates strategy decks. We want an \*operator\* who can define the GTM strategy and then get into the tools and execute it.
 



  





 You’ll own the full growth engine — \*performance marketing, analytics, website \& CRO, SEO, content, and GTM.\*
 



  





 \#\# What You'll Own
 



  





 \#\#\# GTM \& Growth
 



  





 \* Own the marketing and go\-to\-market strategy end\-to\-end.
 



 \* Understand our ICP, customer journeys, use cases and buying triggers.
 



 \* Translate company goals into acquisition, activation and revenue targets.
 



 \* Identify new channels and growth opportunities and rapidly test them.
 



 \* Own the marketing funnel from first touch through conversion.
 



  





 \#\#\# Performance Marketing
 



  





 \* Personally manage and optimize paid acquisition across \*Google, Meta, LinkedIn and other relevant channels\*.
 



 \* Build campaigns, audiences, creatives, landing pages and experiments.
 



 \* Own CAC, CPL, conversion rates, ROAS and pipeline contribution.
 



 \* Continuously test messaging, targeting, channels and offers.
 



 \* Scale what works and kill what doesn't.
 



  





 \#\#\# Analytics \& Attribution
 



  





 \* Own marketing measurement across \*GA4, GTM and our analytics stack\*.
 



 \* Ensure conversion tracking and attribution are set up correctly.
 



 \* Build dashboards for acquisition, funnel performance and revenue.
 



 \* Diagnose funnel drop\-offs and identify opportunities using data.
 



 \* Make marketing decisions based on numbers rather than intuition alone.
 



  





 \#\#\# Website \& CRO
 



  





 \* Own the website as a growth channel.
 



 \* Improve positioning, messaging, landing pages and conversion journeys.
 



 \* Work directly in our CMS and with design/development where needed.
 



 \* Run structured CRO and A/B testing.
 



 \* Create landing pages for campaigns, segments and use cases.
 



  





 \#\#\# SEO \& Content
 



  





 \* Build and execute our organic growth strategy.
 



 \* Own technical, on\-page and content\-led SEO.
 



 \* Identify high\-intent keywords and content opportunities.
 



 \* Build briefs and work with writers/designers where required.
 



 \* Create a content engine that contributes to traffic, sign\-ups and revenue — not content for content's sake.
 



  





 \#\# Who We're Looking For
 



  





 You probably have \*2\-4 years of experience\* across growth, performance or digital marketing.
 



  





 More importantly, you have actually \*done the work yourself\*.
 



  





 You should be comfortable opening Google Ads in the morning, looking at GA4 and funnel data in the afternoon, rewriting a landing page, identifying an SEO opportunity and then deciding where the next ₹1 lakh of marketing budget should go.
 



  





 \#\#\# Must Have
 



  





 \* Strong hands\-on performance marketing experience.
 



 \* Strong Google Ads experience; Meta and/or LinkedIn Ads experience.
 



 \* Working knowledge of \*GA4, Google Tag Manager and conversion tracking\*.
 



 \* Experience owning or materially improving a website/landing pages.
 



 \* Understanding of \*CRO and experimentation\*.
 



 \* Strong understanding of SEO and content\-led acquisition.
 



 \* Ability to analyse funnels and turn data into actions.
 



 \* Strong copy, messaging and positioning instincts.
 



 \* Experience owning meaningful marketing budgets.
 



 \* Bias toward execution and experimentation.
 



  





 \#\#\# Strong Plus
 



  





 \* B2B SaaS experience.
 



 \* Product\-led growth / self\-serve SaaS experience.
 



 \* Experience marketing to international customers.
 



 \* Experience in collaboration software, MarTech, event\-tech, productivity or adjacent SaaS categories.
 



 \* Experience building a growth function from an early stage.
 



  





 \#\# What We're NOT Looking For
 



  





 This probably isn't the right role if your experience is primarily:
 



  





 \* Managing agencies without personally running campaigns.
 



 \* Brand/social media marketing without measurable acquisition ownership.
 



 \* Managing a large marketing team while being removed from execution.
 



 \* Performance marketing limited to reporting rather than campaign ownership.
 



 \* SEO or content alone without broader growth experience.
 



  





 \#\# What Success Looks Like
 



  





 Within your first few months, you should be able to clearly answer:
 



  





 \*Where are our best customers coming from?\*
 



  





 \*What does it cost to acquire them?\*
 



  





 \*Where are we losing users in the funnel?\*
 



  





 \*Which messages, audiences and channels convert best?\*
 



  





 \*What should we invest the next ₹10 lakh of marketing budget into — and why?\*
 



  





 And then execute against those answers.
 



  





 \#\# Location \& Compensation
 



  





 \*Location:\* Gurgaon / Gurugram(Hybrid)
 



 \*Compensation:\* ₹10\-15 LPA, depending on experience and demonstrated ability.
 



  





 We're open to someone already leading marketing, or a \*high\-performing Growth / Performance Marketing Manager ready to step up and own the entire function.\*
 



  




* The title matters less to us than your ability to \*own the number and execute.

Maker Lab's cross\-functional teams of multidisciplinary specialists are embedded into client teams across digital marketing competencies — from measurement \& analytics to content production.
   





 Social Media Manager
   





 Maker Lab supports clients across technology, entertainment, financial services and the payments industry. We're looking for dynamic individuals to join our team and support our amazing clients in the music and entertainment industry.
 



 We are looking for a Social Media Manager who thrives at the intersection of creative content strategy, real\-time cultural intelligence, and performance analytics. You will join a high\-impact team supporting a diverse portfolio of product areas across an enterprise brand environment architecting content that resonates with audiences, drives platform\-native engagement, and surfaces the right cultural moments at the right time.
 



 Role: 
   





 Social Content \& Production Leadership
 


* Oversee and execute high\-velocity, platform\-first social content strategies across primary channels including Instagram, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn, X, and emerging platforms.
* Architect and maintain a rolling 30\-60\-90 day content roadmap that balances brand objectives, campaign priorities, and real\-time cultural opportunities.
* Instinctive pulse on internet culture from emerging formats and creator trends to platform shifts and viral moments and you know how to translate that awareness into brand\-relevant content strategy.
* Partner with creative directors, copywriters, and video production teams to ensure all assets meet rigorous platform best practices, brand standards, and delivery milestones.
* Lead end\-to\-end publishing workflows  from brief to asset delivery to live post including crafting platform\-optimised copy, captions, hashtag strategies, and metadata.

 Community \& Culture Listening
 


* Monitor real\-time cultural trends, social platform feature rollouts, and audience sentiment to surface strategic real\-time content opportunities before they peak.
* Act as the strategic cultural ear for the team  scanning platform trends, creator ecosystems, viral formats, and cultural conversations to identify moments the brand can authentically own.
* Translate community signals comments, DMs, sentiment shifts, and audience feedback into actionable creative insights for the wider content and strategy team.
* Foster a high\-loyalty community environment by acting as the strategic voice in brand interactions, ensuring every touchpoint builds long\-term audience trust and resonance.
* Stay ahead of algorithm shifts, social platform feature releases, and format innovations to ensure the content strategy is always platform\-native and forward\-looking.


- 


 Analytics \& Performance Intelligence
 


* Utilise native social analytics tools (Meta Insights, TikTok Analytics, YouTube Studio, LinkedIn Analytics) and third\-party platforms to track engagement, reach, audience growth, and campaign performance.
* Conduct regular deep\-dives into performance data synthesising metrics into clear, narrative\-driven reports that translate raw numbers into strategic recommendations.
* Lead A/B testing frameworks for content formats, copy variations, posting times, and creative approaches documenting learnings and iterating rapidly.
* Identify performance trends and audience behaviour patterns to inform both short\-term content pivots and long\-term strategy evolution.
* Present performance intelligence clearly to stakeholders — distilling complexity into actionable, decision\-ready insights.


- 


 End\-to\-End Project Management
 


* Own campaign timelines, asset delivery pipelines, stakeholder approvals, and content calendars across multiple concurrent product workstreams simultaneously.

* Proactively flag risks, blockers, and timeline conflicts early — never letting a dependency become a surprise.
* Partner closely with creative directors, copywriters, performance marketers, and regional product teams to ensure brand consistency and messaging alignment.



  

  





 You:
   




* BA/BS degree or equivalent experience.
* 5\-8 years of dedicated experience managing end\-to\-end social workflows within a leading agency environment or an enterprise\-scale global brand.
* Proven track record of balancing creative content development and management with rigorous project management, performance analytics, and stakeholder coordination.
* Deep understanding of platform\-native content strategy across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn, X, and emerging channels and the nuances that make content perform differently on each.

title: Ecommerce Manager
description:
**Job Title: E\-Commerce \& Marketplace Growth Manager** 




  





 We are looking for a highly driven and commercially minded
 **E\-Commerce \& Marketplace Growth Manager** 
 to take ownership of our online sales channels and drive growth across marketplaces, our website, and other digital commerce platforms.
 



  





 This is not a purely operational role. We are looking for someone who can think like a business owner—someone who can identify opportunities, improve sales, optimise profitability, study competitors, develop new product ideas, and build new revenue channels.
 



  





 The ideal candidate will manage and grow our presence across platforms such as
 **Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, our own website, and other relevant marketplaces and aggregator portals** 
 .
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Marketplace Management \& Growth** 



* Manage and grow sales across Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra and other relevant e\-commerce and aggregator platforms.
* Create, optimise and manage product listings, including titles, descriptions, keywords, images and product information.
* Monitor product performance and identify opportunities to improve sales and visibility.
* Plan and execute pricing, discounts, offers, bundles and promotional campaigns.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure inventory availability and minimise stock\-outs.
* Monitor product ratings, reviews, returns and customer feedback.
* Identify underperforming SKUs and develop strategies to improve or discontinue them.
* Identify high\-performing products and opportunities to scale them.



  





**2\. Website Sales \& Digital Commerce Growth** 



* Drive sales and growth through the company website.
* Identify opportunities to improve website conversion rates and customer experience.
* Create product bundles, combo offers, trial packs, family packs, premium packs and other initiatives to increase average order value.
* Develop cross\-selling and upselling opportunities across the product portfolio.
* Work with internal and external teams to improve product pages, offers and customer journeys.
* Develop strategies to increase repeat purchases and customer retention.



  





**3\. Customer Feedback, Testimonials \& Retention** 



* Develop and manage a structured process for collecting customer feedback.
* Conduct customer calls to understand product experience and satisfaction.
* Identify satisfied customers and collect written and video testimonials.
* Build a strong repository of customer reviews, testimonials and user\-generated content for use across digital platforms.
* Follow up with customers to encourage repeat purchases and referrals.
* Analyse customer complaints and feedback to identify opportunities for product and service improvement.



  





**4\. Competitor Research \& Pricing Strategy** 



* Continuously monitor competitors, their products, pricing, offers and promotions.
* Conduct regular market research to identify trending products and emerging opportunities.
* Identify products that competitors are selling successfully and evaluate whether they can be developed, manufactured or sourced in\-house.
* Work with internal teams to identify opportunities for competitive pricing while maintaining healthy margins.
* Prepare regular competitor and market intelligence reports for management.



  





**5\. New Product \& Revenue Opportunities** 



* Identify new product categories and opportunities that can generate additional revenue.
* Research products currently performing well in the market and assess their commercial potential.
* Identify opportunities to manufacture, source or develop products at competitive pricing.
* Work with internal teams to develop new SKUs, variants, sizes, bundles and product extensions.
* Explore high\-margin complementary products and add\-on opportunities.
* Present commercially viable new product and revenue ideas to management on a regular basis.



  





**6\. New Digital Sales Channels** 



* Identify and onboard relevant e\-commerce platforms, aggregator portals and other digital sales channels.
* Explore opportunities for affiliate marketing, referral programs and micro\-influencer partnerships.
* Develop strategies to increase direct\-to\-consumer sales and reduce dependency on any single marketplace.
* Identify potential opportunities in bulk orders, corporate sales, gifting and B2B partnerships where relevant.



  





**7\. Sales, Data \& Profitability** 



* Track daily, weekly and monthly sales performance across all channels.
* Monitor profitability at a product and channel level.
* Analyse the impact of discounts, commissions, returns and promotional campaigns on margins.
* Identify opportunities to reduce costs and improve profitability.
* Prepare regular MIS and growth reports for management.
* Take ownership of assigned revenue and growth targets.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 



* Proven experience in managing e\-commerce marketplaces such as Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra or similar platforms.
* Strong understanding of online product listings, pricing, promotions and marketplace operations.
* Commercial mindset with the ability to identify new sales and revenue opportunities.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to understand product profitability, margins and pricing.
* Experience with website sales and D2C e\-commerce will be an advantage.
* Comfortable speaking with customers and conducting feedback or testimonial calls.
* Ability to conduct competitor and market research.
* Highly proactive, organised and result\-oriented.
* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of business outcomes.



  





**Preferred Profile** 




 We would prefer someone who:
 


* Has hands\-on experience managing multiple e\-commerce platforms.
* Understands both
 **sales growth and profitability** 
 .
* Can independently identify problems and propose solutions.
* Is comfortable working in a fast\-paced and entrepreneurial environment.
* Has a strong interest in consumer products, digital commerce and new product development.
* Thinks beyond day\-to\-day operations and actively looks for new business opportunities.

title: Amazon & Marketplace Manager – Home Appliances
description:
Moonstruck Appliances is hiring an Amazon \& Marketplace Manager to own the growth and profitability of our home\-appliances categories, with Amazon as the primary platform and Flipkart and other marketplaces as additional channels.
 



  





 We are looking for a hands\-on category specialist who understands appliance products, can lead an ecommerce team, and can turn sales plans into consistent execution across listings, advertising, pricing and inventory.
 



  





 WHAT YOU WILL OWN
 



  





 • Amazon marketplace and category performance: manage Seller Central, build SKU\-level growth plans, identify assortment gaps and competition, and plan launches for fans and other home appliances.
 



 • Team leadership: set weekly targets, allocate work, coach team members, review performance and build clear SOPs across catalogue, advertising and marketplace operations.
 



 • Listing quality and conversion: improve titles, search terms, product attributes, variations, images, A\+ Content and Brand Store pages; coordinate with the creative team and resolve listing issues.
 



 • Advertising and promotions: manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display where applicable; improve keyword targeting, bids and budgets; plan deals and sale\-event execution.
 



 • Pricing and profitability: evaluate selling prices, marketplace fees, advertising costs, discounts and returns to improve contribution margin alongside revenue growth.
 



 • Stock and fulfilment: coordinate demand forecasting, replenishment, FBA and seller\-fulfilled availability with production, warehouse and operations teams; reduce stock\-outs and ageing inventory.
 



 • Marketplace operations: monitor account health, catalogue suppression, order issues, returns and customer feedback; coordinate timely resolution with the relevant teams.
 



 • Reporting: maintain clear daily and weekly dashboards covering sales, conversion, advertising efficiency, contribution margin, stock availability and returns, with actions and owners.
 



  





 WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 



  





 • Direct experience managing Amazon Seller Central and marketplace sales, with strong knowledge of home appliances, fans, consumer durables or closely related product categories.
 



 • Practical capability across Amazon advertising, catalogue optimisation, pricing, inventory and marketplace account health.
 



 • Experience leading an ecommerce team, setting targets and following through on execution.
 



 • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills and the ability to explain business performance using numbers.
 



 • Working knowledge of Flipkart; experience with additional marketplaces is an advantage.
 



 • Clear communication and coordination with production, warehouse, creative and customer\-service teams.
 



 • Availability for a full\-time, on\-site role in Bawana, Delhi.
 



  





 HOW SUCCESS WILL BE MEASURED
 



  





 Profitable marketplace growth, stronger listing conversion, improved advertising efficiency, dependable stock availability and a team that delivers against clear targets.
 



  





 TO APPLY
 



  





 Apply through LinkedIn with your CV and a brief summary of the categories and marketplaces you have managed, your team\-leadership experience, and measurable results you have delivered.

title: Client Servicing Manager
description:
**About the Company** 




  





 At Mad Men Marketing, we’re not just about ads\- we’re about impact. As a new\-age creative and digital agency, we work at the intersection of ideas, technology, and culture. We collaborate with some of the most exciting brands in India, crafting stories that spark conversations and drive measurable results. If you're passionate about building brands and managing relationships that matter, you might be the perfect fit.

 We are seeking a seasoned Client Servicing Manager/Account Manager who will be responsible for managing top\-tier client relationships and leading the execution of strategic digital campaigns. You’ll serve as the go\-to person for both clients and internal teams, ensuring seamless delivery and client satisfaction. This is a senior\-level role that demands commercial acumen, creative thinking, and a deep understanding of digital marketing trends.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  




* **Client Relationship Management**



 Act as the primary liaison for key clients, nurturing strong and lasting partnerships.
 



 Gain a thorough understanding of each client’s business goals, target audience, and market positioning.
 



 Maintain high levels of client satisfaction through clear communication, transparency, and timely delivery.
 



  




* **Campaign Planning \& Execution**



 Lead the full lifecycle of campaigns—from brief to brainstorm, from strategy to reporting.
 



 Work cross\-functionally with internal teams (creative, content, influencer, media, performance) to drive execution.
 



 Ensure project timelines, budgets, and quality standards are met without compromise.
 



  




* **Strategic Consulting \& Brand Stewardship**



 Deliver strategic guidance backed by industry trends and insights to help clients meet their marketing objectives.
 



 Ensure all campaigns are on\-brand and aligned with the client’s voice, positioning, and market narrative.
 



 Recommend new formats, channels, or content opportunities based on platform innovation and market shifts.
 



  




* **Performance Monitoring \& Reporting**



 Monitor campaign KPIs and performance metrics using tools like Google Analytics, Meta Suite, and internal dashboards.
 



 Analyze results to deliver actionable insights and clear next steps to improve campaign outcomes.
 



 Lead client reporting meetings and present performance reviews, learnings, and forward\-looking strategies.
 



  




* **Revenue Growth \& Account Expansion**



 Identify upsell and cross\-sell opportunities within existing accounts—introducing new services or retainer scopes.
 



 Collaborate with the new business team to pitch ideas and renew or expand contracts.
 



 Play a key role in driving account revenue and contributing to overall agency growth.
 



  




* **Team Collaboration \& Leadership**



 Be the internal voice of the client—aligning teams and managing expectations across departments.
 



 Mentor junior account executives or interns, sharing best practices and leadership guidance.
 



 Drive internal brainstorming sessions to enhance campaign quality and originality.
 



  




* **Crisis Management \& Problem Solving**



 Tackle challenges head\-on—whether it’s a tight deadline, a shifting brief, or a difficult client conversation.
 



 Maintain professionalism under pressure, offering quick solutions and managing escalation efficiently.
 



 Stay adaptable and proactive in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.
 



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.
* Minimum 2\+ years of account management experience in a digital/creative agency.
* Proven ability to manage high\-stakes clients and complex campaigns.
* Solid understanding of digital marketing, content creation, performance media, and influencer strategy.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with client\-facing polish.
* Proficiency in tools like Google Workspace, MS Office, Meta Ads Manager, Google Analytics, and project trackers.
* Ability to handle multiple projects, teams, and deadlines simultaneously with composure and clarity.



  





 Full\-Time \| Immediate Joiners only
 



  





**Equal Opportunity Statement** 




  





 We are committed to diversity and inclusivity in our hiring practices.

**Job Description:**
**ROLE PURPOSE:**
 As Market Access Manager, you will be responsible for enabling access across the company’s portfolio by developing and implementing market access strategies that address pricing, reimbursement, funding pathways, policy shaping, and stakeholder engagement. The role will support portfolio\-wide access objectives across relevant therapeutic areas, with a specific focus on public accounts, national and sub\-national health authorities, public procurement bodies, and public health programs. Your work will help ensure timely, sustainable, and equitable access to medicines and vaccines by aligning evidence, value communication, and partnership strategies with public\-sector priorities and patient needs.
   

  

**ACCOUNTABILITIES:**
**Portfolio Market Access Strategy:** 
 Develop and execute integrated market access strategies across the portfolio, ensuring each product has a clear access pathway that reflects its value proposition, patient need, public health relevance, affordability considerations, and local healthcare system dynamics.
 **Evidence Generation and Value Demonstration:** 
 Collaborate with medical, HEOR, policy, and cross\-functional teams to generate and translate evidence that demonstrates clinical, economic, budgetary, and public health value across the portfolio, supporting access discussions with public stakeholders and payers.
 **Pricing, Reimbursement, and Funding Pathways:** 
 Support pricing and reimbursement strategies by analyzing market dynamics, public funding mechanisms, procurement models, affordability barriers, and competitor benchmarks, while ensuring alignment with portfolio value, patient access objectives, and compliance requirements.
 **Public Account Engagement:** 
 Build and maintain strategic relationships with public accounts, including government health authorities, public payers, national and sub\-national institutions, procurement agencies, public hospitals, and public health program stakeholders, to understand priorities and shape sustainable access solutions.
 **Value Communication:** 
 Communicate product and portfolio value propositions to policymakers, public payers, procurement stakeholders, healthcare providers, and internal teams, clearly articulating clinical value, public health impact, economic considerations, and relevance to public\-sector priorities.
 **Public Market Intelligence:** 
 Monitor healthcare policy, public funding priorities, reimbursement trends, procurement processes, tender opportunities, competitor activity, and stakeholder dynamics to identify access opportunities, risks, and implications for the portfolio.
 **Access Planning and Execution:** 
 Partner with cross\-functional teams to integrate market access considerations into brand planning, launch planning, lifecycle management, reimbursement planning, public account plans, and private\-channel access initiatives, ensuring timely execution of activities that support access across the portfolio.

description:

 EdTerra Edventures is a leading experiential learning and educational travel company that designs and delivers immersive learning journeys for school students across India and international destinations.
   

  

 We partner with schools to create meaningful experiences that combine travel, learning, culture, adventure and real\-world exposure.

 **Head – Sales**

 **business leadership role**

title: Marketing Director  (ID # 918)
description:
The client is India's leading Voice AI platform for consumer sales. Their AI agents run 50 lakh\+ calls a day for 60\+ leading brands including Kotak Mahindra Bank, AngelOne, PhonePe, IndiaMART, TATA Digital, Amazon, Swiggy and Eureka Forbes, giving every lead the best pitch, in their language, on their preferred channel, at the right time. Our customers see up to 90% lead connectivity, 40% more conversions and 2\-3x lower CAC. We own the stack we run on. Arth, our speech\-to\-text model, is trained on 600M\+ minutes of real Indian sales conversations and, on our own benchmark of noisy Hinglish telephony audio, comes out ahead of every other model. Maya, the world's first Sales LLM, is trained on 400M\+ real sales interactions and their outcomes, so it learns what actually closes, not just what sounds fluent. We process over a trillion tokens a month at under 0\.8 second median latency, and every conversation makes the next one better. Driven by 200\+ builders and backed by Blume Ventures, Chiratae Ventures and Bertelsmann India Investments, we believe how we build matters as much as what we build. Ownership is real, trust is the default, and there is room for deep work. Careers here are not one\-size\-fits\-all. Growth can be linear or non\-linear, leadership can be quiet or bold, and people build, lead and challenge without being pushed into a single mould. If you're excited by AI, driven by purpose, and want your work to truly matter, there is space for you here.
 



  





  





**About the Role** 




  





  





 We are looking for an Associate Director, Marketing to shape how the client shows up in the market as we build the category for AI Voice Agents in consumer sales. This is not a “manage campaigns from a distance” role. We are looking for someone who can think sharply, write clearly, build narratives from first principles, and turn marketing into a real growth engine. You will own the positioning, messaging, launches, content engine, website, PR, events and the overall brand quality across touchpoints. You will work closely with the founders, product, sales and customer teams to define how we tell our story to enterprise buyers, how we launch new capabilities, how we create demand, and how we build trust in a fast\-emerging AI category. The role needs someone who is strategic enough to define the narrative, operating cadence and budget, but still hands\-on enough to write, edit, brief, review, ship and improve the work personally. A big part of the mandate is also to build a genuinely AI\-native marketing operating system. Not just using AI to draft copy, but rethinking how research, content, launch prep, reporting, website work and creative workflows can run faster and better with AI, while still maintaining strong human judgment and brand quality. This is a high\-ownership role for someone who wants to build the marketing function for a serious B2B AI company at an important stage of scale.
 



  





  





**Responsibilities** 




  





  




* Positioning and product marketing
* Define the narrative and messaging architecture, including the category story for AI voice agents in consumer sales.
* Run every launch end to end: messaging, enablement, assets, post\-launch measurement.
* Brand, content and website
* Build the content engine and keep the brand coherent across blog, thought leadership, case studies and socials.
* Own the website as a growth asset: structure, conversion, and visibility across search and AI answer engines.
* Lead the design team and raise the quality bar on everything we ship.
* PR and events
* Own PR end to end: agency, media relationships, announcements, executive bylines, analyst relationships.
* Own the event calendar, and be accountable for its pipeline contribution rather than just its execution.
* The team’s AI operating model
* Decide which workflows run agentically, which need human review, and how brand voice holds up at scale.
* Rebuild content, research, launch prep and reporting as AI\-assisted pipelines with quality gates.
* Team
* Lead and grow the team across content, product marketing and design.
* Own the budget across agencies, tools, events and PR.



  





  





**Qualifications** 




  





  




* 7\+ years in marketing, at least 3 in B2B SaaS or AI sold to enterprise buyers.
* 2\+ years managing people, including a designer or creative.
* You have written positioning and messaging yourself, and run launches end to end where you can say what moved as a result.
* You have run an editorial calendar across SEO\-led pieces, case studies and executive posts, with traffic or pipeline numbers attached to it.
* You have shipped and iterated website pages yourself, and you know how organic visibility works: site structure, technical SEO, schema, and how AI answer engines choose their sources.
* You have directed PR in\-house or through an agency, as long as you drove the output rather than approved it.
* You have owned events, sponsorships, roundtables or webinars, and you know what pipeline came out of them.
* Still hands\-on. If your last few months contain nothing you personally wrote, designed or built, this is not the right fit.
* Genuinely AI\-native. You have restructured a real workflow around AI rather than using it to draft copy, you have built prompt libraries or agents that other people use, and you have an opinion on where AI output is unacceptable.
* Strong written English. This role writes, edits and raises the standard of everything written.



  





  





  





**Why should you consider us seriously?** 




  





  





 We believe that long\-term, people over product and profits, prioritize culture over everything else. We are a well\-balanced team of experienced entrepreneurs and are backed by top investors across India and Silicon Valley (Chiratae Ventures, Blume Ventures, Abstract Ventures, Emergent Ventures; Senior execs at Google, Square, Genpact \& Flipkart; Co\-founders of Infosys, Snapdeal, Slideshare, Zomato, etc.)

title: Delhi/NCR Sr Manager, Pricing Strategy Consulting
description:
**Company Description** 
 Monetizely is a pricing strategy consultancy built by experienced operators with nearly three decades of combined leadership in Product Management, Product Marketing, and Pricing at companies such as Zoom, Twilio, LinkedIn, Squarespace, Medallia, and Microsoft. The team brings deep product and go\-to\-market expertise to every engagement and is known for authoring “Price to Scale” and teaching a top\-rated course on SaaS, Agentic \& AI Pricing Strategy \& Monetization. Monetizely partners with software companies from Seed stage through post\-IPO to transform how they package, price, and monetize their products. Its 5\-step pricing transformation framework blends design thinking, rigorous market research (including Van Westendorp, Conjoint, MaxDiff, and qualitative validation), and strong operationalization to ensure strategies align with GTM motions. The firm has delivered measurable impact, such as significant customer growth, higher average deal sizes, expanded customer bases, and substantial increases in validated willingness to pay across multiple clients.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, remote role for a Sr Manager, Pricing Strategy Consulting at Monetizely. The Sr Manager will lead end\-to\-end pricing and packaging engagements for software clients, from diagnostic discovery through recommendation, experimentation, and rollout. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include conducting market and customer research, structuring and analyzing pricing studies, and translating findings into clear, actionable pricing strategies. The role will collaborate closely with client stakeholders in Product, Marketing, Sales, and Finance to align pricing with product strategy and GTM motions, and to support implementation, enablement, and change management. The Sr Manager will also contribute to Monetizely’s thought leadership, methodologies, and internal tooling, helping scale best practices across client engagements.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Strong expertise in pricing strategy, packaging design, and monetization for B2B SaaS or software businesses.
* Experience with quantitative and qualitative market research methods, including survey design, pricing research frameworks (e.g., Van Westendorp, Conjoint, MaxDiff), and customer interviews.

* Background in Product Management, Product Marketing, Management Consulting, or a related strategic role working with cross\-functional teams.

* Demonstrated ability to lead projects independently, manage multiple client workstreams, and deliver outcomes in fast\-paced, ambiguous environments.
* Comfort working in a fully remote, distributed team and collaborating asynchronously across time zones.

title: CRM Manager
description:
**About noon** 




 We’re building an ecosystem of digital products and services that power everyday life across the Middle East—fast, scalable, and deeply customer\-centric. Our mission is to deliver to every door every day. We want to redefine what technology can do in this region, and we’re looking for a CRM Manager who can help us move even faster.
 



  





**noon’s mission: Every door, every day.** 




  





**About Dubai Mall** 




 The Dubai Mall Online is the official digital platform of Dubai Mall, bringing together the mall’s iconic retail brands into a single online shopping destination. Powered by best\-in\-class e\-commerce technology, logistics, and customer experience capabilities, the platform enables customers to discover, shop, and receive products from multiple Dubai Mall retailers through a seamless digital journey.
 



  





 Joining The Dubai Mall Online offers a unique opportunity to help build and scale a high\-growth business from the ground up, working alongside some of the world’s most recognized brands while shaping the future of omnichannel retail in the GCC.
 



  





**What you'll do:** 




 As the CRM Manager for Dubai Mall Online, you will own the end\-to\-end lifecycle retention strategy, automated customer journeys, and multi\-channel engagement across App Push, WhatsApp, Email, and SMS. You will be working closely with the growth, product, and commercial teams to build and optimize scalable retention funnels designed to drive first\-order conversion, repeat purchase frequency, and long\-term Customer Lifetime Value (LTV). You will be responsible for operationalizing our CRM stack from scratch.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Own Lifecycle Automation \& Funnel Build:** 
 Build and optimize automated customer journeys including Welcome, Onboarding, Cart/Search Abandonment, Post\-Purchase, and Win\-back flows.
* **Analytics Partnership \& Cohort Setup:** 
 Work with Analytics to build and operationalize customer cohorts, RFM segments, and behavioral triggers.
* **WhatsApp WABA Governance \& Tier Ramp:** 
 Manage WhatsApp Business API operations, including Meta template approvals, display\-name verification, and messaging\-volume tier growth.
* **Arabic Journey Execution:** 
 Deliver fully localized English and Arabic CRM communications, including RTL\-compliant copy, offers, and timing.
* **Internal Messaging Tool Governance:** 
 Manage campaign scheduling, audience rules, templates, and delivery health across internal email and push platforms.
* **Wallet \& Cashback Communications:** 
 Own customer communications related to wallet balances, cashback, credits, return windows, and promotional incentives.
* **Cross\-Ecosystem \& Community Broadcasts:** 
 Coordinate strategic audience campaigns with noon Growth teams and Emaar stakeholders across relevant customer databases and channels.
* **Data Hygiene \& PDPL Compliance:** 
 Ensure compliant opt\-ins, unsubscribe processes, customer\-data synchronization, and database hygiene under UAE PDPL.
* **A/B Testing \& LTV Optimization:** 
 Establish continuous testing across timing, channels, messaging, personalization, and recommendations to improve engagement and repeat purchases.
* **Analytics \& Retention Reporting:** 
 Build daily and weekly reports covering customer cohorts, repeat orders, channel performance, deliverability, and uninstalls for Growth leadership.



  





**What you’ll need** 



* **5\+ years of CRM/lifecycle marketing experience** 
 , ideally within mobile\-first e\-commerce, marketplaces, or digital consumer platforms.
* **Strong hands\-on experience with messaging platforms** 
 , including building customer cohorts, RFM segments, and behavioral triggers in partnership with Analytics teams.
* **Expertise in WhatsApp Business API (WABA)** 
 , including Meta template approvals, display\-name verification, and messaging\-volume tier management.
* **Strong understanding of data privacy and compliance** 
 , particularly UAE PDPL or GDPR, including opt\-in/opt\-out processes and customer\-data hygiene.
* **Exceptional attention to detail** 
 with a strong focus on accurate customer\-facing copy, links, audience rules, and trigger timing.
* **Entrepreneurial, high\-ownership mindset** 
 , with the ability to build CRM frameworks, campaign calendars, lifecycle journeys, and experimentation roadmaps from scratch.
* **Professional fluency in English** 
 ; Arabic reading/writing or prior GCC market experience is a strong advantage.



  





**Who will excel?** 



* We’re looking for people with high standards, who understand that hard work matters.
* You need to be relentlessly resourceful and operate with a deep bias for action.
* We need people with the courage to be fiercely original.
* noon is not for everyone; readiness to adapt, pivot, and learn is essential.

title: GM / Head – Export Marketing & New Buyer Development | Garment Exports
company: Maxonic Consulting-Executive Search/ Leadership Hiring-High Impact roles @ HyperGrowth/Scaling  Orgs
description:
**GM / Head – Export Marketing \& New Buyer Development \| Garment Exports**
**Can you open the right international buyers and get them seriously interested in evaluating a new garment supplier?** 

 Maxonic Consulting is conducting a search for an
 **established, quality\-led garment exporter in Gurugram** 
 with a substantial and proven manufacturing base across woven and knit apparel.
 



 The company has
 **meaningful production capacity available for growth** 
 and now wants to build a stronger, professional new\-buyer acquisition engine.
 



  





 This is not primarily a role for someone who has spent their career
 **handling existing buyers or running orders already secured by the company** 
 .
 



  





 The first challenge is much more specific:
 


**Identify the right international buyers, open the doors, represent the company credibly, and get those buyers interested enough to begin evaluating the supplier.**
**What success will look like** 
**1\. Open the right international buyers** 

 This is the most important part of the role.
 



 You should be able to:
 


* identify relevant international brands, retailers, buying houses and sourcing organisations;
* determine who the real buying / sourcing decision\-makers are;
* create access through your network, referrals, direct outreach or other routes;
* represent the company credibly with senior buyers; and
* give them a compelling reason to evaluate the manufacturing platform.



 We are particularly interested in people who can say:
 


**“I personally opened this buyer. This is how I got access, and this is why they agreed to evaluate us.”** 
**2\. Move interest into development, sampling and trials** 

 Opening the door is only the beginning.
 



 You will work with merchandising, product development, costing and manufacturing teams to move serious buyer interest into:
 



**development brief → sampling → costing / RFQ → vendor evaluation → trial order** 




 We will therefore value candidates who have not only secured buyer meetings, but have successfully moved relationships into
 **real commercial evaluation** 
 .
 


**3\. Support conversion into bulk and repeat business** 

 You should have the commercial maturity to support opportunities through negotiation, internal coordination, problem solving and follow\-through.
 



 However, we understand that conversion into bulk orders depends on several factors beyond the salesperson alone—including
 **price, product fit, sampling, compliance, capacity, delivery and factory capability** 
 .
 



 We are therefore interested not simply in:
 


 “How much revenue did you handle?”
 
 but in:
 


**“What did you personally do to create and progress the opportunity?”** 
**4\. Progressively assume broader sales ownership** 

 Initially, this is a
 **senior individual\-contributor role** 
 .
 



 The immediate priority is simple:
 


**Prove that you can create new buyer access and move opportunities forward.** 

 As the business develops, the successful person can progressively take broader ownership of the sales function from the promoters and build the team, processes and commercial infrastructure around it.
   




**Why this could be a meaningful career move** 

 This opportunity combines two things that rarely come together.
 


**You are not building on air** 

 Behind you will be an established, organised and quality\-conscious production platform with:
 


* significant manufacturing capacity;
* efficient assembly\-line production;
* strong quality discipline and low rejection orientation;
* reliable on\-time shipment capability; and
* experienced merchandising and manufacturing support.


**But you do get to build the growth engine** 

 The new\-buyer acquisition capability is still relatively open.
 



 You will have meaningful independence to influence:
 


* which markets to pursue;
* which buyers to prioritise;
* how to create access;
* how Pyoginam should be positioned;
* how the pipeline should be built; and
* eventually, what commercial team should support the business.



 In simple terms:
 


**Build something of your own — without having to build the factory behind you.** 

 You will work directly with the owners, who want to materially grow exports and are prepared to invest behind the right growth leader.
 



 For the right person, the opportunity is therefore about more than compensation or designation.
 



 It is the chance to create a business capability whose impact can be
 **visible, measurable and substantially attributable to you** 
 .
   




**Who we would particularly like to meet** 

 Professionals from:
 


* Export Marketing
* New Buyer Development
* International Business Development
* Sales \& Marketing – Garment Exports
* Marketing \& Merchandising
* Business Head / Commercial roles with genuine new\-buyer responsibility



 Experience in
 **garment/apparel exports** 
 is strongly preferred.
 



 Experience with buying houses, sourcing organisations, international brands and European / UK / US buyers would be valuable.
   




**Marketing Merchandisers — please read this** 

 If your designation is
 **Marketing Merchandiser / Marketing \& Merchandising** 
 , but you have personally helped
 **open new buyers and create fresh business** 
 , we would like to hear from you.
 



 Your designation is not the deciding factor.
 



**What you actually did is.**



**Who is unlikely to fit** 

 This role is unlikely to suit professionals whose careers have been predominantly:
 


* merchandising running orders;
* servicing existing buyers;
* sourcing / vendor management;
* production / operations;
* order execution; or
* handling buyers that were already doing business with the company,



**unless you can demonstrate that you also personally helped develop new buyers.** 




 Similarly:
 


**Knowing buyers is useful. Having personally opened them is much more important.**
**Exceptional hunters from outside apparel** 

 We may also consider an exceptional B2B business developer from an adjacent industry if you can demonstrate:
 


* repeated new\-customer creation;
* ability to build a market from a relatively blank sheet;
* senior\-level selling;
* strong commercial judgement;
* high learning agility; and
* genuine motivation to become credible quickly in apparel manufacturing and sourcing.



 This is
 **not** 
 , however, a role in which someone will learn sales from scratch.
 


**Location** 

 Gurugram
 



 Manufacturing operations: IMT Manesar
 


**Travel** 

 Domestic and international buyer travel / relevant sourcing and apparel fairs where commercially justified.
 


**Level** 

 GM / Head level
 



 Initially a senior individual contributor, with scope to build a team as business requirements develop.
 


**Compensation** 

 The company is prepared to be flexible for an exceptional fit. Fixed and performance\-linked compensation will be structured appropriately around the person selected.
   




**Before you apply** 

 Please ask yourself:
 


**Which international buyers did I personally help open where little or no meaningful business existed earlier?** 

 And then:
 


**How did I get access, why did the buyer agree to evaluate us, and how far did the relationship progress into development, sampling or trial business?** 

 If you have strong answers, we would like to speak with you.
 



 When applying, please include a short note covering:
 



**Buyer / customer opened \| Route to first access \| Your personal role \| Product / category \| Sampling / trial / business outcome** 




 All discussions will be treated confidentially.
 



  





  





**Nimish Singhania
 
 ﻿**




**Maxonic Consulting**

title: Director of Sales Marketing
description:
**Position Overview** 




  





 Gallery Espace is looking for a full time Director Sales \& Marketing based in New Delhi.
 



  





 The Sales Director will be responsible for driving the gallery's sales strategy, revenue growth, client acquisition, and development of long\-term relationships with collectors, HNIs, UHNIs, corporate clients, interior designers, architects, and art institutions.
 



  





 The role requires a strong understanding of the contemporary and/or modern art market, excellent sales and negotiation skills, and the ability to build trusted relationships with collectors and key stakeholders.
 



 The Sales Director will work closely with the Gallery Director, curatorial team, artists, marketing team, and operations team to convert exhibitions, art fairs, private viewings, and client engagements into sustainable commercial opportunities.
 







**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Sales Strategy \& Revenue Growth** 



* Develop and implement the gallery's annual and quarterly sales strategy.
* Set revenue targets and sales objectives and ensure their achievement.
* Identify new markets, collector segments, and business opportunities.
* Develop strategies for increasing sales from existing collectors while acquiring new clients.
* Monitor sales performance, market trends, pricing, and competitor activity.
* Prepare regular sales forecasts, reports, and performance updates for management.



**2\. Client \& Collector Development** 



* Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective collectors.
* Develop a structured database of collectors, HNIs, UHNIs, corporate clients, designers, architects, and institutions.
* Conduct personalised outreach and follow\-ups based on clients' collecting interests and budgets.
* Organise private viewings, studio visits, collection presentations, and bespoke art consultations.
* Understand individual clients' tastes, collecting objectives, and investment horizons and recommend appropriate artworks.
* Ensure a high level of confidentiality, professionalism, and service throughout the sales process.



**3\. Art Sales \& Business Development** 



* Lead the end\-to\-end sales process, from prospecting and artwork presentation to negotiation, closing, invoicing, and post\-sale relationship management.
* Develop corporate and institutional sales opportunities.
* Build relationships with interior designers, architects, hospitality groups, luxury brands, and corporate organisations.
* Identify opportunities for commissioned works, corporate collections, and large\-scale installations.
* Support the development of new revenue streams and strategic partnerships.



**4\. Exhibitions \& Art Fairs** 



* Develop sales plans for exhibitions, previews, openings, and art fairs.
* Work closely with the curatorial and marketing teams to identify priority artworks and potential buyers.
* Coordinate collector outreach before and after exhibitions and art fairs.
* Attend openings, VIP previews, art fairs, and industry events as a representative of the gallery.
* Maximise sales opportunities generated through exhibitions, events, and digital channels.



**5\. Team Leadership** 



* Lead, mentor, and motivate the gallery's sales team.
* Establish individual and team sales targets and KPIs.
* Develop sales processes, reporting systems, and follow\-up standards.
* Conduct regular pipeline reviews and performance evaluations.
* Train the team on client engagement, artwork presentation, negotiation, and closing techniques.
* Foster a culture of professionalism, accountability, and relationship\-driven selling.



**6\. Pricing \& Negotiation** 



* Work with senior management to establish pricing and discounting strategies.
* Lead negotiations with collectors and institutional buyers within approved parameters.
* Maintain appropriate margins while ensuring commercially viable transactions.
* Monitor artwork pricing, artist demand, secondary\-market activity, and relevant market developments.



**7\. CRM \& Sales Reporting** 



* Maintain accurate records of leads, prospects, collectors, interactions, sales, and follow\-ups.
* Ensure effective use of the gallery's CRM and client database.
* Track the sales pipeline from lead generation through conversion.
* Analyse sales data and provide actionable insights to management.
* Maintain accurate forecasts and reports on revenue, conversion rates, average transaction values, and client acquisition.



**8\. Brand Representation** 



* Represent the gallery professionally at exhibitions, art fairs, dinners, collector events, and industry functions.
* Develop and maintain relationships with collectors, artists, curators, critics, museums, foundations, and other industry stakeholders.
* Protect and enhance the gallery's reputation and relationships within the art ecosystem.







**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** 



* Annual and quarterly sales revenue
* Achievement of sales targets
* New collector acquisition
* Repeat\-purchase rate
* Sales conversion rate
* Average transaction value
* Sales pipeline value
* Corporate and institutional business generated
* Exhibition and art\-fair sales performance
* Client retention and relationship development
* Team productivity and target achievement







**Qualifications \& Experience** 



* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Art History, Fine Arts, Business, Marketing, Luxury Management, or a related field preferred.
* **8–12\+ years of relevant sales/business development experience** 
 , preferably within an art gallery, auction house, luxury business, or related sector.
* Proven track record of achieving significant sales targets.
* Established network of collectors, HNIs/UHNIs, corporate clients, designers, architects, or art professionals is highly desirable.
* Strong knowledge of the contemporary and/or modern art market.
* Experience working with artists, galleries, collectors, art fairs, and exhibitions.
* Experience managing and developing a sales team.







**Core Skills** 



* Strategic sales planning
* Relationship management
* Business development
* Consultative selling
* Negotiation and closing
* Client acquisition and retention
* Art\-market knowledge
* Team leadership
* CRM and sales analytics
* Presentation and communication
* Networking and stakeholder management
* Commercial awareness

 Immediate
 



  





**Why Energeia** 





 We've spent 8 years turning energy waste into profit for industry leaders like ABB, LG, PepsiCo, Haldiram's, Bosch, Lenskart, Times of India, Adobe, Leela Palace, and Emaar, delivering ₹256 crore in cost savings and 2\.5 lakh tonnes of CO₂ reduction. You'd be joining at the moment the story gets bigger.
 




  




* **Profitable since Day 1:** 
 Real runway with disciplined growth over 8 years.

 Your work moves revenue
 *and* 
 decarbonization for factories, hospitals, hotels, and more.

 India \+ select international markets; occasional on\-site learning.

 Web case studies, LinkedIn carousels, short videos you’ll be proud to showcase.

 Weekly check\-ins with direct coaching; exposure to the CEO on priority projects.

 New formats, prompts, and growth ideas \- measured by outcomes, not vanity metrics.

 Easy transitions to Sales, Product Management, or Business Strategy if interests evolve.

 Turn complex energy work into clear stories and repeatable growth. You'll own a few projects end to end and work closely with the founders, marketing lead, sales team, designers, and video editors.
 



  





**A note on how we use AI in Marketing** 





 We use AI extensively and responsibly to speed up our workflows, but the thinking is still done by the humans at Energeia. Knowing when the output is bland or wrong, and fixing it, is the skill we're hiring for. This is the heart of the role, not an add\-on. We're building more of our marketing on agentic AI workflows, and you'll work alongside the marketing lead to run and sharpen them, a rare chance to learn how a modern marketing function is actually built.
 




  





**What you’ll do** 



* Write \& ship content like case studies, blogs, LinkedIn copy, etc.
* Build sales collateral in Canva and PPT (decks, proposals, infographics)
* Turn stories into short videos (script \+ manage editors)
* Extract customer insights from on\-ground teams and turn them into stories that make content land
* Scope and manage project hand\-offs to our external design and video partners
* Run occasional email campaigns end\-to\-end
* Execute and refine our AI search visibility strategy



  





**Must\-haves** 



* Sharp critical thinking and reasoning ability.
* Previous B2B marketing or sales experience
* Curiosity about energy efficiency; bias for action.
* Excellent English; conversational Hindi.
* Refined and detail\-oriented design eye.
* Strong copy editing \+ brand\-tone enforcement.
* Customer\-centered way of thinking



  





**Good\-to\-haves** 



* Energy domain exposure (ESCOs, energy efficiency, engineering)
* Previous content creation experience: case studies, blogs, videos, or similar.

* Comfort and experimentation with AI tools, and an interest in building repeatable AI workflows.



  





**Not for you if…** 



* You wait for instructions instead of taking ownership end\-to\-end.
* You avoid learning new tools/AI or fact\-checking technical content.
* You prefer working in silos over collaborating with sales, engineers, and designers.
* Tight timelines and context\-switching make you uncomfortable.

 Chat with HR
 
 →
 
 Marketing Head portfolio chat
 
 →
 
 Short take\-home
 
 →
 
 Final round.
 



  





**Apply:** 
  
 



 Submit your application on LinkedIn, or write to sankriti.malik@energeia.in with subject:
 



 “Marketing Specialist 2026 – Your Name.” Include 2\-3 lines about why you’d like to work with us and links to any case studies, blogs, decks, LinkedIn posts, video samples, email campaigns, etc. that you’ve worked on in the past.
 



  





**Important Note:** 




 Preference will be given to candidates who show initiative:
 



  




* Read our website to learn about our work \- https://www.energeia.in/
